jobs.title: Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

jobs.title: On Holiday Support Agent
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our growing team at Mölnlycke.

In this role, you will leverage data, analytics, and digital solutions to support operational, tactical, and strategic decision-making across the Supply Chain organization. You will play a key role in improving procurement performance, inventory optimization, service levels, cost efficiency, and operational excellence through data-driven insights and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position will primarily focus on Level procurement, with Rosemount Tank Radar as the main area of responsibility. You will support procurement and inventory processes, monitor performance, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate with buyers across multiple sites to resolve system or setup-related issues.

If you are passionate about analytics, process improvement, and translating data into business value, we would love to hear from you.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

    Identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis of procurement and supply chain data.

    Lead and support continuous improvement projects within Supply Chain and in partnership with cross-functional teams.
    Prepare reports, presentations, and data-driven recommendations to support management and business stakeholders.

You consistently apply analytical thinking to solve complex problems and make informed decisions. You communicate clearly and confidently, translating data into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders. You proactively identify opportunities, embrace new technologies and ways of working, and drive meaningful improvements that create business value.

    Experience with supply chain analytics, inventory optimization, or procurement process improvement.
    Exposure to automation, digitalization, AI-driven solutions, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI.

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

jobs.title: Persoonlijk assistent voor Elly-Jean in Aalst
jobs.description:
Elly-Jean is een sociale en gevoelige jongeman die snel contact maakt en graag onder de mensen is. Hij observeert veel en neemt graag dingen over uit zijn omgeving. Geef hem de juiste ondersteuning en hij kan elke dag weer iets nieuws bijleren. Nu zijn school is weggevallen, zoekt hij vooral opnieuw structuur, beweging en fijne bezigheden.

Bij wie ga jij aan de slag?

Elly-Jean is bijna 24 jaar en woont samen met zijn mama, broer en twee zussen in de regio Aalst. Het is een warm gezin waar Elly-Jean helemaal deel van uitmaakt.

Tot voor kort ging Elly-Jean naar school, maar momenteel is hij voltijds thuis. Daardoor is er heel wat structuur en bezigheid weggevallen. Een assistent kan hem helpen om opnieuw een fijne invulling aan zijn dagen te geven.

Elly-Jean is een sociale jongen die gemakkelijk contact maakt. Hij spreekt meestal in eenwoordzinnen. Daarom is het belangrijk dat je goed observeert en zijn gedrag leert lezen. Zo merk je bijvoorbeeld wanneer hij moe wordt of wanneer iets hem niet goed zit.

Elly-Jean heeft nood aan duidelijke structuur. In zijn leefgroep werkte hij met pictogrammen om zijn dagprogramma te volgen en te zien welke begeleider aanwezig was. Heb je ervaring met deze doelgroep, dan kan je die kennis zeker gebruiken om samen met Jean meer duidelijkheid en structuur in zijn dag te brengen.

Maar Elly-Jean is vooral ook een jongen die graag bezig is. Hij houdt van wandelen, zwemmen onder toezicht, fietsen, boodschappen doen en boodschappen uitladen. Lange activiteiten waarbij hij lang moet concentreren zijn minder geschikt. Variatie werkt beter.

Hij geniet van gospel en Studio 100-liedjes en kan helemaal opgaan in wat hij ziet en hoort. Elly-Jean is bovendien best fier op zijn uiterlijk. Hij maakt zich graag mooi en kijkt vol bewondering wanneer mama of zijn zussen zich opmaken. Dan weet hij dat er iets feestelijks op komst is.

Elly-Jean is handig in kleine taken. Hij ruimt graag op, want alles heeft voor hem een vaste plaats. Ook afdrogen kan hij goed. Terwijl hij televisie kijkt of naar muziek luistert, kan jij bijvoorbeeld strijken, opruimen of een maaltijd klaarmaken. Wie weet kan je Elly-Jean wel betrekken en hem dingen aanleren.

Niet elke dag verloopt perfect. Zeker nu er zoveel veranderd is in zijn leven, kan Elly-Jean soms grenzen opzoeken. Je kan op een rustige manier grenzen stellen en laten merken dat dingen niet kunnen. Wanneer Elly-Jean iets fout doet, beseft hij dit vaak en kan hij zich daar achteraf schuldig over voelen.

Welke vaardigheden zijn belangrijk om als assistent te starten bij Jean?

  • Je bent eerlijk en betrouwbaar

  • Je hebt ervaring met deze doelgroep

  • Je kan goed observeren en gedrag leren begrijpen

  • Je brengt rust en duidelijke structuur

  • Je bent zacht maar durft ook grenzen te stellen

  • Je bent creatief in het bedenken van activiteiten

  • Je houdt van wandelen en bewegen

  • Je schrikt niet van epilepsie (komt nog maar zelden voor)

  • Je werkt graag samen met andere assistenten

Takenpakket van de assistent?

  • Elly-Jean begeleiden tijdens zijn dag

  • Samen wandelen, fietsen of zwemmen onder toezicht

  • Boodschappen doen en samen de boodschappen uitladen

  • Creatieve en afwisselende activiteiten bedenken

  • Elly-Jean betrekken bij kleine huishoudelijke taken

  • Structuur en duidelijkheid brengen

  • Goed observeren hoe Elly-Jean zich voelt

  • Zacht grenzen stellen wanneer dat nodig is

  • Elly-Jean helpen om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken en bij te leren

jobs.title: Relationsskapande behandlingspedagog/socialpedagog
jobs.employer: AB Livskraft Personlig Utveckling - Kikkie Krohn
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och bygga något från grunden – och samtidigt bidra till att fler människor får rätt stöd?

Trygg & Skarp är en verksamhet under utveckling med en enkel men stark övertygelse:

Vi tror att människor växer när de blir sedda, lyssnade på och bemötta med respekt.

Trygga möten skapar hållbar framtid.

Nu bygger vi ett mindre nätverk av erfarna behandlingspedagoger och socialpedagoger som vill arbeta självständigt i kommande uppdrag – och som också tycker om att skapa kontakter, bygga relationer och öppna dörrar till nya samarbeten.

Om tjänsten

Det här är en tjänst för dig som trivs både i mötet med människor och i kontakten med verksamheter.

Du kan komma att arbeta direkt med ungdomar och vuxna i våra uppdrag, men också bidra till att Trygg & Skarp växer genom att skapa relationer med exempelvis kommuner, socialtjänst, HVB och andra verksamheter inom det sociala området.

Vi söker alltså inte någon som arbetar med traditionell försäljning.

För oss handlar nya uppdrag om att lyssna, förstå behov och bygga förtroende över tid.

Du behöver därför känna dig bekväm med att ta kontakt med nya verksamheter, presentera hur vi arbetar och föra samtal om vilka behov som finns.

Våra uppdrag

Trygg & Skarp erbjuder stöd i processer där det finns behov av kontinuitet, struktur, samordning och trygg uppföljning.

Kommande uppdrag kan exempelvis handla om individuellt stöd till ungdomar och vuxna.

I mer komplexa ärenden kan arbetet även innebära samordning och uppföljning när flera aktörer finns runt individen, exempelvis:

    socialtjänst
    HVB
    familj
    skola
    vård
    andra stödinsatser.

Arbetet kan bland annat innehålla:

    regelbundna individuella kontakter
    relationsskapande stöd
    motivations- och förändringsarbete
    stöd kring struktur och fungerande vardag
    arbete mot tydliga mål
    kartläggning och uppföljning
    samordning med relevanta aktörer
    dokumentation och återkoppling
    stöd inför, under och efter övergångar mellan olika insatser.

Uppdragets innehåll och omfattning bestäms alltid utifrån det enskilda uppdraget.

En del av tjänsten kan också vara att utveckla nya samarbeten.

Trygg & Skarp befinner sig i uppbyggnadsfas och vi vill gärna samarbeta med personer som tycker att det är spännande att vara med från början.

Det kan därför även ingå att:

    skapa nya kontakter med kommuner och verksamheter
    följa upp befintliga kontakter
    lyssna in vilka behov verksamheter har
    presentera Trygg & Skarps arbetssätt och tjänster
    delta i möten med potentiella uppdragsgivare
    bidra med idéer kring hur våra tjänster kan utvecklas
    bygga långsiktiga professionella relationer.

Du behöver alltså inte se dig själv som en person som ”säljer”.

Däremot behöver du våga ta kontakt, ställa frågor och berätta om något du tror på.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt dig som har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, exempelvis behandlingspedagog, socialpedagog eller annan relevant utbildning inom socialt arbete.

Erfarenhet från exempelvis HVB, öppenvård, ungdomsarbete, vuxenstöd, familjearbete, NPF, beroendeproblematik eller andra komplexa sociala situationer är meriterande.

För oss är hur du möter människor minst lika viktigt som vad som står på ditt CV.

Vi tror att du:

    skapar relation utan att förlora din professionella roll
    kan sätta tydliga gränser med respekt
    behåller lugn och professionalitet när relationen utmanas
    är nyfiken på människan bakom beteendet
    arbetar strukturerat och målinriktat
    dokumenterar och följer upp ditt arbete
    samverkar professionellt med andra aktörer
    håller överenskommelser
    vågar reflektera över ditt eget bemötande
    tycker om att skapa nya kontakter
    vågar ringa, skriva och öppna nya dörrar
    lyssnar innan du föreslår lösningar
    och vill vara med och utveckla något långsiktigt.

Vi utvecklar ett gemensamt arbetssätt för alla som arbetar under Trygg & Skarps namn.

Några av våra grundprinciper är:

SE – LYSSNA – FÖRSTÅ – TYDLIGGÖR – STÄRK – FÖLJ UPP

och genom hela arbetet:

REFLEKTERA.

Vi brukar uttrycka det så här:

Trygg är inte samma sak som kravlös.

Skarp är inte samma sak som hård.

Vi tror på ett professionellt socialt arbete där relation och struktur går hand i hand.

Du kommer in tidigt vilket innebär att Trygg & Skarp inte är en färdig organisation där allt redan är bestämt.

Det ser vi som en möjlighet.

Rätt personer får vara med och forma hur vi arbetar, hur våra uppdrag genomförs och hur vi bygger relationer med framtida uppdragsgivare.

Vi söker hellre några få riktigt bra samordnare/utförare än ett stort register av timanställda.

Uppdrag kan variera i omfattning och geografiskt område. Eftersom du är behovsanställd så avgör du själv vilka presenterade uppdrag du har möjlighet och kompetens att åta dig.

Villkor, ersättning, uppdragets omfattning och ansvar tydliggörs alltid innan ett uppdrag påbörjas.

Om du även bidrar till att skapa nya uppdrag och samarbeten kan ersättningsmodellen anpassas efter det ansvar du tar.

Viktigt att veta

Trygg & Skarp befinner sig i uppbyggnadsfas.

Den här förfrågan innebär därför inte att ett specifikt klientuppdrag kan garanteras direkt.

Vi bygger nu vår första grupp av kvalificerade samordnare/utförare för att kunna matcha rätt kompetens när uppdrag kommer in – och för att tillsammans skapa förutsättningar för nya uppdrag.

Intresserad?

Skicka gärna en kort presentation och berätta:

    vem du är och din utbildningsbakgrund
    vilka målgrupper du har erfarenhet av
    var i Sverige du kan ta uppdrag
    vilken omfattning som kan vara aktuell
    om du tycker om att skapa nya professionella kontakter
    och varför Trygg & Skarps sätt att arbeta väcker ditt intresse.

Vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och hur du arbetar än av ett perfekt formulerat personligt brev.

Vi kommer också gärna att prata med dig om en fråga som är viktig för oss:

Vad betyder ett tryggt bemötande för dig när personen framför dig inte gör det lätt att vara trygg tillbaka?

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Trygg & Skarp

En verksamhet inom AB Livskraft Personlig Utveckling

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

  • Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

  • Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

  • Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

  • Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

  • VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

  • Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

  • Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

  • Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

  • Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

  • Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

  • Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

  • Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

  • Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a video team in place, and a team of interns to grow. The brand is yours to build and yours to run.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. 


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

Wat je doet

  • Portefeuille laten groeien: je beheert een rendabele portefeuille en bouwt ze verder uit via advies, vertrouwen en proactieve opvolging.
  • Advies op maat: je plant gesprekken, analyseert situaties en biedt oplossingen die passen bij de ambities van je cliënten.
  • Netwerk versterken: je bent zichtbaar in de regio en trekt nieuwe klanten aan via prospectie en lokale contacten.
  • Samenwerken met experts: je werkt nauw samen met je branch lead, commercieel assistent en collega‑bankers.

Waarom jij graag zal werken bij Nagelmackers?

Nagelmackers is sinds 1747 een vertrouwde private bank, gebouwd op nabijheid en persoonlijk advies. Sinds 2025 maken we deel uit van CENORBANK Group, waardoor we onze lokale verankering combineren met internationale expertise en nieuwe ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.
Je komt terecht in een warme, professionele omgeving waar menselijkheid, ondernemerschap en diversiteit centraal staan en waar jij écht impact kan maken.

Klaar om je expertise in te zetten in een brede regio met veel groeipotentieel? We maken graag kennis met je.

Nagelmackers werft in eerste instantie rechtstreeks aan en schakelt enkel externe partners in wanneer dit nodig blijkt. We waarderen de belangrijke rol die selectiekantoren spelen in de arbeidsmarkt, maar spontane voorstellen worden niet behandeld. Alvast bedankt voor jullie begrip.

Nagelmackers recrute en priorité en direct et ne fait appel à des partenaires externes que lorsque cela s'avère nécessaire. Nous reconnaissons le rôle important que jouent les agences de recrutement sur le marché du travail, mais les candidatures spontanées ne seront pas prises en compte. Nous vous remercions d'avance de votre compréhension.

 

Wie jij bent

  • Je hebt een bachelor of gelijkwaardige ervaring.
  • Je hebt ervaring in de financiële sector of kennis van beleggingen en basiskennis kredieten.
  • Je bent sterk verankerd in de regio en bouwt graag aan je netwerk.
  • Je bent empathisch, integer en sterk in luisteren.
  • Je communiceert vlot en bent tweetalig NL/FR.

Ook als je vandaag Retail Banker, Relatiebeheerder of Commercieel Adviseur bent, ben je welkom. We begeleiden je in je groei naar een rol met meer autonomie, advies en impact.

jobs.title: Logopedist(e) op zelfstandige basis
jobs.description:
Curamens is een jonge, groeiende groepspraktijk in Tessenderlo waar warme en kwaliteitsvolle zorg centraal staat. We begeleiden kinderen, jongeren en volwassenen die ergens in vastlopen en ondersteunen hen om opnieuw verder te kunnen.

Door onze groei willen we ons aanbod graag uitbreiden met logopedie. Daarom zoeken we een enthousiaste logopedist(e) die ons team wil versterken en binnen onze praktijk een eigen logopedische werking wil uitbouwen.

Wil jij graag meebouwen aan onze praktijk en deel uitmaken van ons team? Neem dan snel contact met ons op! We kijken er alvast naar uit om je te ontmoeten.

Naar wie zijn we op zoek?

· Je beschikt over een bachelor of master in de logopedie en de nodige erkenning om als logopedist(e) aan de slag te gaan

· Je bent bereid om als zelfstandige in bijberoep of hoofdberoep te werken

· Je kan zelfstandig werken, maar vindt het ook fijn om deel uit te maken van een multidisciplinair team

· Je kan zelfstandig werken en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen cliënttrajecten

· Je staat open voor overleg en samenwerking binnen een multidisciplinair team

· Je vindt het fijn om je kennis en expertise verder te ontwikkelen

· Je denkt graag mee en staat ervoor open om de logopedische werking binnen Curamens mee uit te bouwen

· Je kan bij voorkeur minstens 1 dag per week voorzien (minder is bespreekbaar)

Wat zijn onze verwachtingen?

· Je stelt een behandelplan op, verduidelijkt de hulpvraag en voert de logopedische begeleiding uit van intake tot afronding

· Je werkt samen met verwijzers en eventueel andere zorgpartners indien dit aangewezen is

· Je volgt de evolutie van je cliënten op en stuurt de behandeling bij waar nodig

· Je staat in voor de nodige verslaggeving en administratieve opvolging

· Je betrekt ouders of de context bij de begeleiding wanneer dit aangewezen is

· Je stemt waar nodig af met scholen, verwijzers en andere betrokken zorgverleners

· Je draagt vanuit je eigen expertise bij aan de multidisciplinaire werking van de praktijk en bent bereid om deel te nemen aan maandelijkse vergadermomenten

Wat kan je verwachten?

· Werken in een jonge praktijk met veel ruimte voor inspraak en eigen ideeën

· De mogelijkheid om de logopedische werking binnen Curamens mee uit te bouwen

· Een rustige, aangename werkomgeving met een uitstekende bereikbaarheid (op 4 minuten van de autosnelweg)

· Een ingerichte praktijkruimte en wachtruimte waarin je cliënten kan ontvangen

· Groepsruimte beschikbaar voor groepssessies, workshops of opleidingen

· Mogelijkheid tot samenwerking met andere disciplines binnen de praktijk

· Flexibiliteit in agenda en uren (bij voorkeur 1 dag/week maar minder is bespreekbaar)

· Mogelijkheid tot overleg en ondersteuning waar mogelijk

· Goede voorzieningen: wachtruimte, keuken, koelkast en ruime parking buiten

· Deel uitmaken van een tof team

Hoe reageren?

Stuur je CV met motivatiebrief naar info@curamens.be en dan nemen we zo snel mogelijk cont act met je op. Twijfel niet om contact op te nemen indien je nog vragen zou hebben.

We kijken er alvast naar uit om je te ontmoeten!

jobs.title: Assistent Winkelverantwoordelijke Menen

jobs.title: Ervaren Grondwerker/kraanmachinist - omgevingsaanleg
jobs.description:

Un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire à Rogliano, en Italie, cherche son nouvel orthophoniste H/F pour un CDI.

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages
- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site
- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Le petit truc en plus
Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

jobs.title: Odlings- och produktionsledare på The Culinary Farm
jobs.description:
Market Garden Production Manager

Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.

About us

Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden

We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.

The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.

Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture.

The role

As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.

You will:

Plan weekly and daily production priorities.

Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.

Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.

Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.

Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.

Keep essential production and harvest records.

Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.

How you work matters

We are looking for someone who:

Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.

Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.

Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.

Communicates clearly and leads by example.

Is self-motivated and also motivates others.

Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills

Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.

Experience

You should have:

At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.

Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.

Good communication skills in English.

A valid driving licence.

The legal right to work and live in Sweden.

Relevant horticultural or agricultural education is an advantage, but not required. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer

The opportunity to lead in an established and ambitious market garden.

Work in an international team of young, passionate and driven change-makers

A role within our wider educational work around Market Gardening and human-scale food production in the Nordics.

A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan

We work hard and maintain high standards, but we also want the farm to be a place where people enjoy working, learning and developing together.

Practical details

Position: Market Garden Production Manager

Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden

E

mployment:

Full-time seasonal position

Season: March–November 2027

Working hours: 08:00–17:00, including a one-hour lunch break Start: March 2027

Salary: To be negotiated based on experience

Application Process

Apply via our form: https://tmxggetk6he.typeform.com/to/tiflhp1H

Applications are open to candidates across Europe.

Complete our online application form by October 15, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview, followed by a practical recruitment day on the farm for finalists.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Contractor
Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Specialist – IT Category

Indirect Procurement Specialist – IT Category

We are looking for an experienced Indirect Procurement Specialist within the IT Category for a strategic transformation assignment in Stockholm. This is an opportunity for a procurement professional who combines strong commercial expertise with an understanding of IT sourcing, supplier markets and complex transformation programmes.

You will play a key role in driving sourcing activities, securing critical project timelines and preparing the future organisation for successful supplier mobilisation and delivery.

🚀 About the Assignment

As an Indirect Procurement Specialist, you will independently manage procurement activities for goods and services and work closely with stakeholders across business, IT, architecture, security and transformation.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Managing procurements, supplier follow-ups and supplier evaluations.

    

Advising internal stakeholders on contracts, procurement processes, direct procurements and framework agreement call-offs.

    

Conducting IT category and supplier-market scans.

    

Translating business, IT, architecture, security and transition requirements into sourcing strategies, supplier criteria and procurement plans.

Developing commercial models, evaluation criteria and scoring structures.

    

Supporting supplier evaluation, shortlisting and clarification meetings.

    

Leading or supporting negotiations and developing commercial recommendations.

A relevant university or college degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, IT, or equivalent professional experience.

    

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

    

The ability to constructively challenge and align commercial, technical and business perspectives.

    

Strong analytical and structuring skills, with attention to detail.

    

The ability to ensure transparency and auditability in procurement decisions.

    

A pragmatic and delivery-oriented approach, balancing procurement quality, governance and compliance with programme deadlines.

    

The ability to prioritise, create structure and maintain momentum in fast-changing environments with multiple dependencies and incomplete information.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Vehicle Systems
jobs.description:
At Koenigsegg, our R&D team brings together highly talented individuals with a shared passion for engineering the best vehicles in the world. We work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation and technical expertise drive our development.

We are looking for someone who is ready to challenge conventional thinking, contribute with their expertise, and thrive in our non-conventional Lean Development philosophy.

You will work alongside world-renowned engineers on some of the most exciting automotive programs in the world, with the opportunity to create, innovate, and help shape the future of hypercars.

Responsibilities

As a Mechanical Design Engineer within the Vehicle Systems team, you will be responsible for the design and development of robust, reliable, and high-performance automotive systems. The role covers development from concept to production and requires close collaboration with Product, Powertrain, Optical and Electrical Design, as well as CAE, Prototype, and Homologation departments.

You will:

    Design and develop mechanical and electrical automotive systems, including cooling, HVAC, electrical boxes, hydraulics, fuel systems, wiper systems, and packaging
    Generate 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE
    Organize and carry out tests to verify component function and ensure requirements are met
    Provide technical support for the successful introduction of components and systems into production
    Support the release of products into production through PLM
    Collaborate with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality, performance, and delivery requirements are met
    Ensure that products comply with relevant regulations and requirements
    Estimate cost and time scopes for components and systems

Requirements:

    MSc/BSc in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Automotive, or a related field
    5+ years of experience in vehicle system design
    5+ years of experience with CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE
    Strong mechanical engineering skills, including design, manufacturing limitations, mechanical linkages, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
    Experience with technologies used in automotive electrical and hydraulic systems
    Experience with PLM systems
    Working knowledge of DFMEA and GD&T
    Understanding of prototyping, manufacturing, and production technologies
    Professional level of English

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to receiving your application!

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 500 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

jobs.title: Piping Foreman
jobs.description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Foremans. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Foreman is responsible for supervising and directing piping installation, assembly, and maintenance activities on site. The role involves managing a team of piping fitters, coordinating daily work assignments, and ensuring that piping systems are installed according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Foreman ensures efficient workflow, proper resource utilization, and timely completion of project tasks.

Key Responsibilities

· Supervise and coordinate daily activities of piping crews, including piping fitters, helpers, and support personnel.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, piping isometric drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

About the role

As a valued member of our IT Helpdesk team consisting currently of 5 colleagues, you will play a central role in ensuring smooth and effective IT Support at ESS. Your primary responsibilities will include resolving incidents and service requests, either registered in our ticket system or reported directly by users visiting the IT Helpdesk. Collaborating closely with your colleagues you will tackle a variety of tasks such as installations, installations and maintenance of laptops and workstations, support of equipment, systems and applications.

To thrive as an IT Support technician at ESS, you bring a natural flair for service and enjoy delivering quality and long-term solutions. You are equally comfortable working independently or as part of a team, and you appreciate and understand the importance of structured processes and thorough documentation. You value the opportunity to learn new things and enjoy working in a fast-paced organisation. Your responsiveness to user inquiries and enthusiasm for interacting with people will be key to your success in this role.

This is a full-time permanent position with a 6 months' probationary period based at the ESS Campus in Lund, Sweden.

Day-to-day, you will:

    Diagnose and resolve computer hardware and software problems

    Troubleshoot user account, password, permissions and accesses
    Troubleshoot basic network-related problems
    Troubleshoot basic issues with meeting rooms equipment and connections
    Troubleshoot printers and connection issues
    Handle IT assets, equipment inventories and lifecycle management
    Collaborate with your team and other functions to solve issues

About you:

    Experience providing IT Support to users in a larger company
    Practical experience with installations, configurations, diagnosing and resolving issues with Windows- and macOS based laptops and workstations, peripherals and connectivity issues. Practical experience with Linux is an advantage
    Experience in advanced hardware troubleshooting of laptops and workstations
    Experience supporting specialized workstations like scientific workstations is an advantage
    Strong knowledge in Mac OS, Windows, iOS and preferably Linux distributions as an administrator or power user
    Experience with meeting room support and troubleshooting (Crestron- and Poly control systems)

jobs.title: Stödassistent som timvikarie, Villa stinsens gruppbostad, Danderyds kommun
jobs.description:
På Villa Stinsens gruppbostad bor 6 personer med olika funktionshinder. Behovet av stöd och omsorgsinsatser är stort och finns dygnet runt. Arbetet styrs av den boendes behov, önskemål och förutsättningar att klara av dagliga aktiviteter.

Vi arbetar med genomförandeplaner och riskbedömningar och vi fokuserar på att individanpassa stödet för boende, skapa delaktighet och arbeta målinriktat utifrån boendes önskemål och behov. En förutsättning för att kunna säkerställa goda levnadsvillkor är att ha god kännedom om de boende. Inom verksamheten är det av vikt att ha kompetens kring människor i behov av särskilt stöd och service samt funktionedsättningar.

Vill du göra skillnad och har en stark vilja att hjälpa andra? Vi söker dig som gärna gör det lilla extra för brukarna och som trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Välkommen till vår gemenskap!

2 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
När du arbetar som stödassistent hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag som ska hjälpa och stödja brukarna på Villa stinsen att trivas och utvecklas genom att ge ett individuellt stöd och engagemang i deras dagliga liv.

Dina arbetsuppgifter som stödassistent består bland annat av att ansvara för att rutiner följs samt ge stöd och handleda arbetstagarna i det dagliga arbetet både i verksamheten och även ute på våra externa arbetsplatser. Vi arbetar aktivt för en meningsfull fritid så att delta i brukarnas fritidsaktiviteter ingår i arbetsuppgifterna. Som stödassistent följer du våra gemensamma mål och genomförandeplaner och dokumenterar i våra system. I ditt arbete ingår samverkan med ledning, arbetsplatser, övriga medarbetare, boende, hälso- och sjukvårdspersonal och andra för personen viktiga kontakter.

Som stödassistent hos oss består dina arbetsuppgifter av att bygga en förtroendefull relation med de boende, och med respekt för deras rätt till självbestämmande och integritet, stödja dem i de områden av deras liv som de har svårt att klara av själva.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har:

    • Aktuell erfarenhet av arbete på gruppboende inom LSS.
    • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
    • Relevant utbildning t.ex. stödassistent eller undersköterska, eller annan utbildning arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
    • Erfarenhet av arbete med personer med funktionsnedsättning och autism och/eller erfarenhet av arbete på gruppbostad LSS.

Det är meriterande om du har genomfört specialpedagogik 1 &; 2.

Vi söker dig som är samarbetsorienterad, prestigelös och lösningsfokuserad, med en stark förmåga att bygga och vårda relationer. Du visar ett stort engagemang för både arbetstagarna och verksamheten, har mycket god samarbetsförmåga och kan arbeta självständigt när det behövs. Du tar eget ansvar, är säker och stabil i utmanande situationer, och sprider trygghet omkring dig. Med mod och professionalism uttrycker du din åsikt, även när den skiljer sig från andras, samtidigt som du alltid ser till hela verksamhetens bästa och är flexibel men tydlig i ditt bemötande och förhållningssätt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och förmågan att samarbeta.

För denna tjänst behöver du uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret (Arbete i hemmet med äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning) innan anställningsavtal kan upprättas. Beställning av ett sådant kan göras på www.polisen.se. Vi rekommenderar att du beställer digitalt registerutdrag som skickas till din digitala brevlåda.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 27 september. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

Genom närhet och korta beslutsvägar får du möjlighet att ta ansvar och jobba med både delar och helhet i ditt yrke. Här växer vi tillsammans med engagerade invånare, företag och kompetenta kollegor i trädgårdsstadens vackra miljö. Ta steget till ett utvecklande och hållbart arbetsliv i en lagom stor kommun nära allt.

Besök gärna https://www.danderyd.se/ovriga-verksamheter/jobba/ för att ta del av mer information om kommunens uppdrag och utvecklingen framåt. Där hittar du också information om bland annat våra förmåner och vår rekryteringsprocess.
