Här på EY får du chansen att skapa en exceptionell upplevelse. Vi erbjuder dig den senaste teknologin, omger dig med högpresterande team och tillhandahåller den globala räckvidd samt den mångsidiga och inkluderande kultur som krävs för att du ska kunna upptäcka din fulla potential. Genom våra coachnings- och utbildningsprogram kommer du att utveckla de färdigheter som behövs för att förbli relevant både idag och i framtiden, samtidigt som du bygger ett nätverk av kollegor, mentorer och ledare som kommer att stödja dig på din resa, både inom EY och utanför.





Möjligheten: ditt nästa äventyr väntar på dig



Vill du arbeta med komplexa skatte- och affärsjuridiska frågor i en dynamisk och internationell miljö? Till vårt affärsområde Tax & Law söker vi nu juniora skattekonsulter och affärsjurister. Se nedan beskrivningar av de grupper som vi söker till just nu och ange i ditt personliga brev vilken grupp du är mest intresserad av. Startdatum är löpande efter överenskommelse.



    Corporate Tax (Stockholm, Göteborg): Vår allmänna företagsbeskattningsgrupp arbetar med större och mellanstora företag i skattefrågor kopplade till bland annat företagsöverlåtelser, omstruktureringar och internationella skattefrågor.
    People Advisory Services (Stockholm, Göteborg): Internationell skatterätt med fokus på individbeskattning och socialförsäkringsfrågor för företag med medarbetare som arbetar över landsgränser. Vi arbetar med frågor kopplade till bland annat tjänsteresor, utsändningar, lokalanställningar och andra internationella mobilitetslösningar.
    EY Law (Stockholm): Vår affärsjuridiska grupp arbetar med rådgivning inom ett brett spektrum av juridiska områden, bland annat bolagsrätt, arbetsrätt, bank- och finansrätt, börsrätt, fastighetsrätt och dataskydd.



Vi är även öppna för ansökningar till våra andra team inom Tax & Law: Transfer Pricing, Financial Services, Indirect Tax och Global Compliance & Reporting.





Kvalifikationer



    Akademisk examen från juristprogrammet, annat affärsrättsligt program, ekonomprogrammet eller annan relevant utbildning
    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska





Meriterande



    Erfarenhet från exempelvis domstol, revisionsbyrå, advokatbyrå eller Skatteverket





Som person är du



    Nyfiken och intresserad av att utvecklas
    Ansvarstagande, strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten
    Öppen för olika perspektiv och arbetar gärna tillsammans med andra





Vad vi erbjuder dig



    Utveckla dina tekniska färdigheter och ledarskapsförmågor genom framtidsinriktade kurser och utvecklingsprogram.
    Bredda dina perspektiv genom att arbeta i integrerade team och samarbeta med personer från olika professionella och kulturella bakgrunder.
    Investera i ditt personliga välbefinnande och din karriärutveckling.





Är du redo att ”Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Då är du varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten. Skicka in ditt CV, personliga brev och betyg senast den 30 september 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontaktar du ansvarig rekryterare på Julia.Frejd@se.ey.com.



Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.



På EY värdesätter vi mångfald och uppmuntrar ansökningar från individer från olika bakgrunder. Om du har frågor, behöver stöd eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.



EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!
jobs.description:
Går du i tankarna på att arbeta i Danmark, antingen nu eller i framtiden? Vi söker kontinuerligt duktiga specialister i allmänmedicin för kommande och långsiktiga uppdrag över hela Danmark.

Vi vet att livet består av mer än bara jobb. Därför utgår vi alltid från dina personliga önskemål. Om du har familj, vill bo på en specifik ort eller har specifika önskemål kring ditt schema, så anpassar vi vårt sökande efter dig, inte efter en fast låst list

Vill du arbeta i ett hälso- och sjukvårdssystem som värnar om din arbetsmiljö? Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

jobs.title: Fullstack Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.

We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.

We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.

About the role

In this role, you will:

    Own features from design to deploy - frontend (React/TypeScript), backend (Node/TypeScript) and database (Postgres)
    Integrate with agent and retrieval APIs to deliver seamless product experiences
    Instrument products, run A/B tests, and iterate quickly with design and PM
    Make pragmatic trade-offs and thrive in ambiguous 0→1 product spaces
    Collaborate closely with stakeholders, users and teammates to define and solve the right problems

Our tech stack:

    We build on a simple modern stack optimized for both humans and AI.
    Backend: TypeScript, Kotlin, Node.js
    Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind
    Databases: Postgres, Redis
    Cloud infra: GCP/Kubernetes/Terraform

About You

Basic Qualifications:

    Minimum 5 years' experience with frontend (React/TypeScript), backend (Node/TypeScript) and database (Postgres)
    Experience with end-to-end ownership of delivering features for customers

Other qualifications:

    Experience shipping customer-facing value quickly in small teams - owning everything from problem definition through UX, API, and instrumentation.
    Experience working end-to-end to deliver features that delight users and move the needle for our customers.

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales - Cimatron
jobs.description:
Shape the global commercial direction of Cimatron and turn market insight into profitable growth. As Vice President of Sales, you lead the worldwide sales organization, strengthen direct and reseller channels, and build the capabilities needed to succeed in technically complex markets.

Joining us means stepping into a highly visible role withing a growing global business. You help strengthen customer loyalty, drive performance, and build a high-performing global sales organization. Here, you:

    Translate market shifts, customer needs, and data into decisive action.
    Lead global teams and establish consistent sales standards, workflows, and service practices across regions.
    Contribute to an innovative, performance-driven organization focused on customer success.

About the job

You lead the entire commercial strategy and execution for the Cimatron business globally. The scope includes revenue and profitability, market coverage, sales excellence, forecasting, reseller performance, and strategic customer relationships. You lead a geographically distributed commercial organization, collaborate closely with Cimatron leadership team, and report business performance, risks and strategic recommendations to the President of Cimatron.

Job responsibilities

    Define and execute a global sales strategy aligned with business targets, growth ambitions and clear returns on investment.
    Drive revenue and margin performance across all regions, maintaining a strong pipeline, reliable forecasts and disciplined commercial governance.
    Develop market coverage, segmentation and go-to-market models across direct sales and reseller channels.
    Lead, coach and develop regional sales leaders while shaping an organization equipped for current and future market needs.
    Act as executive sponsor for key customers, strategic accounts and major opportunities, supporting selected negotiations and enterprise deals.
    Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, Operations, Finance and HR to strengthen market execution, customer value and organizational performance.

Location and flexibility

The position offers a flexible location within Europe. Travel is expected to reach approximately 25–30% over time.

Your profile

You have extensive experience in international B2B software sales and a record of growing revenue in technically complex markets. Your background includes leading multi-regional organizations and turning market intelligence, sales performance, and customer insights into focused commercial action.

Your background includes:

    A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related field; an MBA is highly preferred.
    Extensive B2B sales experience within software, manufacturing, machine tools, cutting tools or a closely related environment.
    Proven leadership of multi-regional sales teams, including experience leading other leaders.
    Strong knowledge of CAD/CAM workflows, manufacturing processes, global market dynamics and CRM-supported sales management.
    Advanced analytical, forecasting and commercial planning capabilities.
    Fluency in English is required, while German language skills are an advantage.

Previous experience as a Sales Director, Regional Vice President or in an equivalent senior position is also preferred, as is experience with CAD, CAM or PLM sales.

Strategic and forward-looking, you lead transformation with integrity, resilience, and sound judgment. You lead by example, inspire trust, develop people, and set clear expectations while remaining adaptable in a fast-moving environment. Strong executive communication and cultural intelligence help you influence effectively and bring geographically dispersed teams together around shared priorities.

The team

You lead a global commercial organization of approximately 37 employees, including regional sales leaders and teams working across direct sales, reseller management, sales support, and customer service. Collaboration across regions, cultures, and functions are essential in this position.

Our culture

At Cimatron, we believe in fostering an inclusive, equal, and open-minded culture. We value diversity and strive to create a supportive environment where every team member can thrive. We offer competitive benefits and numerous career development opportunities. Are you intrigued? Visit our website or LinkedIn to get to know us further.  

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Taline Forsberg, hiring manager, taline.forsberg@cimatron.com

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter.

Recruitment Specialist: Lisbeth Häggström

How to apply

Send your application no later than September 23, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0096576.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

Cimatron, part of Sandvik Group, was founded in 1982 and has since developed the computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM) software needed by manufacturers across industries to reach their full potential. Serving all manufacturing sectors, Cimatron provides specialized solutions for mold and die makers, as well as comprehensive solutions for 2.5-5-axis milling and turning.

jobs.title: Laboratory Sales Manager to GC Nordic
jobs.description:
GC Corporation was founded in 1921 in Japan and has developed itself into one of the most prominent companies in the development, production and distribution of a very wide range of dental products. GC Europe (Leuven, Belgium) supports and leads our different sales offices and dealers in EMEA territory. Our Nordic Team is currently looking for a

Laboratory Sales Manager, NordicPurpose of the job

As a Laboratory Sales Manager you will drive sales growth and business development for our laboratory and CAD/CAM product portfolio across the Nordic region. jobs.title: Global Ontology and Semantic Data Leader
jobs.description:
About the Role

Establish and lead a global ontology and semantic data strategy for the Digital Energy software organization. This role defines how products, systems, devices, points, relationships, behaviors, and operational concepts are represented consistently across the portfolio.



This is not a purely theoretical or governance-focused position. The successful candidate will combine deep semantic-technology expertise with the practical engineering ability to build and apply ontologies in real software products.

What You Will Do


    Establish and lead the global ontology and semantic data strategy for DE Software.
    Define a common approach to semantic modeling, entity relationships, metadata, classifications, and data tagging.
    Develop practical ontologies for buildings, energy management, automation systems, and related domains.
    Apply RDF, RDFS, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL, JSON-LD, and knowledge graphs where appropriate.
    Establish processes for ontology development, versioning, validation, extension, and governance.
    Create reusable semantic models that can be adopted across multiple products and engineering teams.
    Translate operational concepts into machine-understandable models with product architects, software teams, data teams, AI teams, and domain experts.
    Identify opportunities to use semantic models to improve interoperability, analytics, search, engineering efficiency, and AI capabilities.
    Partner with the applied AI team to provide structured domain knowledge, grounding, and contextual relationships.
    Develop reference implementations and working prototypes that demonstrate business and technical value.
    Evaluate existing industry ontologies, taxonomies, schemas, and standards before creating proprietary extensions.
    Build a global community of practice around ontology and semantic data.

What Will Help You Succeed


    Significant professional experience with ontology engineering, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, or closely related disciplines.
    Hands-on experience designing and implementing semantic models in production or product-oriented environments.
    Strong understanding of RDF, OWL, semantic relationships, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, and data classification.
    Experience with data tagging, metadata management, entity modeling, and semantic validation.
    Ability to explain what an ontology is, why it matters, and how it creates value for software products and customers.
    Strong software, data engineering, or technical architecture background.
    Demonstrated ability to influence multiple product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
    Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications


    Experience in smart buildings, building management systems, industrial automation, energy management, IoT, or digital twins.
    Experience with Brick Schema, Project Haystack, RealEstateCore, SAREF, BOT, or other relevant industry models.
    Experience integrating semantic models with operational databases, event systems, APIs, analytics platforms, or AI applications.
    Experience applying knowledge graphs or ontologies to retrieval-augmented generation, AI grounding, reasoning, or agent-based systems.
    Experience leading an enterprise-wide semantic architecture or ontology program.
    Familiarity with graph databases and semantic stores.

Leadership Profile


    Highly articulate and able to create clarity from complex concepts.
    Pragmatic rather than dogmatic.
    Comfortable defining a long-term strategy while delivering near-term results.
    A recognized expert who continues to work directly with technology.
    Collaborative across product, architecture, engineering, and business teams.
    Capable of becoming the trusted global authority for ontology within DE Software.

What Success Looks Like


    Publish and align a DE Software ontology strategy.
    Deliver an initial shared semantic model for a priority domain.
    Create an ontology governance and versioning process.
    Achieve adoption by one or more product or platform teams.
    Demonstrate measurable value through an AI, interoperability, engineering, or analytics use case.
    Establish a global ontology community of practice.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
​Senior Software Developer - Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U)

Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About the role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location: Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages — spanning millions of connected devices — is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. You enjoy working in an environment with a long-term technical vision but shifting short-term priorities, and you communicate clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders. You take pride in code quality, system reliability, and helping the team improve its ways of working.

Required:

    Several years of hands-on experience as a backend software developer, ideally in a microservice/distributed systems environment
    Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
    Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
    Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Also, great if you have:

    Experience with message-driven architecture (e.g. RabbitMQ)
    Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL)
    Frontend experience (React/JavaScript) is a plus, though not the core focus of the role
    Familiarity with device lifecycle management, IoT connectivity, or hardware/software integration
    Experience working in an environment with external hardware/manufacturing partners
    AWS experience

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!

If you have questions regarding this position, please reach out to our Group Senior TA Specialist, Robert Jonasson, at robert.jonasson@verisure.com

Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

jobs.title: Boat Builder
jobs.description:
Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team?

Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels. Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation – the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not only operating in Stockholm, but is now attracting orders from around the world.

Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, reducing energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels.

And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel-free lakes and oceans.

You can now be part of the amazing team at Candela! We are looking for Boat Builders to support Candela’s future growth ambitions.

About the role

As a Boat Builder, you will play an important hands-on role in building our electric boats. We have opportunities in two different areas of production: Assembly and Composite.

Depending on your experience and profile, you may join one of these teams:

Assembly

In the Assembly area, you will help build and install the interior of our boats. Your work will mainly involve composite parts, including measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling components according to drawings and instructions.

Composite

In the Composite area, located at the beginning of the production process, you will work with carbon fiber and other composite materials. You will prepare and mix materials and ensure they are properly prepared and placed for the molding process.

Across both areas, you will work with a variety of hand tools and power tools, and be responsible for using and maintaining them safely and efficiently. Precision, attention to detail and a strong focus on quality are essential, as your work contributes directly to the quality and performance of our vessels.

Your core responsibilities will include:

    Working hands-on with the production and assembly of our electric boats
    Measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling composite components
    Working with carbon fiber and other composite materials
    Preparing and mixing composite materials for the molding process
    Assembling components according to technical drawings, instructions and specifications
    Using hand tools and power tools safely and efficiently
    Performing adjustments and ensuring proper fit, alignment and finish
    Inspecting your work to ensure it meets quality standards and specifications
    Maintaining tools, equipment and a clean and organized work environment
    Documenting work according to company procedures
    Following safety rules and using provided personal protective equipment (PPE)
    Working in an international environment – our corporate language is English, including in production

What are we looking for?

You are a practical, detail-oriented and hands-on person who enjoys building high-quality products. You have experience working with tools and are comfortable working in a production or workshop environment.

You take pride in your work and understand the importance of precision, quality and following instructions. You are eager to learn, adaptable and enjoy working as part of a collaborative and diverse team.

Experience with composite materials is valuable, but we are also interested in candidates with a strong practical background and the right mindset who are motivated to learn.

Requirements:

    Ability to communicate in English in your daily work
    Experience working safely with hand tools and power tools
    Ability to read and work according to technical drawings and instructions
    Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality
    Good physical condition and ability to work hands-on, including standing for extended periods and working in tight spaces
    Willingness to work in a production environment and follow safety procedures

Meritorious (nice to have):

    Experience from assembly or production work
    Experience working with composite materials, carbon fiber or similar materials
    Experience from the marine, automotive or other manufacturing industries
    Experience with mechanical assembly or installation
    Experience working with technical drawings
    Experience from a workshop or manufacturing environment

Form of employment: Full-time with initial 6-month probation period

Start date: ASAP

Location/base: Rotebro

Team: Assembly or Composite

Reporting to: Production Area Manager

Why people love working at Candela

At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels – we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges and seeing the results in action – sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers!

We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness. That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun – whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes or cheering each other on during Candela Months, our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events.

We’re office-first but not office-only. We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person – but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated and the ride is just as important as the destination.

Recruitment process

We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well.

Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR, so please use our career website for your application.

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
    Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
    Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
    Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
    Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
    Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

    6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
    Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
    Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
    Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
    Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
    Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
    Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
    Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
    Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

    CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
    CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
    Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
    Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Hej Software Engineer,

Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA?

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, open new doors, learn from mistakes, and grow together. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people.

We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a skilled and curious Software Engineer to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Our digital products help make sure that IKEA products meet requirements, are compliant in our markets across the world, and can move safely and efficiently through a global value chain.  

We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden and looking for someone who enjoys building digital solutions with close collaboration across teams, cultures, and locations.



Your new job

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is a curious problem solver and learner. In Core Business Range, you will help bring digital products closer to the heart of the IKEA business, building solutions that support product development, manufacturing and supplier flows.

You will join a cross-functional team creating and maintaining backend services, APIs, integrations, web applications and large databases that support critical business processes across IKEA. While the role includes contributing across the full stack, the primary focus is on backend development, system integrations, and reliable software delivery. You will be empowered to experiment, learn, and continuously improve our engineering practices. Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers.



What we’d like you to bring to the table

    3+ years of experience building software solutions, with a strong foundation in backend but curiosity to grow across the full stack
    Strong experience with backend development using .NET/C#, REST APIs, and relational DBs
    Experience with frontend development using React, TypeScript, Jest or similar  
    Experience or interest in cloud development, preferably Azure, GCP, or AWS
    Comfortable with CI/CD, DevOps practices, GitHub, and test automation
    An agile mindset and experience working in cross-functional product teams
    Clear and honest communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, cultures, and locations
    A deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this



Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.



We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 20th of September. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses.  

This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  

Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Vera Bendz; vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE POSITION AND THE COMPANY

With a wide range of products for the entire family, Biltema is a strong brand with more than 160 stores across the Nordic region and plans for further expansion. The success and vision are based on a simple concept that has been refined over the years; To make it economically easier for people to have cars, boats, homes, tools, and leisure articles of high quality, thereby creating a richer leisure time for these people. They choose their own path and have therefore decided to invest in their own operations and development of systems and technical solutions, among other things. Biltema Nordic Services is a service company within Biltema with various departments that together deliver a complete solution for the department stores' assortment and operations. The IT department in Helsingborg provides systems and digital solutions in collaboration with Biltema's other companies within the group for our Nordic markets.

You will be part of a large team of colleagues who, together with the entire IT department, develop, manage, and support both proprietary products and systems, as well as well-known systems from market-leading suppliers. Together with your colleagues, the mission is to develop, integrate, and automate Biltema's over 150 digital platforms and systems.

YOU ARE OFFERED

    

To work for a company with healthy values and play an important role in the future development of Biltema's systems.

    

Work in an organization with clear leadership and a clear and long-term vision.

    

The opportunity to work at a well-managed and very prosperous company that values entrepreneurship and simplicity.

EXAMPLES OF WORK TASKS

    

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and integrations using NServiceBus, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and .NET technologies.

    

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

    

Utilize SQL Server databases effectively, ensuring optimal performance and reliability in application usage.

    

Develop and deploy applications on the Azure Cloud platform.

    

Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code in C#.

    

Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to backend systems and integrations.

    

Ensure best practices in software development, including code reviews, testing, and documentation.

    

Stay updated with the latest industry technologies to continuously improve systems.

    

Guide junior and mid-range developers and share knowledge and best practices.

EXPERIENCE

    

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

    

Minimum of 5 years of experience in backend development and system integrations.

    

Proficiency in NServiceBus and .NET framework.

    

Strong experience with SQL Server.

    

Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud services.

    

Excellent programming skills in C#.

    

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

    

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Start: By agreement

Working hours: Standard office hours with the possibility for hybrid work.

Location: Helsingborg

Type of employment: This assignment is a recruitment, and the employment will be directly with our client. Salary, terms, and conditions are discussed separately.

The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Therefore, Biltema Nordic Services requests that all inquiries regarding the position be directed to A-Hub.

jobs.title: Barcelona Tvsäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Global FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Your New Role

We are looking for an experienced Global FP&A Manager to join an international organization on a six-month fixed-term interim assignment.

Reporting directly to the Group FP&A Director, you will take ownership of the global FP&A cycle across multiple entities and regions during an important transition period.

As Global FP&A Manager, you will own the consolidated global P&L and play a key role in supporting senior leadership with accurate, insightful and actionable financial information.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Owning the global FP&A cycle across entities and regions

    

Managing monthly actuals versus budget, forecast and prior year, including driver-based variance analysis and commentary

    

Running the full forecast cycle from templates and submission calendars through regional follow-up, consolidation and executive review

    

Preparing monthly management reporting packs as well as materials for the Board and Executive Committee

    

Providing ad-hoc financial analysis, including business cases, scenario modelling and cost-base reviews

    

Working closely with regional finance leads and functional leaders, challenging assumptions and submissions rather than simply consolidating information

    

Driving greater consistency and efficiency across the FP&A organisation

    

Standardising templates, documenting definitions and mapping logic, and improving reporting processes

    

Automating at least one manual process during the assignment

    

Ensuring a structured and well-documented handover to the permanent post-holder or Group Controlling during the final weeks

Success in the role will be measured by your ability to deliver FP&A cycles according to schedule, provide high-quality reporting without rework, maintain forecast accuracy within agreed tolerances and leave behind a clear and robust handover.

Company Presentation

Our client is an international, technology-driven industrial company specialising in the development and production of advanced powertrain solutions for the global automotive market. With cutting-edge engineering and state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities across two continents, they are pushing the boundaries of sustainable mobility and shaping the future of transportation. Joining this organisation means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where technical excellence, innovation, and long-term responsibility guide every step.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Working model: Hybrid Start date: Immediately End date: 2027-04-15, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

    

3–5+ years of experience within finance, including at least 4 years in FP&A at group or multi-region level

    

Proven experience owning a full budget or forecast cycle from start to finish

    

Strong experience of multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation

    

Expert-level financial modelling skills in Excel

    

Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning tool such as Anaplan, OneStream, SAP BPC or Board

    

Strong working knowledge of an enterprise ERP environment, such as SAP or Oracle

    

Solid knowledge of IFRS, with the ability to reconcile management and statutory reporting perspectives

    

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present and defend financial results to senior executives in English

    

Meritorious: Experience from manufacturing, industrial or automotive environments

    

Meritorious: Experience from a joint venture, carve-out or newly established organization where processes are still developing

    

Meritorious: Familiarity with SQL or Power BI

    

Meritorious: Fluency in Mandarin Chinese

What we Offer

    

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

jobs.title: Commercial Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a broad and business-close legal role supporting a European business unit in a complex commercial environment. The work spans commercial structuring, competition law, strategic collaborations and selected M&A-related matters, with close interaction across marketing, operations, sourcing and business development.

This is a role for you if you enjoy working where legal advice directly influences how the business grows, prices, partners and goes to market. You will help bring clarity to both day-to-day commercial questions and more strategic decisions across multiple European jurisdictions. It is an interesting opportunity if you want a wide legal mandate and real influence close to the business.

Job Description

    You will advise the business on commercial structuring, contract negotiation and legal risk in close dialogue with key stakeholders.
    You will support matters related to competition law, trade terms and consumer protection across different European markets.
    You will work closely with sales, sourcing and operations teams on pricing models, discount schemes and trade arrangements.
    You will guide the business in questions related to product claims, strategic collaborations and route-to-market changes.
    You will contribute legal support in M&A-related activities and other commercially important initiatives.
    You will create and improve legal frameworks, ways of working and processes in areas where structure is still evolving.
    You will coach and influence senior stakeholders by turning complex legal questions into clear and practical guidance.

Requirements

    Strong track record in commercial contract negotiation, stakeholder engagement and legal advisory across operations, sales and supply chain.
    Solid ability to provide legal guidance on competition law, trade terms and consumer protection in a European business context.
    Experience of working closely with cross-functional teams such as sales, sourcing, operations, marketing or business development.
    Strong commercial awareness and a genuine interest in understanding the business beyond the legal perspective.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Background

Melt&Marble’s mission is to accelerate the transition towards more sustainable products. We harness precision fermentation to create the next generation of sustainable designer fats, tailored for applications ranging from delicious, climate-friendly foods to high-performance personal care products.

Position summary

We are looking for a hands-on Manufacturing Operations Specialist to support the commercialization and scale-up of Melt&Marble’s products.

This role combines manufacturing coordination, quality and compliance management, logistics coordination, and project management. The successful candidate will work closely with our manufacturing partners, testing laboratories, customers, and internal teams to ensure that production lots move smoothly from manufacturing through quality control, documentation, and delivery.

You will also liaise with manufacturing partners, testing laboratories, suppliers, logistics providers, customers, and internal teams to establish scalable systems as we grow from pilot production to commercial volumes.

Our ideal candidate should have experience coordinating manufacturing, quality, supply chain, or operational activities within industries such as food, ingredients, biotechnology, fermentation, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or related fields. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure, building systems, managing multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks.

The candidate should be comfortable working in the dynamic environment of a startup company, handling multiple projects simultaneously, and helping establish scalable systems.

Occasionally, some activities may require working outside of standard office hours. The position may require occasional travel within Sweden and abroad.



Main Responsibilities & Tasks

Manufacturing coordination

    Coordinate external manufacturing partners and track production from fermentation, extraction, through testing, packaging, and delivery, ensuring that materials, packaging, and labelling are ready in time for production.
    Manage production-related supply dependencies: purchase/delivery timelines, lead times, backorders, and shipment readiness.
    Coordinate logistics across partners/facilities: shipments, dispatch, tracking, and delivery coordination to customers.
    Identify supply risks (material shortages, delayed packaging, logistics constraints, dependency bottlenecks) and proactively escalate with mitigation actions.



Quality, Traceability & Compliance  

    Ensure complete, organized quality and compliance documentation for each production lot.
    Coordinate quality control and external testing activities, including specifications, Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), batch records, traceability, batch release documentation, etc.
    Maintain traceability linking materials to batch records, test results, CoAs, etc.
    Coordinate and validate supplier documentation required for compliance (e.g., incoming quality documentation, supplier qualification support).
    Support continuous improvement of quality documentation workflows to reduce errors, delays, and nonconformities.

  

Operational Systems & Cross-Functional Coordination

    Identify and implement improvements to manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and product flow processes.
    Help establish scalable operational systems (documentation structure, release checklists, partner SOP alignment, inventory/document tracking support).
    Coordinate cross-functional projects by tracking timelines, deliverables, and follow-up actions across internal teams.

Required qualifications

    BSc, MSc, or PhD in biotechnology, food science, chemistry, chemical engineering, supply chain, operations, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality, supply chain, logistics, technical operations, or a related role within food, ingredients, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, personal care, or another regulated manufacturing industry.
    Solid understanding of quality systems, traceability, and compliance requirements in a manufacturing environment (e.g. GMP, HACCP, ISO-based quality systems, supplier qualification, batch documentation, or related frameworks).
    Hands-on experience maintaining or coordinating quality and compliance documentation such as batch records, specifications, CoAs, supplier documentation, testing records, and traceability systems.  
    Experience coordinating activities involving multiple external partners, suppliers, laboratories, or manufacturers.
    Understanding of manufacturing processes in biotechnology, food ingredients, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or related industries.
    Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
    Good written and oral communication skills in English.
    Proactive, flexible, and hands-on, with the ability to work independently and thrive in a startup environment.

Bonus points

    Hands-on experience with contract manufacturing partners.
    Understanding of microbial fermentation, downstream processing, or other batch manufacturing processes.
    Experience with lipids.
    Experience coordinating international shipments, customs, or import/export activities.
    Experience implementing operational, inventory, ERP, quality management, or document management systems.
    Familiarity with customer-facing quality and compliance documentation requirements.



We offer

    An innovative, interdisciplinary, & fun research environment where you can rapidly grow your skillset and advance in your career
    Opportunity to participate in and make meaningful contributions to innovative projects that address key global challenges
    Competitive remuneration, generous vacation package, & other benefits



Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.



How to Apply:

Applications should be in English and contain:

    Cover letter- tell us why you’re a great fit for Melt&Marble and this particular position (300 words max!)
    CV outlining your experience, education, and key skills, including contact information of 2 current/former supervisors and 1 current/former colleague



Deadline: September 30th. Note that we might evaluate applications as they are received, so please apply early!



For any questions, please email hr@meltmarble.com

jobs.description:
Working with a team of biologists and engineers, this challenging and demanding position requires the
selected candidate to work in the company's aquatic research facility based in Malta, the largest
private facility of its kind in Europe. The activities carried out at the facility include work on various
aquatic nutrition trials and health related experiments undertaken on a range of freshwater and marine
species of fish, shrimp and live feed; the technician would be involved in all aspects of the daily
operations as well as being involved in specific research assignments.

NOTE: All applicants must have an EU/EEA/UK passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with the required permits and have an excellent command of the English
language, written and spoken.  

Job description  
A position within the AquaBioTech Group has arisen for a suitably qualified person to work as an
aquaculture / aquatic technician on a variety of research projects at our R&D facility known as ABT
Innovia. The responsibilities of the selected candidate are defined as follows:

Key Accountabilities
. The work is focused on the wet-labs facility of AquaBioTech Group (ABT Innovia), with
primary duties on maintaining livestock and RAS systems. These tasks involve mostly feeding
and health monitoring of the livestock, RAS system maintenance, inspection and
housekeeping, monitoring water quality and experimental trials activities and reporting.
. Day to day coordination and execution of all national and international research projects that
the AquaBioTech Group and its partners are awarded, ensuring that all the research
contracts are managed and executed within the timeframes and budgets provided and all
deliverables are met. This includes ensuring that all SOP and required accreditations, such as
GLP and GMP, are achieved and maintained.
. Be involved in various aspects of the design, engineering and logistics of bringing a RAS
project through to installation and beyond.

Reporting directly to the R&D Facilities Manager, the position is demanding requiring a person who is
highly motivated, methodical and organised. The selected person must be prepared to work to very
tight deadlines in isolated and multi-functional projects and in conjunction with a team of international
staff. AquaBioTech Group has also been awarded, and is continuously seeking to win more, research
projects funded by local government and the EU.

Requirements
. The successful candidate is likely to have a good solid background in aquaculture sciences,
preferably with at least a B.Sc. level of education, although experienced technician candidates are
also encouraged to apply. Experience in laboratory operating procedures and GMP and GLP is
also a bonus, but not essential as all training in these procedures will be provided.
. The selected candidate will be required to speak and write English fluently, and knowledge of any
other languages would be considered an asset, although not essential.
. The selected candidate must have a clean EU / EEA passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with no travel restrictions or legal convictions and be in possession of
a clean driving licence.

AquaBioTech Group offers all employees company accommodation, which comes at cheaper rates

För dig som vill arbeta med försäljning på en hög nivå. 📈

Vi söker nu drivna och ambitiösa Sales Agents till vårt växande team i Málaga.

Du kommer att arbeta med försäljning av finansiella tjänster inom investeringsområdet, där du ansvarar för hela säljprocessen – från den första kontakten med kunden till uppföljning, presentation och avslutad affär. 🤝

Du kommer dagligen att arbeta med både nya och befintliga kunder.

Ditt ansvar är att skapa kontakt, bygga förtroende, förstå kundens behov och på ett professionellt sätt presentera företagets tjänster.

Du driver därefter processen framåt genom uppföljning, hantering av invändningar och kontinuerlig dialog med kunden – hela vägen till avslut. 📞

Vi söker inte nödvändigtvis personen med längst erfarenhet.

Vi söker personen med rätt driv.

Du är ambitiös, social och tävlingsinriktad. Du tycker om att mäta dina resultat, du tar feedback på allvar och du vill hela tiden bli bättre på det du gör.

Tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning är meriterande, men inget krav.

Vi har en strukturerad utbildning på plats och ger dig de kunskaper och verktyg som krävs för att komma in i rollen. 🎓

Det vi förväntar oss tillbaka är att du kommer in med energi, disciplin och viljan att prestera.

Du behöver kunna hantera att höra nej.

Du behöver kunna ta ansvar när resultaten inte är där.

Och framför allt behöver du vilja bli bättre.

Varje dag. 📈

💰 VILLKOR & ERSÄTTNING

Vi erbjuder en stabil grundlön som ger dig tryggheten i vardagen, kombinerat med en provisionsmodell utan tak.

Det finns alltså ingen övre gräns för hur mycket du kan tjäna.

Din ersättning påverkas av din prestation – och möjligheten att öka din inkomst följer med din utveckling som säljare. 💸

Arbetstider

Måndag–torsdag: 09:45–19:00

Fredag: 08:45–16:00

Du arbetar enligt svensk kalender, vilket innebär att svenska helgdagar och röda dagar gäller även om du arbetar från Málaga.

Det innebär bland annat att du är ledig på svenska högtidsdagar som midsommar, jul och andra svenska helgdagar. 🇸🇪

🏆 EN MILJÖ FÖR PRESTATION

Vi bygger en organisation där det ska vara tydligt vad som krävs för att lyckas.

Målen är höga. Tempot är högt. Konkurrensen är en del av vardagen.

Samtidigt arbetar vi aktivt med coaching, utveckling och teamkänsla. 🤝

Vi tror på att skapa en miljö där ambitiösa människor kan växa – både professionellt och personligen.

För rätt person finns det dessutom möjlighet att växa vidare inom organisationen i takt med att du utvecklas och visar vad du går för.

Här ska du kunna se skillnaden mellan att bara gå till jobbet – och att faktiskt bygga en karriär. 🚀

🌴 VARFÖR MÁLAGA?

Du får möjligheten att bygga din karriär inom försäljning samtidigt som du bor och arbetar i Málaga.

Ett internationellt arbetsliv, ett ambitiöst team och en stad där arbetsdagarna kombineras med ett liv utanför kontoret. ☀️

Det är en miljö som passar människor som vill framåt.

⚡ DET HÄR ÄR FÖR DIG SOM…

…inte vill stå och stampa på samma plats om ett år som du gör idag.

Du kanske redan arbetar med försäljning och vill ta nästa steg.

Eller så kanske du är helt ny inom branschen men vet att du har det som krävs för att bli riktigt bra.

Oavsett vilket är vi mer intresserade av din potential än din titel på CV:t.

Om du är beredd att lägga ner arbetet, ta coachningen och ständigt höja din egen nivå, finns här en möjlighet att bygga något långsiktigt.

Så om du känner att det här är miljön du vill utvecklas i – då vill vi höra från dig.

Skicka in din ansökan och låt oss ta det därifrån. 🔥

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.
