jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning:

Med verksamhet i nästan 40 länder, över hela världen, är vårt syfte att vara den bästa delen av resan. Oavsett om våra kunder flyger utomlands på semester, åker på affärsresa eller pendlar till jobbet med tåg, strävar vi efter att erbjuda dem mat- och dryckesupplevelser som uppfyller deras många olika smaker och behov.

Arbetsbeskrivning:   Kock till Craft n' Draft Luleå Airport  





Craft n’ Draft är en gastropub, där maten och ölen står i fokus. Vi söker nu en erfaren och engagerad kock till vårt köksteam. Tjänsten är på 60-80%, kan anpassas efter önskemål. Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta extra vid behov. Skriv vilken tjänst du är intresserad av i din ansökan.







Vi erbjuder:• Trygga anställningsvillkor med tjänstepension och försäkringar genom våra kollektivavtal med HRF• 40 % personalrabatt och subventionerad lunch• Friskvårdsbidrag







Arbetsuppgifter:Du arbetar med vanliga uppgifter inom ett restaurangkök – allt från att förbereda och tillaga rätter, smörgåsar, sallader och bakverk, till disk, städning och uppackning av varor. Du är också delaktig i det dagliga arbetet med att utveckla menyer och förbättra kökets rutiner.







Din profil:• Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i restaurangkök• Förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra• Hög arbetsmoral och ansvarskänsla• Van att arbeta i högt tempo och hålla ordning även under stress• Kommunikativ, lösningsorienterad och initiativtagande• God fysisk uthållighet – arbetsuppgifterna är fysiskt krävande







Din profilVi söker dig med relevant restaurangutbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet från restaurangkök. Du har även erfarenhet av att laga både à la carte och husmanskost, samt av att hantera beställningar. Att ta ansvar och ha en aktiv roll i det dagliga arbetet är något du trivs med. Du samarbetar väl med andra, men arbetar också självständigt när det behövs. Din kommunikation med kollegor och arbetsledning är tydlig, och du bidrar till ett positivt och lösningsfokuserat arbetsklimat. Eftersom arbetet stundtals är fysiskt krävande behöver du känna dig bekväm med ett aktivt arbetsupplägg. Du behärskar svenska obehindrat, både i tal och skrift.







I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap och du ska kunna uppvisa pass som styrker ditt medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schewiz måste du också kunna styrka att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.







För att få arbeta på flygplatsen krävs en godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll, vilket bl.a. innebär att du kan styrka din sysselsättning under de fem senaste åren. Detta ska styrkas i form av skriftliga intyg eller betyg, säkerställ att du kan få fram detta och förbered den dokumentationen så gott du kan inför en eventuell intervju.







Övrig infoDu arbetar skift med arbetsrotation. Schemat följer verksamhetens behov.Våra öppettider följer avgångstiderna på Luleå Airport.11:00-20:00 för det mesta, ett par dagar i veckan till 22:00/23:00.



Vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan, intervjuer sker löpande.Vid frågor kontaktar du Louise Engström: louise.engstrom@ssp.se

jobs.title: Chemical Engineer at CERN
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team developing the next generation of high-performance superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities. In this role, after dedicated training in the team, you will develop and optimise advanced surface treatments essential to their performance, including chemical polishing, electrochemical polishing and electroplating. You will also contribute to the design, procurement, commissioning, and acceptance of a new surface treatment facility dedicated to SRF components.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop, operate and optimise chemical and electrochemical surface-processing techniques for SRF accelerating cavities and their subassemblies.
- Optimise existing processes by developing and conducting laboratory-scale chemical and electrochemical trials, applying multiphysics simulation tools to improve process performance and reproducibility.
- Define technical requirements and coordinate the design, procurement, testing, commissioning and acceptance of new equipment and facilities for the chemical and electrochemical surface finishing of SRF components.
- Develop, validate, document and implement operating procedures, process specifications and quality control methods for the surface finishing of SRF components.
- Work closely with engineers, physicists, technicians, safety specialists and external suppliers, communicating results and technical recommendations through reports, reviews and project meetings.
- Ensure that all necessary safety measures and documentation are kept up to date and effectively implemented across existing and new processes and facilities.

Your profile:
- Strong background in applied electrochemistry and corrosion.
- Field experience in modelling, simulation, developing and optimising chemical or electrochemical treatment processes.
- Good knowledge of chemical engineering unitary operations and chemical process safety.
- Familiarity with electrochemical characterisation techniques.
- Knowledge of materials science, covering both organic and inorganic materials.
- Knowledge of wet surface finishing processes and initial practical experience would be considered an asset.
- Knowledge of metallurgy would be considered an asset.
- Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Knowledge of electrochemistry, corrosion and protection.
- Knowledge of metals and alloys: composition, structure, properties, heat treatments.
- Knowledge and application of thermodynamics and energetics.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in fluid mechanics and/or heat transfer.
- Contributes to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addresses issues.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Works conscientiously and reliably; delivers on promises.
- Actively promotes safety and encourages others to do the same; respects safety rules and procedures.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Medical hazard
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician at Cern
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing more efficient superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities for future CERN accelerators. In this hands-on role, after dedicated training in the team you will contribute to the improvement of thin-film coating technologies through the design, fabrication, commissioning and operation of physical vapour deposition (PVD) equipment.

Your responsibilities:
- Design mechanical components and coating equipment using 3D CAD tools and produce the associated manufacturing and assembly drawings.
- Assemble, install, test, commission and operate physical vapour deposition coating systems and their associated equipment.
- Manufacture and modify metallic and ceramic components using conventional machining and computer numerical control (CNC)-based manufacturing techniques.
- Participate in coating activities, record operating parameters and document process procedures.
- Procure mechanical components for thin-film coating systems.
- Diagnose faults, carry out maintenance and implement mechanical improvements to existing coating systems.
- Apply the relevant safe.

Your profile:
- Experience in conventional and CNC machining operations, particularly milling and turning.
- Experience using 3-dimensional computer-aided design 3D CAD software and interpreting technical drawings.
- Experience in the assembly and testing of ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems would be an asset.
- Basic knowledge of vacuum thin-film coating techniques would be an asset.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.
- Manufacturing of mechanical parts.
- Installation and commissioning of vacuum systems.
- Production and analysis of thin-film coatings.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

jobs.title: Jobba med kundservice under Cyperns sol
jobs.description:
Är du redo att byta mörka novembermorgnar mot havsutsikt, uteserveringar och ett nytt liv vid Medelhavet?

Vi söker nu 4 kundservicemedarbetare till vårt team i Larnaca på Cypern, med start 19 oktober 2026.

Det här är en heltidsmöjlighet för dig som söker mer än ett kort äventyr utomlands. Vi söker nya kollegor som vill göra Cypern till sitt hem och utvecklas på en internationell arbetsplats.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Du hjälper svensktalande kunder främst via telefon och ger snabb, tydlig och vänlig service. Samtalen är varierande och din uppgift är att lyssna, hitta rätt information och vägleda kunden på ett professionellt sätt.

När du har kommit in i rollen kan även andra kanaler, som chatt och e-post, bli en del av arbetet.

Det här är kundservice, inte försäljning.

En smidig flytt och ett bekvämt liv i Larnaca

Att flytta utomlands är ett stort steg och vi hjälper till att göra det enklare. Vi erbjuder boende under dina första två veckor och hjälper dig att hitta ett permanent boende och komma till rätta på Cypern. Efter din provanställning ersätter vi även kostnaden för din flygresa till Cypern.

Månadslönen är 1 400 euro brutto. På den här lönenivån betalar du för närvarande ingen inkomstskatt på Cypern, men lagstadgade avgifter på cirka 11,5 procent dras från lönen.

Din lön ökar också i takt med anställningstiden. Under ditt första anställningsår höjs lönen var fjärde månad, vilket innebär att du efter ett år tjänar 120 euro mer per månad. Löneutvecklingen fortsätter i takt med att din anställningstid ökar.

Vardagskostnaderna i Larnaca är klart lägre än i Sverige, vilket gör det möjligt att leva bekvämt och njuta av livet vid Medelhavet, från strandpromenader och uteserveringar till restauranger, träning och sociala aktiviteter.

Du får även lunch på kontoret tre gånger i veckan, gymmedlemskap eller massage en gång i månaden samt personalrabatter. En gång i månaden gör vi också något roligt tillsammans. Våra aktiviteter kan vara allt från vinprovning och dans till solnedgångskryssningar och gokart.

Du får en strukturerad introduktion, löpande coachning och goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom kundservice och kontaktcenterverksamhet.

Vem är du?

Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice är meriterande, men inget krav. Din inställning, ditt ansvarstagande och din vilja att lära dig är det viktigaste.

Du kan passa bra hos oss om du:

    Talar och skriver svenska flytande

    Tycker om att hjälpa människor och kommunicera via telefon

    Är ansvarstagande, nyfiken och lär dig snabbt

    Vill göra Cypern till ditt hem

Intresserad?

Skicka ditt CV och en kort ansökan via ansökningsknappen eller till jobbcy@dynava.com. Du är också varmt välkommen att kontakta oss på samma adress om du har frågor om tjänsten.

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och kan tillsätta tjänsterna så snart vi hittar rätt personer.

Dynava är en erfaren nordisk kundservicepartner med verksamhet i flera länder. I Larnaca arbetar du tillsammans med finska och svenska kollegor och får stöd av ledare som finns på plats på det lokala kontoret.

På Dynava har vi hanterat kundserviceärenden i över hundra år. Redan 1911 kunde vi hjälpa den första kunden via telefon. Idag arbetar hundratals kundservicemedarbetare på Dynava. Våra team finns på 14 kontor samt arbetar på distans i Finland och Sverige, liksom i Larnaca, Tartu, Chișinău och Dakar. Tillsammans hanterar vi varje år miljontals kundkontakter för våra uppdragsgivare.

Vi drivs av att skapa en unik kundserviceupplevelse oavsett kanal och tid på dygnet. Vår beprövade arbetsmetod bygger på att kombinera en hög kunskapsnivå i varje team med de senaste tekniska lösningarna. På så sätt kan vi optimera våra kunders processer.

Mer information: www.dynava.com

jobs.title: AV programmer - Amersfoort
jobs.description:
Our client is the market leader in the audiovisual industry.

Responsibilities/Tasks  

The AV Programmer will be responsible for assisting customers with the installation and operation of a wide range of A/V control products.

Technical Support & Control Applications
.Provide remote and potentially on-site support for AV control systems, assisting with configuration, and troubleshooting.
.Diagnose issues related to control software, AV hardware communication (RS232, TCP/IP), and third-party device integration.
.Guide customers through system setup and resolve anomalies in software or hardware operation.
.Provide advanced training for customers-programmers, online or in internal or external facilities, on control solutions.

Sales & Feedback
.Provide feedback to the Control Manager when a case needs escalation.
.Inform product improvement needs to the Product & Development team based on field experience and tender requirements.
.Maintain awareness of certifications and specifications relevant to AV control systems.
.Report technical issues using internal tools.


Requirements    

A strong background in other control systems - such as AMX, Crestron, or QSC - is essential, along with solid experience in Python programming (or similar). The ideal candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of integrated A/V environments and be capable of adapting to diverse technical challenges. We are looking for someone based in the BENELUX or DACH area that speaks fluent English.

Technical Expertise
.Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS (servers, registry, DLLs), SQL databases.
.Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP addressing, NAT, routers).
.Proficiency in Python 3 programming and Visual Studio Code knowledge.
.Familiarity with communication protocols (RS232/RS422, SSH, web sockets).
.Experience with AV system integration and control platforms (Extron, AMX, Crestron).

Communication & Reporting
.Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills.
.Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
.Methodical troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
.Regular reporting on status using internal tools.

Education & Experience
.Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

jobs.title: Mäklare Svensk Fastighetsförmedling Fuengirola
jobs.description:
Vill du sälja bostäder på Costa del Sol – och vinna tillsammans med oss?

Svensk Fastighetsförmedling i Fuengirola söker en driven säljare som triggas av tydliga mål, affärer och resultat – men som vet att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans.

Du behöver inte vara mäklare idag. Det viktigaste för oss är att du kan sälja, skapa förtroende och driva affärer framåt.

Kanske arbetar du redan med försäljning i Sverige eller någon annanstans och känner att det är dags för nästa steg? Då kan det steget mycket väl vara till Costa del Sol.

Om rollen

Hos oss blir du en del av ett ambitiöst och sammansvetsat team som hjälper människor att köpa och sälja bostäder i Fuengirola med omnejd.

Det här är en roll för dig som gillar tempo. Du tar initiativ, söker möjligheter och tycker om känslan av att sätta upp ett mål – och sedan göra jobbet som krävs för att nå det.

Du har en tydlig egen motor och vill prestera, men du är också personen som hjälper en kollega, delar med dig av det du kan och gläds när någon annan i teamet lyckas.

Vi söker helt enkelt en vinnarskalle som vill vinna tillsammans med andra.

Vem är du?

Vi söker någon som:

    

har dokumenterad erfarenhet av försäljning och goda resultat

    

är målfokuserad, driven och affärsmässig

    

trivs med tydliga förväntningar och motiveras av att nå och överträffa mål

    

är initiativrik och van att själv skapa aktivitet och möjligheter

    

har lätt för att skapa relationer och bygga förtroende

    

är en lagspelare som förstår att din egen prestation och teamets framgång hänger ihop

    

är tävlingsinriktad på ett positivt sätt – du vill prestera utan att göra det på bekostnad av dina kollegor

    

har ansvarskänsla och förmåga att representera både teamet och varumärket professionellt

    

talar flytande engelska och god spanska, kunskaper i något av de skandinaviska språken är meriterande

    

har B-körkort.

Du behöver inte redan bo i Spanien, men du behöver ha möjlighet och vilja att flytta till Costa del Sol inom relativt kort tid.

Det här är en roll för dig som...

...vill mer.

Du vill utvecklas, göra affärer och se resultat av din egen insats. Du gillar att ha höga förväntningar på dig själv och trivs bäst i en miljö där människor är engagerade och vill framåt.

Samtidigt vet du att ett riktigt bra team inte bara består av starka individer. Det bygger på människor som stöttar varandra, delar kunskap, firar varandras framgångar och kliver fram när någon behöver hjälp.

Hos oss ska du vara på hugget för att göra nästa affär och nå dina egna mål – men också för att bidra till att människorna omkring dig blir bättre.

Varför Svensk Fastighetsförmedling?

Hos Svensk Fastighetsförmedling blir du en del av ett av Sveriges mest välkända varumärken inom fastighetsförmedling, samtidigt som du arbetar på en internationell och dynamisk bostadsmarknad på Costa del Sol.

Här kombineras entreprenörskap, försäljning och höga ambitioner med styrkan i ett etablerat varumärke och ett team som vill utvecklas tillsammans.

Och ja – arbetsplatsen råkar dessutom ligga i Fuengirola.

Men det är inte solen som ska få dig att söka jobbet.

Det är möjligheten att bygga något, utvecklas och bli riktigt bra på det du gör.

Är du vår nästa kollega?

Skicka in din ansökan och berätta gärna vad som driver dig i försäljning, vilka resultat du är mest stolt över och varför just Costa del Sol lockar dig.

Sök redan idag!

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt så återkommer vi och berättar mer. Har du frågor om tjänsten så är du välkommen att kontakta kontorets franchisetagare Karla Aceituno, karla.aceituno@svenskfast.se. Självklart hanterar vi din ansökan konfidentiellt.

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta på Svensk Fastighetsförmedling så hittar du mer information via jobb.svenskfast.se eller via vårt instagramkonto @livetpasvenskfast

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Läs mer om oss här:

https://jobb.svenskfast.se/

https://www.facebook.com/svenskfastkarriar/

https://www.instagram.com/livetpasvenskfast/

jobs.title: Account Manager Capital Sales Ocean Division
jobs.description:
Account Manager - Ocean Division NDR



Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.



As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the Job
As our new Account Manager Ocean Division, you will play a pivotal role in driving the company's growth by proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced, customer focused environment and enjoys the challenge of building lasting relationships.



Your responsibilities will include:

    Direct sales responsibilities, ensuring customer success for your assigned accounts, handling all activities from inquiry to order.
    Generate and nurture leads, converting them into orders.
    Collaborate with the other teams such as Business Development, P&A and Service in order to grow the business.
    Engage actively with the market, focusing on customer interactions, including regular in person engagement, understanding customer needs, and delivering product and service value.
    Develop value based quotes that reflect customer needs and highlight unique selling points.
    Actively follow up on quotes to ensure the proposed value is understood and matches customer needs.
    Provide direct support to customers during the quotation process.
    Work proactively and in a structured manner within and across teams to optimize sales efficiency.
    Use CRM and other tools consistently and effectively to support the sales process and decision-making.



This position is based in one of our Nordic Sites located in Sandvika, Espoo, Søborg, Aalborg or Lund.



Who You Are

You are a proactive and driven sales professional with strong communication skills and a passion for building customer relationships. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable using digital tools, and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are structured, goal-oriented, and eager to deliver value to customers while growing your career in a global company.



What You Know
To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

    Proficiency in commercial contract management and understanding.
    Experience in field sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing role, with a proven track record of successful face-to-face customer engagement.
    High digital competence including frequent usage of CRM systems and digital communication tools.
    You understand technical products and can translate customer needs into value-based solutions.
    Excellent interpersonal skills, comfortable communicating with individuals and teams, including at senior levels.
    Strong communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language.
    You know how to work collaboratively across teams to achieve sales goals.
    Technical education, such as a bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field would be a benefit.



What We Offer

You'll be part of a small, informal team where everyone's voice matters. We work hard, but we also make sure there's room for a healthy balance in life. Teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, we support each other, share ideas, and celebrate our successes together. As part of Alfa Laval, you'll also enjoy the benefits of working in a global company, with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, learn from diverse perspectives, and grow your career in an international environment.



What's in it for you?

You'll enjoy a challenging and rewarding role in a global, open, and supportive environment. You'll collaborate across functions, gaining broad business insights and building a valuable international network. Your contributions will be recognized, and you'll see the real impact of your work on Alfa Laval's success. As you help shape the future of our industry, you'll also have opportunities for personal and professional growth, developing your skills, expanding your horizons, and advancing your career in a company that values innovation, teamwork, and initiative.



For More Information
Please contact Ocean Capital Sales Manager Anna-Maja Eriksson

TAP, Divya Sharma



Application Deadline: Please submit your application no later than 15th September 2026



Selection and interviews will be ongoing continuously. Please be aware that the application process may close earlier if we identify suitable candidates, so do not delay in applying.



As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.



We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.



Applications sent directly via email will be disregarded without notice due to GDPR.

We are looking forward to your application.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Har du starka kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomi, och motiveras du av att skapa struktur, kvalitet och insikter i finansiella processer? Trivs du i en roll där du får ansvar för rapportering, controlling och ekonomisk uppföljning? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Om rollen

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde blir att stötta och följa upp våra svenska och finska bolag samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Du ansvarar för finansiell uppföljning, månads- och årsbokslut samt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och kvalitet i våra redovisningsdata och finansiella rapporter. Du kommer att delta aktivt i budget- och prognosprocesser, analysera ekonomiska resultat och bidra med insikter som stödjer ledningens beslutsfattande.

Du kommer även att arbeta med processförbättringar och interna kontroller för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta finansiella processer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med både interna och externa intressenter, och du kommer att bidra till att säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande redovisningsprinciper och interna riktlinjer.

Ditt arbete kommer att vara avgörande för att skapa transparens, kvalitet och kontroll i våra finansiella processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som inte bara är erfaren, utan även har ett genuint intresse för att skapa struktur och kvalitet i ekonomiska processer. Du har en relevant utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans samt erfarenhet från en liknande roll.

Du behärskar engelska och minst ett skandinaviskt språk och har stark analytisk förmåga. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och är bekväm med att hantera stora datamängder och finansiella analyser. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och Excel är meriterande.

Som person är du proaktiv, ansvarstagande och självständig. Du trivs med att samarbeta över organisatoriska gränser, skapar förtroende genom din professionalism och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Du tar ägarskap för dina uppgifter och levererar resultat med hög kvalitet inom överenskomna tidsramar.

Intresserad?

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande, så skicka in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Heidrun Thorsteinsdottir på +45 2234 6657.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.description:
Kilkanen Oy är ett familjeföretag med lång erfarenhet, grundat 1969. Våra kunder är ledande globala tillverkare av maskiner, motorer och utrustning inom bland annat marin-, energi-, olje- och gasindustrin. Vi är en del av Leinolat Group tillsammans med fyra andra företag inom metallindustrin.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en internationell miljö – cirka 85 % av koncernens produktion exporteras till kunder över hela världen. År 2025 omsatte koncernen 57 miljoner euro. Koncernstrukturen ger möjlighet att flexibelt byta arbetsuppgifter mellan företagen utifrån dina intressen och kompetenser. Vi uppmuntrar också våra medarbetare att vidareutbilda sig och utveckla sina kunskaper.

I rollen får du arbeta med flera olika moment inom maskinbearbetning. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat svarvning, fräsning och andra bearbetningsarbeten beroende på produktionens behov. Arbetsstyckena varierar i storlek och seriestorlekarna ligger vanligtvis mellan 1 och 200 detaljer, vilket gör arbetet omväxlande och utvecklande.

För tjänsten behöver du kunna läsa ritningar, ha kunskaper i mätteknik samt ett intresse för mångsidig maskinbearbetning. Erfarenhet av styrsystemen Fanuc och Mazatrol är meriterande.

Tjänsten passar även dig som är i början av din karriär. Du kan söka direkt efter avslutad utbildning eller om du redan har arbetslivserfarenhet. Det viktigaste för oss är att du har ett genuint intresse för maskinbearbetning, en vilja att lära dig nya saker och ett engagerat arbetssätt.

Vi erbjuder:

en långsiktig anställning i en kompetent och utvecklingsinriktad arbetsmiljö. Du får en grundlig introduktion och blir en del av ett trevligt arbetslag. Anställningen är tillsvidare.

Arbetet utförs på produktionsanläggningen i tvåskift mellan klockan 06.00 och 22.00.

Du är välkommen att söka även om du bor längre bort. Vi hjälper dig att komma igång genom att stötta dig i att hitta bostad i Vasaregionen.

Vi erbjuder:

Ett varierande och utmanande arbete.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python) - Switzerland
jobs.description:
Join CERN's Scientific Information Service, as part of the OSI Department, and contribute to the development of platforms such as INSPIRE, SCOAP, CERN Analysis Preservation and HEPData, used by researchers and scientific communities worldwide. You will design, develop, and operate backend applications, APIs, integrations, and data processing workflows, working primarily with Python and Django.

You will also help bring machine learning and emerging AI capabilities to these platforms, including information extraction, classification, matching, recommendation, semantic search, RAG, and LLM-based applications. You will explore new ways of connecting scientific information platforms, including technologies such as the Model Context Protocol, with a focus on production systems rather than fundamental ML research.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop, maintain, and operate scientific information applications using Python and Django, including APIs, data models, integrations, and data processing workflows.
- Integrate machine learning and AI capabilities into production systems, using technologies such as Large Language Models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, and the Model Context Protocol.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and apply them to concrete scientific information use cases.
- Ensure software quality through automated testing, code review, monitoring, and continuous integration.
- Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, and information specialists on technical solutions and architecture.

Qualifications:
Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or a related field.

Your profile:
- Strong professional experience in Python and software engineering, including backend development with Django or a comparable Python framework, API design, relational databases, and maintainable production software.
- Experience with data-intensive applications or data processing workflows.
- Good understanding of modern Large Language Model technologies and their integration into software systems.
- Experience with Apache Airflow, React and TypeScript, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch would be an asset.
- Experience with LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, semantic search, Model Context Protocol, tool calling, or AI agent integrations would also be an asset.

Your skills:
- Development of application software, design, development and maintenance of production software applications, APIs and data processing workflows using Python and Django.
- Knowledge of programming techniques and languages, strong knowledge of Python, software engineering principles, API development, relational databases and modern development practices.
- Architecture and design of ICT systems, designing maintainable and scalable software architectures, integrations and data intensive applications.
- Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software, applying automated testing, monitoring, debugging, performance analysis, and continuous integration to ensure software quality and reliability.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Keeps up-to-date with developments in own field of expertise and readily absorbs new information.
- Supports and acts in accordance with team decisions; accepts joint responsibility for team successes and shortcomings.
- Demonstrates a pro-active approach to resolving differences; addresses issues of conflict constructively.

Language skills:
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer
Job flexibility: Hybrid

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/other-software-engineer-python/

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

jobs.title: Full-stack developer Poland Remote
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy building products that people rely on every day, and having the freedom to decide how the solution should be built?

At Jobylon, you'll join a team where engineers are trusted to own features from idea to production. You'll spend most of your time building, with few meetings competing for your attention, and you'll see the impact of your work in a product used by thousands of recruiters and hiring managers worldwide.

You'll have room to shape solutions, improve existing workflows, and contribute to the direction of the product. Some of the challenges involve scaling for new markets and growing customer demands. Others are much smaller but equally important: removing friction, simplifying complex processes, and making everyday work easier for the people using the platform.

About the job

You'll work on a product that many of our customers spend hours in every day. The improvements you make won't disappear into a backlog or an internal system that nobody sees. They'll become part of the daily workflow of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates across Europe.

You'll take ownership of features from specification through deployment, working closely with product and engineering to understand the problem before deciding on the solution. Rather than being handed isolated tasks, you'll be trusted to drive meaningful parts of the product forward.

The team works in focused 8-week cycles, with dedicated time both for building and for improving. That means you'll have space to address technical debt, refine existing functionality, and explore better ways of working, not just move from one deadline to the next.

You'll primarily work with Python and Django, alongside modern frontend technologies, but the focus is less on the tools themselves and more on building a product that solves real customer problems.

We're also actively exploring how AI can help us build better products and work more effectively, and you'll have plenty of freedom to experiment with modern tools and ways of working.

About you

You have several years of experience as a full-stack developer, primarily working with web-based products. You feel comfortable taking ownership of features throughout the entire development lifecycle, from understanding requirements to seeing your work live in production.

You have professional experience with Django, meaning you have been hands-on in building scalable Django based products in a professional setting.

You've worked in product-focused environments where engineers are expected to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape solutions, not just implement them.

You speak and write English fluently, as it's our working language.

You are currently located in Poland and is open to working remotely.

Jobylon develops and offers a modern hiring software (SaaS) to companies who want to create and share beautiful job ads and manage their applicants with ease. The recruitment industry has stayed unchanged for too long whilst the need for a simple and efficient tool has increased.

Jobylon was founded in 2011 and since then we've launched a number of exciting projects and ventures within the HR tech space. We've always had the same goal - to use technology and innovation to change and simplify what is today a traditional space.

During this time we've also been awarded as one of Sweden's hottest entrepreneurs and nominated for the Red Herring award - we've done this with a small but dedicated team!

Today, we work with nearly 1000 employers from more than 80 countries worldwide , including amazing organisations such as 7-Eleven, Schibsted, Scandic Hotels, Vaimo, Bonnier and many more!

jobs.title: Ski service / Ski Technician
jobs.description:
Description of the employer:
Norefjell Skisenter is a ski resort located at Norefjell in Krødsherad, Norway. The resort offers alpine skiing, ski school, ski rental, ski service, ski shop and various guest services and activities during the winter season.

The ski resort employs seasonal and permanent staff across several departments, including ski instructors, ski rental, ski service, ski shop, lift operations, restaurants and guest services. The resort welcomes both Norwegian and international guests throughout the winter season and operates with varying staffing needs depending on guest numbers and seasonal demand.

Job description:
The Ski Technician is responsible for the maintenance, preparation and servicing of skis and snowboards at Norefjell Skisenter. The position involves working primarily in the ski service workshop and handling both the resort's rental equipment fleet and guests' personal equipment.

Main duties and responsibilities:
- Maintain, repair and prepare alpine skis and snowboards for daily use.
- Perform machine and manual ski servicing, including base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and polishing.
- Prepare and maintain the resort's rental ski fleet to ensure that equipment is safe, functional and in good condition.
- Carry out repairs and adjustments to skis, snowboards and bindings within the scope of the position.
- Perform regular inspection and maintenance of rental equipment.
- Service guests' skis and snowboards according to their requirements and the ski service's quality standards.
- Operate and maintain ski service machinery and workshop equipment.
- Identify damage, wear and technical issues and determine the appropriate service or repair.
- Ensure correct handling and preparation of ski and snowboard equipment before it is returned to guests or placed back into the rental fleet.
- Follow safety procedures and manufacturer recommendations when working with machinery and equipment.
- Keep the workshop clean, organised and efficient.
- Provide professional customer service and explain completed services and recommended maintenance to guests when required.
- Cooperate with the ski rental, ski shop and other resort departments.
- Assist with other operational tasks within the ski service department when required.

The position requires good technical understanding of skis and snowboards, attention to detail and an interest in ski equipment and maintenance. Previous experience from a ski workshop or ski service department is preferred. Experience operating professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

The position is seasonal and primarily involves working during the winter season. Working hours may vary from week to week depending on guest numbers and whether the resort is operating during peak or low season. Weekend and public holiday work may be required.

Work experience:
Previous experience from a ski workshop, ski service department or ski rental is preferred. Experience Wintersteiger machines, base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and ski repairs is an advantage.

Technical skills:
Good understanding of alpine skis, snowboards, bindings and related equipment. The candidate should be able to identify damage and wear and carry out appropriate maintenance, repairs and adjustments. Experience operating and maintaining professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

Language:
Good English communication skills are required in order to communicate with colleagues and international guests. Norwegian or other European languages are an advantage.

Certificates and qualifications:
Relevant ski technician or ski service qualifications are an advantage. Training or certification related to machinery operation, workshop safety or equipment maintenance is also beneficial.

Other skills:
The candidate must be precise, quality-oriented and able to work independently. Good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently during busy periods are required. The candidate must also be service-minded and able to cooperate well with colleagues across different departments.

Additional information:
Norefjell Skisenter can assist with accommodation and rental arrangements. All seasonal employees also receive free access through the toll road to and from the mountain, as well as free parking.
All seasonal employees are also provided with a season pass and employee discounts at the ski shop, ski rental, and restaurants such as Skistua and NON at Norefjell Ski & Spa.

Martin Hansen

Phone: +45 21 47 73 43

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

Ön är präglad av mötet mellan influenser från både grekisk och turkisk kultur, som speglas i allt från den spännande matkulturen till fantastiska historiska platser och kulturarv. Som tidigare brittisk koloni är Cypern en plats där människor möts och den internationella känslan genomsyrar stämningen, och ön är känd för sin varma, välkomnande lokalbefolkning.  

Engelska klarar du dig långt på då i stort sett hela lokalbefolkningen talar språket, men vill man så finns det självfallet möjlighet att gå kurser i bland annat grekiska som också talas av många på ön.

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.title: Swedish speaking sales agents to Barcelona!
jobs.description:
Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är en av Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer. Och svenska kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

    Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
    Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy

jobs.title: B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga i September
jobs.description:
B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga – arbeta med svenska företagsprojekt med start i September.

Är du redo att utveckla dina kommunikationsförmågor och arbeta med professionella B2B-projekt under solen i Málaga?

Vi söker svenska mötesbokare som vill bli en del av vårt växande team i Spanien. Du arbetar med svenska företagsprojekt och hjälper våra samarbetspartners att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter genom kvalitativa möten med rätt beslutsfattare.

Du blir en del av ett mindre och engagerat team där kvalitet, struktur och goda resultat står i fokus. Vi arbetar uteslutande med B2B – inga privatkunder.

Vad gör en B2B-mötesbokare?

Som B2B-mötesbokare kontaktar du svenska företag och bokar möten åt våra samarbetspartners. Du skapar professionella dialoger, identifierar företagens behov och säkerställer att rätt beslutsfattare får möjlighet att träffa en specialist eller rådgivare.

Du får en gedigen introduktion till varje projekt och arbetar med etablerade företag inom flera spännande branscher – bland annat inom HR, lön, HR-administration, IT-lösningar, betalningslösningar och lagerstyrningssystem.

Den perfekta kandidaten

Vi söker dig som är social, nyfiken och tycker om att skapa nya relationer. Du kommunicerar professionellt på svenska och trivs med att prata med företagskunder.

Erfarenhet av mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundkontakt är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, din vilja att utvecklas och din förmåga att skapa förtroende i samtal med svenska företag.

Du blir en del av ett team där kvalitet, struktur, samarbete och personlig utveckling är centralt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta svenska företag och boka möten för professionella rådgivare och konsulter
    Skapa dialog med beslutsfattare och identifiera relevanta affärsbehov
    Arbeta med flera B2B-projekt inom exempelvis HR, IT, fintech, försäkring, pension och affärssystem
    Säkerställa hög kvalitet i kunddialoger och mötesbokningar
    Bidra till teamets gemensamma mål och resultat
    Utveckla dina kunskaper inom kommunikation, försäljning och affärsförståelse

Dina kvalifikationer

    Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa relationer
    Intresse för B2B-kommunikation och professionell kundkontakt
    Positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya färdigheter
    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och målinriktat
    Erfarenhet inom mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande men inget krav

Lön och förmåner

    Fast lön med attraktiv bonusmodell
    Fast anställning på kontoret i Málaga
    Grundlig introduktion och utbildning inom alla projekt
    Möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika branscher och målgrupper
    Ett starkt svenskt team med god sammanhållning
    Löpande utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och rådgivning
    En arbetsmiljö där kvalitet prioriteras framför kvantitet

Vad får du ut av att arbeta hos oss?

    Möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom försäljning, rådgivning och affärsutveckling
    Inblick i spännande branscher som HR, IT, fintech och företagslösningar

jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Danish – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

Responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams, creating sales materials, attending trade shows, and reporting on sales progress. Join us to shape our success and expand our market presence.
