jobs.title: Kiertävä lähihoitaja - määräaikainen, Attendo Oma, Oulun seutu
jobs.description:
Kiertävä lähihoitaja Attendo-koteihin ja kotihoitoon Oulun alueelle – Olemme täällä sinua varten!

Me Attendolla olemme Matkalla kodiksi. Se merkitsee sitä, että haluamme olla ennen kaikkea koti ikäihmisille, vammaisille ja vammautuneille sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille. Viimeisten vuosien aikana olemme onnistuneet johtamiseen, asiakaskokemukseen ja kohtaamisiin satsaamalla kasvattamaan niin läheis- ja asukastyytyväisyytemme kuin henkilöstötyytyväisyytemmekin historialliseen huippuun.

Jokainen asukkaamme ansaitsee tulla kohdatuksi omana itsenään ja elää täyttä elämää. Attendolaisena olet tärkeä osa tätä tehtävää.

Oulun alueella on 6 ikääntyneiden, 6 kehitysvammaisten ja 6 mielenterveys-ja päihdekuntoutujien Attendo-kotia, sekä kotihoidon palvelut. Tutustu Oulun alueen Attendo-koteihin: Attendo-kodit [https://www.attendo.fi/yksikot/?culture=fi&ancestors=26013&pageSize=20&take=0&pageIndex=1&skipAmount=0&root=348689&contentType=contentType-0&currentPageId=26577&location=Oulu]

Voit olla vasta valmistunut tai jo kokenut konkari. Pääasia, että teet työtäsi iloisella ja avoimella mielellä. Kiertävänä lähihoitajana tärkeintä on joustavuus ja rohkeus tarttua toimeen.

Meillä on mukava ja rento kiertävien hoitajien tiimi ja oman tiimin lisäksi saat kuulua kiertoalueen Attendo-kotien tiimeihin.

Attendo Oma-tiimiläisten tehtävänä on olla aina siellä missä tarve on sillä hetkellä suurin. Sinulle nimetään alueelta kotiyksikkö, jossa olet silloin kun sijaistukselle muualla ei ole tarvetta.

Palkkaus sisältää kiertävän työntekijän tehtäväkohtaisen lisän 337,11 e/kk, sekä maksamme verottoman kilometrikorvauksen työajoista. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen määräajalle 31.12.2027 saakka, aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on pääsääntöisesti kaksivuorotyötä.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan työvuoroihisi – autonominen listojen suunnittelu tukee työhyvinvointia ja arjen sujuvuutta.

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkintoa (lähihoitaja)

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Hygieniapassi

* Rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan työsuhteen alkaessa

* Sote-ammattikortti eli varmennekortti

* Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus

* Sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomenkielentaitoa, vähintään tasolla B1.1.

Lähihoitajat ovat sydämellisiä tiimityöskentelijöitä, jotka tarttuvat rohkeasti toimeen ja innostuvat uusista ideoista. Asiakaslähtöisyys, ystävällisyys ja vastuuntuntoisuus kuvaavat hyvin näitä hoiva-alan rautaisia ammattilaisia. He ottavat itsenäisesti vastuuta ja tuovat positiivista, avuliasta energiaa tiimeihimme.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi
Attendolla kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat täyttä totta, eivät pelkkää puhetta. Meillä on laaja koulutustarjonta, ja kannustamme kaikkia työntekijöitämme kouluttautumaan ja halutessaan myös etenemään urallaan.

Joustamme kanssasi
Tasapaino työelämän ja muun elämän välillä on meille tärkeää. Meillä saat vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi ja sovittaa työn elämäsi eri vaiheisiin.

Työsuhde-etuihimme kuuluvat esimerkiksi:

* Ilmainen kahvi/tee töissä sekä ateriaetu

* Edenred työsuhde-etu, jota voit käyttää esim. työmatkoihin, urheiluharrastuksiin, hierojalle, elokuva- ja konserttilippuihin (300e/kalenterivuosi yli 6kk työsuhteisiin)

* Henkilöstöetuohjelma, joka tarjoaa etuja usealle eri palveluntuottajalle

* Kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä

* Koulutusmahdollisuuksia uralla kehittymiseen

Työsuhteen ehdoissa ja palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkahaitari tehtävään on 2 493,06 € - 2 719,93 € + tehtäväkohtainen lisä.

Huomioithan, että olemme savuton työpaikka.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae meille työkaveriksi!

Hakuaikaa on 20.9.2026 asti, mutta älä jää odottamaan, vaan hyödynnä mahdollisuus päästä osaksi tiimiämme – täytämme paikan heti, kun sopiva hakija löytyy! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikoordinaattori, joka toimii Attendo Omalaisten esihenkilönä. Lähetäthän työhakemuksesi vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Hakemuksen jättämisen yhteydessä pääset halutessasi vastaamaan myös lyhyeen videokysymykseen.

Täällä sinua varten

jobs.title: PhD research fellow/Researcher
jobs.description:
Department of Neurology, Oslo University Hospital / GliaLab, University of Oslo    Researcher and/or PhD position (fulltime).

Applications are invited for one position as Researcher ("Forsker") or PhD research fellow ("Stipendiat") in the project "AI-Driven Optogenetic Closed-Loop Seizure Control"- A 2-photon-imaging project, funded by Helse Sør-Øst (Project 340682).

The project extends our group's ongoing work on the preceding Helse Sør-Øst project (2024056, 2024-2026), and builds on our recent findings on cortical spreading depolarization (CSD) as a possible "brake" on epileptic seizures (Enger & Heuser, Front Netw Physiol 2024; Heuser et al., Cereb Cortex 2018), and on our established two-photon imaging methodology for studying astrocytic and vascular dynamics (Bojarskaite et al., Nat Commun 2023). The aim is to develop and test an AI-driven, closed-loop system that detects seizure activity in real time and triggers an optogenetic intervention (CSD or direct neuronal inhibition) with the goal of a novel, targeted treatment approach for epilepsy.


The application must contain:
- Cover letter with statement of motivation, research interests, and which track (Researcher/PhD fellow) you are applying for
- CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work)
- Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only; PhD diploma or confirmation of imminent completion for Researcher applicants)
- Complete list of publications and academic works
- List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)
- Deadline for application: October 15th, 2026
- Start: November 1st, 2026, later start can be possible depending on circumstances
- Position duration: 3 years (through October 31st, 2029)
- Contact: Research group leader Kjell Heuser, Department of Neurology, Oslo University Hospital HF, dr.heuser@gmail.com, or +47 92414568, and/or Associate Professor Rune Enger, GliaLab, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo, rune.enger@medisin.uio.no, or +47 90534262

The project comprises:

- Two-photon imaging: In vivo two-photon imaging of astrocytes and neurons in awake, head-fixed mice through chronic cranial windows, building on our established methodology for studying cortical and hippocampal network activity. 

- Consolidating the conditional Kir4.1 knockout hippocampal model combined with wireless EEG telemetry.

- High-density electrophysiology (Neuropixels 2.0) and miniaturized two-photon imaging (Mini2P) of astrocytes and neurons through chronic hippocampal windows, to test the role of CSD in seizure termination.

- Development of an AI-based seizure-detection algorithm driving automated, closed-loop optogenetic stimulation.

The successful candidate will be based at GliaLab, Letten Centre, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (https://glialab.no), working in close collaboration with the Department of Neurology, Oslo University Hospital. 
Please indicate in your application which track you are applying for (Researcher or PhD fellow), or whether you wish to be considered for either, depending on your qualifications.


Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is essential to perform the tasks required. We pursue diversity among our job applicants and encourage everyone to apply regardless of who you are and what background you have.
Qualifications


     Requirements if hired as PhD fellow (100% position):

  • Completed Master's degree (or equivalent) in neuroscience, medicine, biology, biomedicine, or a related field
  • Documented experience with in vivo rodent experimental work 
  • Highly motivated and accurate candidate
  • Good problem-solving skills

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

Ben jij als verpleegkundige toe aan de volgende stap in je carrière? Wil jij je verder specialiseren in de zorg voor zwangeren, vrouwen tijdens de bevalling én pasgeboren baby's? Dan is de opleiding tot obstetrieverpleegkundige misschien wel precies wat je zoekt! Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste leerling obstetrieverpleegkundige die wil bijdragen aan de best mogelijke zorg voor moeder, kind en gezin. Wil je meer weten over deze functie en opleiding? Lees dan verder!
Wat ga je doen?
Als obstetrieverpleegkundige is geen dag hetzelfde. Je verleent zorg aan zwangeren, vrouwen tijdens de bevalling, kraamvrouwen en pasgeboren baby's. Daarbij staat gezinsgerichte zorg centraal: je hebt niet alleen oog voor de moeder en het kind, maar voor het hele gezin.
Je begeleidt de zwangere of kraamvrouw, haar partner en eventuele kinderen tijdens één van de meest bijzondere momenten in hun leven. Vaak is dat een periode vol vreugde en nieuw geluk, maar soms ook een ingrijpende tijd waarin verdriet en verlies een rol spelen, bijvoorbeeld bij het overlijden van een (ongeboren) kind. Juist in die momenten maak jij met jouw deskundigheid, betrokkenheid en persoonlijke aandacht een waardevol verschil.

Electrical Service Technician - Infrastructure Systems
Do you enjoy working on technical installations that directly contribute to safe traffic flow, reliable infrastructure and public safety? As an Electrical Service Technician, you will work on complex infrastructure projects involving tunnels, bridges, locks, pumping stations and water-related installations. No two days are the same, and your work has a visible impact on systems that must remain operational 24/7.
What we offer
At Employ IR, we provide you with the space and freedom for your own initiative and development. We believe it is important that you can apply your expertise within our organization. There is plenty of room to develop yourself and advance your career. Additionally, we offer: - Salary between €4.357 - €5.200 gross per month, depending on experience; - Employ IR covers work-related and relocation costs; - 8% holiday allowance on top of your annual salary; - 25 vacation days per year; - Company car, also available for private use; - A solid pension scheme for a secure future; - Opportunities for career growth, technical training and additional courses; - A safe, stable and supportive working environment focused on teamwork, technical quality and responsibility.
Job description
You will mainly work on electrical, measurement and control systems within dry and wet infrastructure. These systems are essential for keeping tunnels, bridges, locks, pumping stations and traffic-related installations safe and operational. Your work includes preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, commissioning and technical improvements. What you bring
This role is suited to a technician who enjoys variety, responsibility and independent work. You stay calm when faults occur, communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, and take pride in delivering safe and high-quality technical work.

jobs.description:
Agile coach
As organizations transition to Agile methodologies, they may need the expertise of an Agile Coach. An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. In this text, we will discuss the definition, competencies and responsibilities of an Agile Coach.
Definition Agile Coach
An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile -methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. The goal of an Agile Coach is to advise organizations on how to improve their practices and integrate Agile methodologies. Agile Coaches are experts in understanding and adhering to Agile principles and ensuring that teams and individuals use the right tools and techniques to achieve desired results.
Key competencies
An Agile Coach needs a number of key competencies to be effective in his or her role. Some of these competencies are:
Knowledge of Agile methodologies : Is familiar with Agile methodologies and the principles behind them. He or she should be able to clearly explain and guide the application of these principles in practice.
Coaching and Training: Must be able to coach and train effectively. This includes the ability to ask the right questions, provide feedback and ensure good communication.
Leadership: Must be a Servant Leader. Servant-Leadership is a "way of being and doing" in which the leader is subservient to the growth of others, the organization and himself. In doing so, this philosophy contributes to a development of society as a whole.

jobs.description:
Wil jij als vrijwilliger bijdragen aan een gezellige vrijdagmiddag op onze ouderensoos? Wie zijn wij Wij zijn een dagbesteding voor ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking op de Paardenmarkt in het centrum van Delft. Op deze locatie zijn verschillende woningen en ook een dagcentrum. Op het dagcentrum is op vrijdagmiddag een soos. De bezoekers komen daar voor de gezelligheid. Er moet niets, het gaat vooral om samen zijn. We doen spelletjes, kaarten, sjoelen. Drinken een kopje koffie en een drankje. Soms is er een bingo of komt er een koor optreden. Er komen gemiddeld 25 cliënten, de meeste wonen ook op locatie de Paardenmarkt. Sommigen komen met de bus van externe locaties. Het zijn oudere cliënten die functioneren op een laag tot hoog ontwikkelingsniveau. Kijk voor meer informatie over de locatie: Werken bij Ipse de Bruggen in Delft en Den Haag: een impressie Jouw baan als Vrijwilliger Ouderensoos Op vrijdagmiddag help je van 13.00 tot 16.30 uur bij de voorkomende werkzaamheden. Dat zijn spelletjes doen, koffiezetten, helpen bij het sjoelen en een gezellig praatje maken. Bij de soos werken meer vrijwilligers. Het is een gezellig groepje! Sommigen helpen ons al jaren, sommigen nog niet zo lang. Jouw profiel Je houdt van gezelligheid. En je vindt het leuk om samen met andere vrijwilligers en begeleiders onze bezoekers een leuke middag te bezorgen. Wat krijg je van ons Het aantal uren is in overleg; uiteraard houden wij rekening met je agenda en mogelijkheden. Wij zorgen goed voor onze vrijwilligers: Je wordt enthousiast ingewerkt. Je kunt je reiskosten declareren (in overleg onkosten). Er is jaarlijks een cursusaanbod over uiteen lopende thema’s. Wij zetten onze vrijwilligers regelmatig in het zonnetje. En hele dankbare gezichten omdat door jouw hulp meer mogelijk is. Informatie Je werkt bij Ipse de Bruggen vaak met kwetsbare cliënten en daarom zijn wij zeer zorgvuldig in ons selectiebeleid. De aanvraag Verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG), het navrage

van referenties en het opvragen van informatie bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd maken om die reden onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure. Voor informatie kun je contact opnemen met Leonie Vugts (begeleider DAC Paardenmarkt), tel: 088 - 967 74 60.

Are you a nurse or doctor and do you want to use your expertise to help people in need? Then come join our medical team on Lesvos as a volunteer. Together with our MHPSS team you will contribute to humane (emergency) care at the reception centre Mavrovouni. Please note: we are currently only accepting applications from September 2026 onwards.
About us
Boat Refugee Foundation provides medical and psychosocial (emergency) aid and stands up for the rights of people seeking refuge. We take action where systems become inhumane and compassion is lost. Since 2015, we have been working in various locations at the borders of Europe. There our teams, which largely rely on volunteers, provide medical and psychosocial support.
What will you do?
As a volunteer you will work in our medical team on Lesvos, which largely consists of professional volunteers. Besides nurses and doctors we work with our interpreters, who live in the camp themselves. They have an indispensable role in our team.

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums.
L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils :

Description de l'entreprise

Sopra Steria , acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d'édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d'activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative.
Sopra Steria place l'humain au centre de son action et s'engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 5,8 milliards d'euros.
The world is how we shape it

Description du poste

Le Data Center of Excellence Sopra Steria (DCoE), entité transverse du pôle France, est au cœur de l'accompagnement et de la transformation Data / IA de nos clients.

Convaincu que la Data est le moteur d'un socle industriel évolutif et durable, construit pour répondre aux enjeux buisness, nous travaillons sur toute la chaine afin d'apporter de la valeur à nos clients sur tous les niveaux (métier, IT, CxO.) en lien avec nos équipes conseils et delivery.

Le DCOE regroupe les expertises technologiques et méthodologiques sur toute la chaine de valeur Data : de la stratégie de transformation, à la mise en place d'usage d'IA au quotidien, en passant par la gouvernance et les architectures Data Cloud et on premise.

Environnement de travail

En tant que Consultant Analytics & IA vous intégrerez notre centre d'excellence Data, ce qui vous permettra d'intervenir auprès de divers clients dans des secteurs d'activités variés ( Banque, Assurance, Secteur Public, Télécom, Média, Jeux, Industrie et Services ) sur l'ensemble du territoire Français. Nous intervenons en appuis des équipes delivery, lors de la phase de prospection, d'avant-vente et de réalisation des projets.

Vous travaillerez en priorité sur les sujets d'Analytics & d'industrialisation IA (traitement des données, qualité, modélisation, visualisation, veille, innovation) tout en intégrant les meilleures pratiques d'industrialisation des projets IA à l'échelle d'une organisation.

Nous travaillons en partenariat avec les éditeurs phares du marché, ainsi qu'avec les hyperscaler.

ZenML, Dataiku, SageMaker, VertexAI, MLFlow, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.***Mettre en œuvre des transformations et valoriser les données en utilisant SQL, Python, Java, Scala.***Avoir une bonne connaissance des méthodologies et des outils liés au CI/CD.***Avoir une maîtrise d'au moins un des cloud provider (AWS, GCP ou Azure)***Cadrer les projets, comprendre un RFP, élaborer une réponse technique (Audit, Roadmap, propositions techniques et logicielles) et la défendre devant un auditoire mixte, à la fois technique et fonctionnel.***Avoir une connaissance de Snowflake ou de Databricks serait un atout majeur. (incluant l'optimisation des performances et la réduction des coûts d'utilisation Effectuer une veille technologique et académique constante sur les avancées en IA.

Suite à votre prise de poste, vous serez potentiellement amené(e) à réaliser de l'encadrement d'équipe et/ou intervenir sur le delivery de solution (à titre d'expertise).

Qualifications

De formation Bac+5 ou plus (ingénieur grandes écoles ou universités), vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins trois ans sur un poste de Consultant Analytics et IA vous ayant permis d'acquérir de solides compétences.

Vous avez une sensibilité particulière sur des sujets Data et IA plus larges (Algorithmie, industrialisation, explicabilité) ? Cela sera un véritable atout pour vous adaptez aux différents projets desquels vous serez en charge.

A l'aise avec la prise de parole en public cela vous permettra de présenter et animer des ateliers et réunions autour de solutions IA.

Pour finir, vous disposez d'un anglais de niveau B2 nécessaire pour adresser nos clients à l'étrangers.

jobs.title: Talent Lead
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

  • Develop a strong candidate experience and represent White Circle throughout the hiring process

  • Help define and improve our approach to hiring, including how we assess candidates and make hiring decisions

  • Partner with leadership on long-term talent planning and hiring strategy

 

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have several years of experience running hiring at a startup, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth environment

  • Have personally hired a meaningful number of people and are comfortable owning the full recruiting process yourself

  • Have built hiring processes and recruiting operations from scratch

  • Have experience hiring across multiple functions, including GTM, Operations, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Have experience with international hiring across multiple countries and markets

  • Are comfortable working directly with leadership and senior hiring managers

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable tracking and analysing recruiting metrics

  • Are an excellent sourcer and know how to find strong candidates beyond simply posting jobs

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Are comfortable operating independently in an environment where processes are still being built

  • Speak and write fluent English (C1+)

A big plus:

  • Experience hiring for AI, ML, and Research roles

  • Experience building a recruiting function as the first or one of the first talent hires

  • Experience hiring in the US, EU, and UK

  • Experience with employer branding and building a strong talent pipeline

  • Experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, research, or recruiting ops

 

Why White Circle

  • Meaningful equity package

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Mabella

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with Head of People (25 min)

  2. Practical Recruitment Exercise with Head of People (60 min)

  3. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

Please submit your application in English.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Lead [gn] Data Intelligence
jobs.description:
The AI Enablement Team is the catalyst for internal transformation and product acceleration across Actian. In the modern data landscape, AI is not a siloed experimental lab; it is a core capability that must be embedded into our product DNA and our engineering workflows.

We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. You are not a theoretical researcher or a passive prompt engineer; you are a highly practical, technical driver who builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and frameworks that allow other product and engineering teams to deploy AI safely, rapidly, and at scale. You will democratize AI across the organization, establish modern LLMOps/MLOps practices, and directly impact the Actian Data Intelligence Platform by introducing agentic workflows, intelligent data pipelines, and cutting-edge capabilities.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Internal AI tooling: Design and maintain the core AI orchestration layers, centralized API gateways, and reusable frameworks (e.g., advanced RAG architectures, agentic frameworks) for company-wide consumption.

  • Product AI Integration: Collaborate directly with core engineering teams to embed production-ready generative AI and machine learning features into the Actian Data Intelligence Platform.

  • LLMOps & Governance Infrastructure: Establish strict guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring tools to track model performance, bias, data privacy, and security across all AI implementations.

  • Cost & Latency Optimization: Actively monitor and manage cloud and API compute spend (token management, open-source vs. commercial models) and optimize execution latency for production AI features.

  • Cross-Functional Upskilling: Lead workshops, design blueprints, and create documentation to empower non-AI engineering teams to build and maintain their own AI-driven features confidently.

  • Rapid Prototyping (PoC to Production): Drive the engineering execution of high-impact AI proof-of-concepts, ensuring they are built with production-grade code that scales seamlessly.

  • Standardization of Tooling: Define and enforce the organization's official AI stack, from vector database selection and vector embeddings strategies to semantic caching mechanisms.

  • Vendor & Open-Source Strategy: Evaluate and manage partnerships with AI model providers and lead the technical assessment of cutting-edge open-source models to keep Actian at the vanguard of innovation.

  • Data-Driven Impact Tracking: Define and track operational metrics for the AI Enablement function, such as developer adoption rates, reduction in time-to-market for AI features, and ROI of implemented AI tools.


    • Qualifications & Profile:

  • Technical Background: Strong background as a Senior AI/ML Engineer, LLMOps Engineer, or Software Architect who has successfully built and scaled AI-powered applications in enterprise SaaS or complex data platforms.

  • AI & Engineering Mastery: Deep technical expertise in Python or Go, semantic search, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and fine-tuning or prompt engineering of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Extreme Ownership: High-agency mindset. You don’t wait for product teams to ask for AI capabilities; you proactively build the frameworks that solve their bottlenecks before they even identify them.

  • Software Engineering Rigor: You treat AI development as software engineering. You understand CI/CD, unit testing for AI (evaluation datasets), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and clean code architecture.

  • Influence Without Authority: Exceptional leadership and communication skills. You can inspire and align disparate engineering teams around a shared technical vision without being their direct line manager.

  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to demystify complex AI anomalies or architectures into clear business value for internal stakeholders and executives.


    • What We Offer:
  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

    Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.
     
    We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.title: Valuer (Fixed-term contract - 12 months) (m/f)
jobs.employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
jobs.description:
Career Opportunities: Valuer (Fixed-term contract - 12 months) (124717)
Requisition ID 124717 - Posted 10/07/2026 - Luxembourg - Luxembourg - Activity area (2) - Experienced Professionals
  
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The main objective of this position is to perform in-depth analysis and checks on all types of investments in funds managed by FundPartner Solutions (FPS). The Valuer will play a key role in establishing and verifying valuation procedures, with a particular focus on Hedge Funds and Private Assets. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical skills, rigor, and a collaborative team spirit to analyze Audited Financial Statements and ensure the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.

• Audited Financial Statement Analysis: Analyze Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets to ensure accurate valuation and compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
• Drafting and Review: Experience in drafting or working on Audited Financial Statements is considered a strong asset.
• Audit and Client Requests: Respond to audit requests and client inquiries, providing detailed financial information or valuation methodologies to ensure compliance and client satisfaction.
• Risk Reporting Management: Manage risk reporting and conduct risk analysis through audited financial statements to identify areas of improvement or potential risks.
• Valuation Activities Reporting: Measure and report on valuation activities, ensuring excellent client service by providing accurate and timely reports.
• Back Testing Reporting: Present back testing reports to Conducting Officers or Boards as required, demonstrating the ability to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Fluent in french and english
• 3 to 5 years experience in valuation, pricing, or corporate action, with a strong focus on analyzing Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets.

Experience in drafting or working on Audited Financial Statements is a plus.

Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is also considered a strong asset.

• Excellent knowledge of financial products and their valuation.
• Broad knowledge of funds regulation and fund administration.
• Experience with data vendors such as Bloomberg, Markit, ICE, Reuters.
• Proficient use of data and communication tools (e.g. MS Office suite, Business Object, Tableau, etc).
• Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is a plus.
• Experience with online collaboration tools and digital reporting platforms is an asset.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• High level of rigor and organizational skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate effectively.
• Ability to present complex information clearly to senior management, Conducting Officers, or Boards, including back testing reports.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Meet your future team

You will join the Data Factory within the Central Data Office, a multidisciplinary team designing and operating the firm's core data ingestion and integration platforms. Encouragement to apply

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Bring your data engineering expertise to a role where platform reliability, collaboration, and impact matter every day. Shape how data is ingested, trusted, and used across the firm while growing your technical depth and influence. Grow here. Go further.

Join our team. Your future starts here.

Swiss Life Group is one of Europe's leading comprehensive life, pensions and financial solutions providers.

Within the Group's International Division and with its two business lines, Swiss Life Global Solutions offers a broad range of tailored cross-border life insurance solutions to wealthy individuals for a suitable integrated wealth planning (Global Private Wealth Solutions) and to international companies to address the benefits needs of their local and mobile employees (Global Employee Benefits Solutions).

• you enjoy working in a truly international and entrepreneurial environment
• you have strong business acumen and are able to think consistently from the customer's point of view
• you are willing to work in an efficient, committed and agile manner, in the best interests of our company

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate (m/f/d) in Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS).  
  
What if it was you?

The PwC Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS) team in Luxembourg is looking for a senior associate to join our local actuarial practice of over 20 actuaries and risk modellers. This is one of the largest actuarial consulting teams in Luxembourg. As part of our dynamic and diverse team, you will work on complex problems and challenges related to reserving, pricing, risk or capital related projects across the Luxembourg and broader European markets, as well as multidisciplinary projects in areas such as     reinsurance optimisation and business transactions.
  
Be a part of our team where you will:

• Provide actuarial consulting services.
• Perform reserving analysis and valuation with a strong focus on business drivers, ensuring reserve adequacy aligns with regulatory requirements and translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for management and stakeholders.
• Support/lead Solvency II reviews for insurers, including Solvency II balance sheets, QRTs and ORSAs.
• Support insurance regulation-related projects in insurance, such as local regulation, IFRS 17 accounting, transfer pricing, POG/VFM, etc.
• Work closely with audit teams to provide actuarial support to our audit practice with regard to Luxembourg-based insurers and reinsurers.
• Support the Corporate Finance, M&A and Strategy teams by providing expert support for business transactions, portfolio transfers, actuarial due diligence projects and reserves/provision certifications.
• Assist in the continued growth and development of PwC's actuarial practice.
• Supervise and coach junior actuarial staff.
  
Let's talk about you. We expect that …

• You have a university degree with a specialization in actuarial science, mathematics, or quantitative finance;
• You have at least 2 years of working experience as an actuary;
• You demonstrate solid understanding of standard life and/or non-life actuarial practices under Solvency II, complemented by expertise in one or more related areas such as Luxembourg GAAP, IFRS 17 reporting, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
• You enjoy working in a practical and creative manner, constantly analysing and solving new challenges.  
• You have good command of the English language. Fluency in French is considered an advantage.
• You enjoy working in a team. You want to develop, build relationships and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues.
• You have the experience with specialised software in one of areas such as pricing, reserving, capital management (for example, URS, ResQ, Prophet or other recognised).
  
…so that you are the candidate we are looking for!

At PwC, we believe diversity is the representation of all the characteristics that make us both alike and unique. Our backgrounds, cultures, nationalities, lifestyles, identities, opinions and beliefs, approaches to solving problems, ways of working, and views of personal and professional success, all add value to the services we deliver to our clients. Our objective is to nurture an inclusive environment where a diversity mindset is ingrained, and inclusion is the norm. We constantly focus on respecting and valuing individual differences.

jobs.employer: ALSA S.A., AGENCE LUXEMBOURGEOISE POUR LA SECURITE AERIENNE
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Temps de travail: Temps plein
Type de contrat: CDI
Date d'entrée en fonction: Immédiate
Date limite de candidature: 30 septembre 2026


ORGANIZATIONAL SETTING:

Reporting to the Head of UAS and new technologies department, you participate to the implementation of the UAS regulation and to the safety oversight of UAS operators in Luxembourg.


Your scope of work will include (but not limited to):

• Implementing national and international regulations relating to unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), in accordance with the priorities set at national level;
• Digitalizing systems supporting UAS operations in collaboration with the relevant state entities (e.g. CTIE) and international partners (e.g. EASA, Eurocontrol);
• In-depth technical and regulatory assessment of applications relating to the SPECIFIC category;
• Supervision of UAS operators through inspections and compliance audits;
• Support citizens and relevant entities by providing clear, accessible and tailored information in order to promote safe and compliant drone operations;
• Development and coordination of internal processes (Checklists, procedures, etc.);
• Participation in international working group or workshop if necessary.


REQUIREMENTS:


Education:

At least three years of post-secondary education in aeronautics, equivalent to bachelor's degree level or equivalent.

ALSA s.a., Luxembourg Aviation Safety Agency, is a company acting under the supervision of Luxembourg National Aviation Authority and fully owned by the State of Luxembourg.

• At least three years of experience within an operational environment (e.g. professional UAS operator, training school, UTM developer).
• Good knowledge of EU regulation 2019/947, including the Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) methodology. Knowledge of any other EU regulations relevant to UAS operations (e.g. 2019/945; 2021/664) will be considered an asset;
• Good understanding of the operational aspects of the aviation and UAS industry and associated risks. Qualification or certification in manned or unmanned aircraft piloting or in Air Traffic Control (ATC) will be considered an asset;


Experience, technical skills and competences:

jobs.title: Junior Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Join our Audit Recruitment Days – 22 and 23 October 2026


Make your mark:

Forget the traditional job interview process. KPMG Luxembourg's Audit Recruitment Days are a two-day immersive experience  designed to give you a real feel for what it means to be an Auditor at KPMG. Through interactive challenges, innovative assessment activities you'll get the chance to explore how modern audit is evolving while also getting to know our people, our culture and life in Luxembourg, all while being considered for a career opportunity at KPMG Luxembourg..

Audit is evolving rapidly. Emerging technologies, data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming the profession, creating exciting opportunities for curious minds who combine strong business understanding with a passion for innovation.

Whether your background is in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Technology, the Recruitment Days will allow you to experience how modern Audit combines professional judgment, technology and collaboration to create trust.


What to expect:

Day 1 - Step into #TeamBlue: You'll start the day at our KPMG Luxembourg headquarters where you'll kick things off with interactive presentations about KPMG and the world of Audit. After lunch, you'll dive into the Audit Tech Challenge, a collaborative activity that gives you a real taste of modern Audit in action. In the afternoon, you'll get to discover Luxembourg through a fun team-based urban rally. The day will end with a special networking dinner with our Partners and Service Line Leaders before returning to your accommodation for the night, provided by KPMG.

Day 2 - Time to shine: This is where you'll show your strengths and take part in your a business interview with our Audit professionals. Following the interview, you'll get to participate in an engaging Virtual Reality Cchallenge, meet our people in a lively speed-networking session, and have an exclusive office tour. We'll wrap the day up with lunch followed by a closing session, where a few surprises and highlights await!

The following week, you'll receive feedback because we value transparency and growth! If the outcome is positive, you will also receive a job offer to join KPMG Luxembourg.


Your future role:

As a Junior Auditor, you'll do much more than just review financial information.

You'll combine audit expertise with technology, data and innovation to help clients build trust in an increasingly digital world. Your responsibilities will include:

Applying your accounting and finance knowledge to real client engagements using IFRS, Luxembourg GAAP and international auditing standards.  
Working alongside experienced auditors to understand business processes, identify risks and deliver high-quality audits.  
Leveraging data, technology and emerging AI-enabled tools to support audit procedures and improve efficiency.  
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges.  
Contributing to innovative projects that improve audit methodologies, data analytics and digital transformation.  
Continuously developing both your audit expertise and your digital capabilities throughout your career.


Who we're looking for:

We're looking for ambitious, sharp-minded people who are ready to grow and make an impact with us at KPMG Luxembourg. If you check these boxes, we want to hear from you! Here's what you need to know:

Start date: We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2027 and January 2028.
Education: You have (or will soon have) a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Audit, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. Bonus points if you're interested in professional accountancy qualifications (e.g., IRE).
Languages: You're fluent in English, plus either French, German, or Luxembourgish.
Mindset: Analytical, curious about technology, eager to learn, collaborative and ready to embrace innovation.  
Integrity: You value quality, ethics and doing the right thing.


What's in it for you:

Your future starts here! At KPMG, you'll get:

Training and support: A full-on learning experience, including our Induction Week plus all the resources to keep leveling up.  
Career growth: Want to work in another department or in a different office? We make it part of your professional development.
Impactful work: Work with top experts, collaborate with global clients, and use cutting-edge technology to make a difference.
Fun and community: From KPMG Plage to staff parties and sports activities, we make work-life balance a reality.
Flexibility: Work from home or at different office locations – we're all about that modern work setup.
Inclusive culture: We champion diversity, gender equality, and strong support for the LGBTQ+ community. You belong here!
This isn't just another job opportunity - it's your chance to join a dynamic, forward-thinking team that values your potential. Join #TeamBlue and be part of something bigger!

jobs.description:
Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist – Semantic AI, Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering
Job ID: 10517592 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that Every Day is still Day One! We're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and Amazon's Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (C-RME) team is at the heart of that mission, using science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally.
We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist to lead key semantic layer and knowledge intelligence initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, ontology design, and applied AI, owning workstreams for the development of semantic foundations and dedicated science approaches that ensure their accuracy, consistency, and explainability in service of agentic and non-agentic AI across RME.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to the success of Central and Field RME teams working with new launches of Amazon buildings, as well as ensure that our Field teams benefit from state-of-the art AI solutions to support Global Operational Excellence.
You will closely work with our team of senior scientists and systems engineers in our knowledge intelligence team, which is leading the full lifecycle of graph-based AI solutions, from customer problem formulation and ontology design to production deployment, enabling network-wide data discovery, decision support, and compliance monitoring.
A core part of your mandate is to lead the semantic modelling and ontological foundation layer that supports both explainability and retrieval capabilities. This foundation feeds into transversal initiatives spanning multiple teams and products involving multiple AI approaches. You will closely work with Senior Applied Scientists owning explainability, causal reasoning, intelligent retrieval and question answering over knowledge graphs.

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist, you will:

• lead the semantic layer for agentic AI, including developing and assessing the ontological foundations that enable autonomous workflows and cross-site best practice sharing. You will also disseminate governance and standardization practices that ensure downstream consumers (including retrieval and explainability systems) operate on consistent, well-defined semantics
• design, build, and deploy graph-based AI solutions that combine knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and ML models to extract meaning from large-scale unstructured document collections, enabling data discovery, classification, and governance across RME
• define and own knowledge pipelines that extract, transform, and enrich entity relationships from diverse unstructured and semi-structured sources into production-grade knowledge graphs, ensuring reliability and accuracy of the overall information architecture
• collaborate with fellow senior scientists to design, deploy, and operate graph and vector databases to support retrieval, causal reasoning, and analytics use case as well as ensure contributing scientists maintain versioning, validation state, and provenance for every knowledge graph entry
• collaborate with fellow senior applied scientists to ensure ontology and schema design decisions optimize for queryability, so that question-answering and retrieval systems can leverage the semantic layer with minimal impedance mismatch
• integrate LLMs and ML models into text processing pipelines for classification, embedding generation, document similarity, entity extraction, and semantic analysis, applying rigorous experimentation and evaluation methodology to select the best fit-for purpose approach
• design ontological structures that support explainability, enabling agents and reasoning systems to trace reasoning paths and surface provenance, enabling governance-level transparency for autonomous AI actions
• optimize models and inference pipelines for production constraints including latency, throughput, cost, and infrastructure reliability
• establish best practices and standards for knowledge engineering and applied science processes, elevating the maturity of RME's data, information, and AI capabilities
• mentor and train colleagues on knowledge graph concepts, semantic modelling, and applied AI techniques

About the team

The Amazon Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) team maintains and optimizes technologies ranging from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses utilizing robotics and high-volume conveyance all the way through the value chain to small, high-speed warehouses placed as close to our customers as possible. Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) uses science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally. We do this to meet our customer promise, reduce costs, and support the Climate Pledge.

asic Qualifications

- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- • MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Information Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent industry experience)
- • Proven experience developing and deploying production knowledge graphs in real business scenarios at enterprise scale
- • Deep expertise in semantic technologies, modelling languages (RDF, OWL, etc..), and querying languages (SPARQL, Gremlin, Cypher, or other GQLs);
- • Experience with MLOps practices: building production-grade pipelines, CI/CD for ML, containerization, and monitoring of deployed AI solutions
- • Appetite for staying at the forefront of semantic web technologies and graph applications

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- • PhD in a relevant field with publications in knowledge representation, NLP, or graph-based AI
- • Familiarity with graph visualization tools and techniques
- • Experience leveraging graph theory (traversals, centrality, community detection) and graph analytics in applied settings
- • Experience designing clean, modular, and testable ML code in a collaborative environment

In this role, you will own category strategy for Amazon's European cross-dock distribution program and grocery logistics packaging; managing a supplier portfolio that directly enables hundreds of fulfillment centers to receive supplies faster, at lower cost.

You'll shape how Amazon procures, distributes, and optimizes non-inventory supplies across Europe, working at the intersection of warehousing, transportation, and manufacturer partnerships. This is a builder role: you'll run competitive tenders across multiple countries, manage 3PL relationships, and expand operations into new markets, all while turning procurement from a transactional function into a strategic supply chain enabler.

If you enjoy navigating complexity across markets, building programs from scratch, and seeing your work translate into measurable operational impact across a continent; this is your role.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end category strategy for European cross-dock distribution operations, including supplier selection, contract management, performance governance, and expansion into new markets
- Lead competitive sourcing events (RFIs, RFPs, tenders) for warehouse services, logistics providers, and grocery packaging suppliers across multiple EU countries
- Manage supplier relationships and performance across the European distribution network, driving accountability through KPIs, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Develop and execute the procurement strategy for EU grocery logistics packaging, building a diversified supplier base and implementing cost-effective commercial frameworks
- Partner cross-functionally with operations, finance, transportation, and legal teams to ensure seamless procurement execution and compliance across EU jurisdictions

A day in the life

No two days look the same. One day you're negotiating warehouse contracts with a logistics provider in Spain; the next, you're reviewing packaging samples with a French supplier or building a business case for entering a new market. You'll regularly connect with operations leaders across Europe to understand site-level needs, partner with finance on cost models, and join leadership reviews to share your category's performance story. Expect a mix of strategic planning, hands-on supplier management, and occasional travel to facilities and suppliers across Europe. You'll build things that don't exist yet.

About the team

We manage how Amazon's non-inventory supplies - packaging, pallets, grocery logistics materials — move from manufacturers to fulfillment centers across the globe. Our team sits within Global Procurement Organization and operates as a supply chain integrator: we don't just buy things, we design the end-to-end flow from source to site. You'll join a team of six category managers, each owning a distinct supply chain pillar, collaborating across operations, transportation, and finance. We value strategic thinking, builder mindset, and pragmatic execution. We're growing fast and shaping how procurement creates value at continental scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
- Experience managing supplier relationships and conducting competitive sourcing events (RFPs, RFIs, or e-auctions), contract negotiations
- Experience in strategic procurement, category management, or strategic sourcing
- Experience managing procurement categories or supplier portfolios across multiple European countries

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience in logistics, warehousing, or distribution procurement categories
- Experience with packaging materials sourcing or FMCG/retail supply chains
- Familiarity with consignment models, Incoterms pricing, or direct-from-manufacturer procurement
- Proficiency in one or more additional European languages (French, Italian, Spanish, or German)

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Objektmanager (m/w/d)  mit Schwerpunkt Maklergeschäft | Vermietung & Verkauf (Immobilienmakler/in)
jobs.employer: BIVG Brandenburg/H. Immobilien Verwaltungs- gesellschaft mbH
jobs.description:
Immobilien bewirtschaften. Potenziale erkennen. Vermittlungen erfolgreich abschließen.

Die BIVG ist ein etabliertes Immobilienunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf der Verwaltung, Bewirtschaftung und Vermittlung von Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien.

Durch unseren umfangreichen Verwaltungsbestand, langjährige Kundenbeziehungen und eine Vielzahl direkter Eigentümerkontakte erhalten wir regelmäßig Anfragen zur Vermietung, zum Verkauf und zur Einschätzung von Immobilien. Die Nachfrage ist inzwischen so groß, dass wir unseren Maklerbereich personell weiter ausbauen möchten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres bestehenden Teams suchen wir deshalb einen dynamischen kaufmännischen Objektmanager mit Schwerpunkt Maklergeschäft (m/w/d).

Die Position verbindet klassische kaufmännische Objektbewirtschaftung mit einem festen und eigenverantwortlichen Schwerpunkt in der Immobilienvermittlung.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie betreuen gemeinsam mit unserem bestehenden Team Immobilienbestände und übernehmen zugleich einen wesentlichen Teil unseres Maklergeschäfts.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- kaufmännische Betreuung und Bewirtschaftung von Immobilien
- Kommunikation mit Eigentümern, Mietern, Dienstleistern und weiteren Beteiligten
- Aufnahme und Bearbeitung von Verkaufs- und Vermietungsanfragen
- Beratung von Eigentümern zu Vermietung und Verkauf
- Besichtigung und Aufnahme von Immobilien
- marktübliche Einschätzung von Kaufpreisen und Miethöhen
- Vorbereitung geeigneter Vermarktungsstrategien
- Erstellung und Veröffentlichung professioneller Immobilienangebote
- Betreuung und Qualifizierung von Miet- und Kaufinteressenten
- Durchführung von Besichtigungen
- Begleitung von Vertragsverhandlungen
- Vorbereitung von Mietvertragsabschlüssen bzw. Begleitung notarieller Kaufverträge
- Pflege und Dokumentation sämtlicher Vermittlungsvorgänge in unserem CRM-System
- Abstimmung mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Verwaltung, Buchhaltung und Objektbewirtschaftung

Die konkrete Verteilung zwischen Objektmanagement und Maklergeschäft innerhalb Ihrer regulären 37,5-Stunden-Woche richtet sich nach Qualifikation, Erfahrung, persönlicher Schwerpunktsetzung und Auftragslage.

Was Sie mitbringen sollten

Wir suchen eine immobilienwirtschaftlich ausgebildete Persönlichkeit, die Freude am persönlichen Kundenkontakt in der Immobilienvermittlung sowie in der Objektbewirtschaftung hat.

Idealerweise verfügen Sie über:

- eine abgeschlossene immobilienwirtschaftliche Ausbildung, Weiterbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienwirtschaft (insbesondere im Bereich Vermietung & Verkauf)
- praktische Erfahrungen in der Vermietung und/oder im Verkauf von Immobilien
- ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz
- ein sicheres, verbindliches und professionelles Auftreten
- gute Kenntnisse des Immobilienmarktes
- die Fähigkeit zur marktüblichen Einschätzung von Immobilien und Miethöhen
- einen strukturierten und eigenverantwortlichen Arbeitsstil
- Freude an digitalen Arbeitsprozessen
- einen sicheren Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Kommunikationsmitteln
- sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Besonders willkommen sind

- Kenntnisse der grundlegenden Immobilienbewertung oder Wertermittlung
- entsprechende Lehrgänge, Zertifikate oder sonstige Qualifikationsnachweise
- Erfahrungen in der WEG-, Miet- oder Sondereigentumsverwaltung
- Erfahrung bei der Erstellung hochwertiger Exposés für gehobene Verkaufsobjekte
- Kenntnisse in Canva, CorelDRAW oder vergleichbaren Gestaltungsprogrammen
- Kenntnisse im Bereich Online-Marketing und Social Media

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Bei uns übernehmen Sie das Maklergeschäft nicht ohne bestehende Strukturen.

Sie profitieren insbesondere von:

- regelmäßigen Verkaufs- und Vermietungsanfragen aus unserem bestehenden Kunden- und Verwaltungsbestand
- einem etablierten Immobilienunternehmen mit langjährigen Kundenbeziehungen
- einem modernen CRM-System für Immobilien, Interessenten und Vermittlungsvorgänge
- datenschutzkonforme Übersichten über Miet- und Kaufinteressenten mit Suchprofilen
- bestehenden Anzeigenkontingenten auf zahlreichen bekannten Immobilienplattformen
- einem zusätzlichen Budget für die individuelle Vermarktung von Immobilienangeboten
- bei freien Kapazitäten einem zusätzlichen Marketingbudget für die Vermarktung unseres Maklerbereichs
- direktem Zugriff auf vorhandene Objekt- und Verwaltungsinformationen
- kurzen Abstimmungswegen innerhalb eines bestehenden immobilienwirtschaftlichen Teams
- einer regelmäßigen 37,5-Stunden-Woche
- einem festen monatlichen Gehalt
- einer zusätzlichen attraktiven Beteiligung an erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Vermittlungen
- • kostenlosen Weiterbildungsangeboten* (es gelten Bedingungen)

Ihr Festgehalt wird unabhängig vom Vermittlungserfolg als reguläres Arbeitsentgelt gezahlt und stellt keinen Provisionsvorschuss dar.

Die zusätzliche Beteiligung richtet sich nach Qualifikation, Aufgabenumfang und dem von Ihnen übernommenen Anteil am jeweiligen Vermittlungsprozess.

Eine Position für Immobilienprofis mit breitem Interesse

Diese Stelle eignet sich insbesondere für Sie, wenn Sie Immobilien nicht ausschließlich verkaufen möchten, sondern Freude daran haben, Objekte und Eigentümer langfristig zu betreuen und aus der laufenden Bewirtschaftung heraus neue Potenziale für Vermietung und Verkauf zu erkennen.

Sie arbeiten dabei nicht als Einzelakteur, sondern als Teil eines bestehenden Teams mit kurzen Wegen und umfassendem immobilienwirtschaftlichem Hintergrund.

Wenn Sie fachliche Immobilienkenntnisse, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Maklergeschäft miteinander verbinden möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

jobs.employer: BIVG Brandenburg/H. Immobilien Verwaltungs- gesellschaft mbH
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
WEG-Buchhalter/in; Buchhalter/in Immobilienwirtschaft; Steuerfachangestellte/r mit Interesse an Immobilien; Kaufmann der Grundstücks- und Wohnungswirtschaft

Stellenbeschreibung:
Ihre Karriere als Immobilienbuchhalter/in beginnt hier.

Die BIVG Brandenburg/H. Immobilien Verwaltungsgesellschaft mbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen der privaten Immobilienwirtschaft in Brandenburg an der Havel mit mehr als 25 Beschäftigten.

Seit über 33 Jahren verwalten wir Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien sowie Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften. Dabei stehen wir für eine moderne, zuverlässige und fachlich anspruchsvolle Immobilienverwaltung.

Zur Verstärkung unseres bestehenden Buchhaltungsteams suchen wir eine kaufmännisch qualifizierte Persönlichkeit mit gutem Zahlenverständnis, Freude an digitalen Arbeitsprozessen und dem Wunsch, gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Fachkolleginnen und Fachkollegen hochwertige Arbeitsergebnisse zu erstellen.

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld und Aufgabenbereich

Sie arbeiten innerhalb eines bestehenden Teams und übernehmen für einen fest zugeordneten Immobilienbestand insbesondere:

- laufende objektbezogene Einnahmen- und Ausgabenbuchhaltung
- Weiterverarbeitung geprüfter Eingangsrechnungen einschließlich Kontierung und Zahlungsabwicklung
- computergestützte Verarbeitung und Verbuchung von Kontoumsätzen
- Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung
- Kontenprüfung und Kontenabstimmung
- Überwachung offener Forderungen und kaufmännisches Mahnwesen
- digitale Kautionsbuchhaltung
- Mitwirkung bei Hausgeld-, Jahres-, Betriebs- und Nebenkostenabrechnungen
- Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Wirtschaftsplänen und Vermögensberichten
- Abstimmung mit Teamleitungen, Immobilienverwaltern und weiteren Mitarbeitern der Buchhaltung
- Vorbereitung fachlich fundierter Arbeitsergebnisse zur abschließenden Prüfung durch die zuständigen Teamleitungen
- Pflege buchhalterischer und objektbezogener Daten in unseren ERP- und Fachsystemen

Je nach Qualifikation und Interesse können Sie sich zusätzlich in weiterführende kaufmännische Aufgaben einarbeiten. Hierzu kann beispielsweise die wirtschaftliche Vorbereitung größerer Bau- und Investitionsmaßnahmen gehören, etwa durch:

- Ermittlung und Abstimmung des Finanzierungsbedarfs
- Einholung und Vergleich geeigneter Finanzierungsvorschläge
- Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Finanzierungskosten

Warum Ihre Arbeit bei uns wichtig ist

Eine professionelle Immobilienverwaltung funktioniert nur mit einer verlässlichen Buchhaltung.

Hausgeldabrechnungen, Wirtschaftspläne und Vermögensberichte gehören zu den Kernaufgaben einer WEG-Verwaltung. Auch Betriebs- und Nebenkostenabrechnungen, laufende Zahlungen sowie die wirtschaftliche Vorbereitung von Instandhaltungs- und Investitionsmaßnahmen bauen auf einer sorgfältigen und nachvollziehbaren Buchhaltung auf.

Ein belastbarer Wirtschaftsplan stellt beispielsweise sicher, dass Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften ihre laufenden Verpflichtungen erfüllen und geplante Maßnahmen finanzieren können. Fehlerhafte Planungen können dagegen unmittelbar die wirtschaftliche Handlungsfähigkeit einer Gemeinschaft beeinträchtigen.

Unsere Arbeitsergebnisse genießen bei unseren Kunden und Auftraggebern sowie bei Sachverständigen, Wirtschaftsprüfern und anderen professionellen Marktteilnehmern ein hohes Vertrauen.

Auch wenn der unmittelbare Kundenkontakt überwiegend durch andere Fachbereiche erfolgt, bleibt Ihre Arbeit bei uns nicht unsichtbar. Wir machen gute Leistungen bewusst sichtbar und lassen unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter am gemeinsamen Erfolg teilhaben.

Das bringen Sie mit

Sie müssen nicht bereits jedes Detail der Immobilienbuchhaltung beherrschen. Entscheidend sind für uns eine solide kaufmännische Grundlage, gutes Zahlenverständnis und die Bereitschaft, sich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir wünschen uns insbesondere:

- abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung
- praktische Kenntnisse in der Buchhaltung
- gutes Zahlenverständnis und Freude an kaufmännischen Zusammenhängen
- strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
- Organisationsfähigkeit und selbstständige Steuerung des eigenen Aufgabenbereichs
- Freude an digitalen Arbeitsprozessen sowie ERP- und Fachsystemen
- Teamfähigkeit und Freude an fachlicher Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zum gegenseitigen Wissens- und Erfahrungsaustausch
- Interesse an regelmäßiger fachlicher und persönlicher Weiterbildung
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Verlässlichkeit

Immobilienwirtschaftliche Vorkenntnisse sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Besonders geeignet ist die Stelle beispielsweise für:

- Immobilienkaufleute
- Steuerfachangestellte
- Finanzbuchhalter
- kaufmännische Mitarbeiter mit Buchhaltungserfahrung
- Kaufleute für Büromanagement mit entsprechendem Schwerpunkt
- vergleichbar qualifizierte kaufmännische Fachkräfte

Wer bereits sicher mit Buchhaltungsprozessen umgehen kann, erhält von uns die notwendige Unterstützung, um sich in die Besonderheiten der Immobilien- und WEG-Buchhaltung einzuarbeiten.

Benötigte Deutschkenntnisse

Für die Tätigkeit setzen wir Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf dem Sprachniveau C1 in Wort und Schrift voraus.

Sie arbeiten regelmäßig mit buchhalterischen, immobilienwirtschaftlichen und teilweise rechtlich geprägten Sachverhalten, müssen komplexe Unterlagen sicher erfassen und sich fachlich präzise mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Teamleitungen abstimmen. Ein sehr gutes Sprachverständnis ist daher für eine eindeutige, nachvollziehbare und fehlerfreie Bearbeitung erforderlich.

So arbeiten wir zusammen

Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind in feste Teams mit eigenen Objektbeständen integriert und arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Buchhaltern, Immobilienverwaltern und Teamleitungen zusammen.

Eine permanente gegenseitige Kontrolle entspricht nicht unserem Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit. Wir erwarten deshalb strukturiertes, nachvollziehbares und zuverlässiges Arbeiten sowie die notwendige kaufmännische Sorgfalt.

Gleichzeitig wird bei uns niemand mit fachlichen Fragen allein gelassen. Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, definierte Prozesse und erfahrene Ansprechpartner schaffen hierfür die Grundlage.

Wir wünschen uns Mitarbeiter, die den fachlichen Austausch schätzen und ihr Wissen auch selbst gerne weitergeben.

Ausbildung und Wissen weitergeben

Als zugelassener Ausbildungsbetrieb der IHK und dualer Partner mehrerer Hochschulen gehört die Förderung junger Menschen zu unserem Unternehmensalltag.

Unser Ausbildungsteam aus drei Ausbildern betreut regelmäßig Auszubildende, Werkstudierende und dual Studierende.

Besonders freuen wir uns über Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die ihr Wissen in Abstimmung mit unserem Ausbildungspersonal gerne weitergeben und bei Bedarf fachliche Zusammenhänge oder betriebliche Abläufe erklären. Eine formale Ausbildertätigkeit ist hierfür nicht erforderlich.

Das bieten wir Ihnen

Bei uns erwartet Sie ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem familiengeführten Immobilienunternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hohem fachlichen Qualitätsanspruch.

Wir bieten Ihnen unter anderem:

- gute und leistungsgerechte Bezahlung
- Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
- individuell abgestimmte Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersversorgung
- Beteiligung an den Kosten der Kinderbetreuung
- Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
- strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung
- Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenem Fachpersonal
- regelmäßige fachliche Fort- und Weiterbildung
- Übernahme geeigneter Weiterbildungskosten durch den Arbeitgeber
- aktive Vorschläge für passende Weiterbildungsangebote
- Bereitstellung von Fachliteratur
- moderne digitale Arbeitsprozesse und spezialisierte Softwarelösungen
- Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
- kurze Entscheidungswege
- kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld
- langfristige berufliche Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Einzelkämpfer.

Gute Immobilienverwaltung ist für uns immer das Ergebnis gemeinsamer Arbeit. Deshalb wünschen wir uns Menschen, die ihren eigenen Aufgabenbereich zuverlässig organisieren und gleichzeitig den fachlichen Austausch mit Kollegen schätzen.

Lebenslanges Lernen ist für uns ein selbstverständlicher Bestandteil guter beruflicher Entwicklung. Wir suchen daher Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, die neugierig bleiben, ihr Wissen erweitern und offen für neue fachliche und digitale Entwicklungen sind.

Wenn Sie eine kaufmännische Ausbildung abgeschlossen haben, gerne mit Zahlen arbeiten und einen Arbeitsplatz suchen, an dem Ihre Arbeit gesehen, geschätzt und fachlich weiterentwickelt wird, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
