jobs.title: Financial Controller, Group Consolidation, Mehiläinen, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in an inspiring work community in a leading European social and healthcare sector company? If your answer is yes, you could be a new member of our team!

We are looking for a Financial Controller to our Group Consolidation Team in Helsinki!

Mehiläinen Group is a well-known and highly respected private provider of healthcare and social care services, offering comprehensive high-quality care in Finland, Sweden, Germany, Lithuania, Estonia, Romania, and Serbia. Mehiläinen also offers digital healthcare software solutions through its subsidiary, BeeHealthy. Founded in 1909, Mehiläinen is a rapidly developing and growing leader in the industry with pro forma revenue of 3.1 billion euros in 2025. With 55,000 professionals and a network of more than 1,450 locations, Mehiläinen serves 5.2 million patients each year. Mehiläinen operates under the Meliva brand in Sweden, Estonia, Lithuania and Germany; under the Regina Maria brand in Romania; and under the MediGroup brand in Serbia.

About the Role
As a Financial Controller, you will be an integral part of our Group consolidation team. You will collaborate closely with finance colleagues and other stakeholders in all our operating countries. Our team is responsible for Mehiläinen's annual and interim reports, IFRS accounting principles, and the consolidation system Anaplan. Additionally, we play an important role in ensuring accurate CSRD reporting. Mehiläinens international M&A activity is visible in our teams day-to-day work, and characteristics of a rapidly growing company are visible in our work. The role can be tailored to some extent based on the candidate's competence and background.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare Mehiläinen's financial statements, interim reports and trustworthy monthly financial reporting and analyses together with the team

Monthly group consolidation tasks together with the team

Controlling tasks for IFRS16 lease accounting in Fatman and preparing IFRS16 journal entries

Participate in and develop Mehiläinens CSRD reporting capabilities

Participate in Mehiläinens internal controls testing

Admin and maintenance tasks in our consolidation tool Anaplan

Participate in development projects


To succeed in this role, we expect you to have the following:

Qualifications & experience:
A relevant higher university degree (e.g., MSc Econ)

A few years of experience in financial accounting, group accounting or background in auditing

Understanding of consolidation systems, accounting systems and finance processes

Understanding of IFRS, or suitable background and interest to adopt certain IFRS standards quickly

Strong excel skills and motivation to develop technical solutions to improve our reporting

Fluent in Finnish and English, we prepare materials in both languages

Interest and capabilities in technical solutions (eg. databases, SQL, PBI) are seen as an advantage


Skills & Attributes:
Ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality and outcomes

Stress tolerance and adaptability in a dynamic environment

Comfortable working in English with colleagues from other countries


Why join Mehiläinen?
We are all committed to acting in line with our values, and we believe the best results come from giving our experts freedom, responsibility, community, and opportunities to grow. We offer the opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions in a challenging and diverse role, alongside a professional and supportive team. You can choose your own work equipment, enjoy a variety of activities to balance work life, and have the opportunity to work flexibly in a hybrid setup.

Interested? Apply Now!
If this exciting opportunity aligns with your career aspirations, please submit your application, including your salary expectations, through our recruitment system by 21st of September 2026. We will be reviewing applications and interviewing suitable candidates on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply promptly. Work starts according to the agreement.

For more details about the position, please contact:
Head of Group Reporting Jukka Rekonen
jukka.rekonen@mehilainen.fi
tel. 040338 0215 (Available for calls on Friday 11th of September at 10-11 and Friday 18th of September at 10-11)

jobs.title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
jobs.description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English

**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä


**Arvostamme:**

- Kykyä kannatella samanaikaisesti useita lankoja

- Sujuvia tiimi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Positiivista otetta ja kehittämishalua


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Toimitusjohtaja Teemu Vanharanta, teemu.vanharanta@panchovilla.fi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen **rekry@panchovilla.fi** viimeistään **25.9.2026**. Toimi kuitenkin nopeasti, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajan puitteissa ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

jobs.title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

jobs.title: Internal Controls System Specialist Nordics

As an ICS Specialist, you will work across the organization to identify risks, strengthen internal controls, and drive improvements that safeguard our assets and ensure high-quality financial reporting. - Ensuring Segregation of Duties (SoD), including review and monitoring of critical authorizations in ERP systems

- Liaising with internal and external auditors

- Masters degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

- 3-5 years experience in Internal Controls, Audit, Finance or Risk Management.

- Experience in an industrial sector or manufacturing is preferred

- Proficiency in ERP systems and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint); Tagetik and Qlik Sense are a plus.

- Fluency in English.


**Y**ou are a proactive and detail-oriented professional who enjoys balancing risk with business growth. Collaboration comes naturally to you - you build strong relationships across teams and are comfortable influencing stakeholders. If youre passionate about continuous improvement and have a knack for spotting trends and opportunities, youll fit right in.

**What we can offer you:**

- Diverse tasks and varied workdays

- Safe working environment

- Skilled and supportive colleagues

- Comprehensive employee benefits: Enjoy our cultural, fitness, and wellness perks, supported lunches, extensive occupational health care, and a motivating bonus system.

- Training and development opportunities

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
jobs.description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

jobs.title: Math Modeler
jobs.description:
The team of Wärtsilä marine engineering simulators is looking forMath Modeller. You can become part of a team which works on a market leader product (45% market share) that imitates marine engineering functionality for vessels. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland but also Turku, Finland is negotiable. We offer a possibility to hybrid work.

Main responsibilities:
* Develop from the scratch for dynamic math models of vessel equipment and systems.
* Create front-end side of simulators.
* Compile technical documentation for these models.
* Maintain existing models.
* Take a part in agile activities.


To be successful in this position, we expect you to:
* Bs or MS in physics, applied math, engineering or similar field.
* Practical experience in imitation modelling of physical systems.
* Basic knowledge of numerical methods for solving PDE and DAE.
* Basic knowledge of OOP approach or any OOP language.
* Be able to formulate a problem correctly and plan ways to solve it.
* English intermediate or higher.
* Be agile.


We will be amazed if you have (but not mandatory):
* Be familiar with Open Modelica or any Modelica-based language.
* Be able to quickly master new tools.
* Have a background in marine engineering.


Practical experience in imitation modelling required in one of the areas:
* Hydraulics (gravity flow, pumping through pipeline, pump characteristics, pipeline elements resistance, Bernoulli equation, two-phase media flow (liquid + gas)).
* Heat Transfer (heat capacity of materials – solid, liquids, gases; heat exchange between various media; temperature transfer & temperature resistance of materials).
* Thermodynamics (ideal gas laws; real gas specifics; main thermodynamics parameters and characteristics, its interdependencies; thermodynamics laws; phase transitions).
* Mechanics (kinematics and dynamics of rigid body, rotational dynamics equations; mechanical energy parameters and equations, mechanical energy transitions, inertia characteristics; simple mechanisms).
* Automation and regulation (main principals and parameters; governors (controllers) – main types and work principals; controlled system parameters and dynamic).


Why you and us?
We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.
We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?
We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact and next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.
Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Secretary General of UArctic
jobs.description:
UArctic (University of the Arctic) is an international network of universities, colleges, research institutes, and other organizations committed to education, research, and collaboration in and about the Arctic. UArctic brings together members from across the circumpolar North and beyond to strengthen knowledge exchange, capacity building, and sustainable development.

The UArctic International Secretariat is hosted by the University of Lapland in Rovaniemi, Finland. We are now seeking a visionary and experienced leader to serve as Secretary General of UArctic and Head of the UArctic International Secretariat.

The Secretary General serves as the chief administrative officer and legal representative of UArctic and plays a key role in ensuring effective governance, strategic coordination, and organizational sustainability across the global UArctic network.

The position is located at the UArctic International Secretariat in Rovaniemi. The Secretary General reports to the President of UArctic, the UArctic Board of Governors, and the University of Lapland. UArctic is legally registered as an association in Finland (UArctic ry). Approximately 20% of the position is allocated to duties defined by the leadership of the University of Lapland.

What you will do

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day operations of the UArctic International Secretariat.

- Ensure the implementation of UArctic's Constitution, Bylaws, and strategic decisions made by the Board of Governors and the Assembly.

- Provide executive support to the President and Board in the preparation, coordination, and documentation of meetings, decisions, and initiatives.

- Lead UArctic together with the President, Executive Vice-President, and the Senior Executive Management Group.

- Facilitate communication and collaboration among UArctic governance bodies, including UArctic staff, member institutions, and external partners.

- Oversee member recruitment and member engagement processes.

- Support the implementation of UArctic's strategic objectives, particularly in governance, partnerships, and long-term sustainability.

- Represent UArctic in international forums and stakeholder relations.

- Serve as the principal legal officer of UArctic ry and ensure compliance with Finnish legislation, applicable international regulations, and UArctic governing documents.

- Act as authorized signatory of UArctic ry in official legal and contractual matters.

- Ensure responsible financial stewardship, including budget preparation, financial reporting, and oversight of internal controls.

What We Offer

We offer a unique opportunity to lead one of the most significant international higher education and knowledge networks focused on the Arctic region. You will work at the heart of international Arctic cooperation and contribute to strengthening research, education, and sustainable development across the circumpolar North and beyond.

What we expect from you

The successful candidate will have:

- An advanced degree in a relevant field.

- Proven leadership experience in an international, university-based, governmental, intergovernmental, or comparable organization.

- Strong knowledge of governance structures, legal frameworks, and financial administration.

- Excellent intercultural communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.

- Fluency in English.

- Proficiency in Finnish and in additional languages is considered an asset.

We also value:

- Familiarity with Arctic issues and northern cooperation networks.

- Demonstrated experience and success in supervisory and people leadership roles.

- Excellent collaboration, networking, and teamworking skills.

- The ability to lead complex international partnerships and stakeholder processes.

- Experience working in multicultural environments and across different sectors.

Further information on the position

For further information about the position, please contact Director of Internationalisation Services Mari Putaansuu (mari.putaansuu@ulapland.fi, +358 44 478 0249). Enquiries are welcome on 17 September 2026 between 9:00 and 10:00 (EEST) and on 22 September 2026 between 14:00 and 15:00 (EEST).

Address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: permanent from March 2027 or as agreed
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The starting monthly salary level is approximately 7499-7693e. The salary is determined on the basis of level 14 for other expert and support staff, from the salary system of the general collective agreement for universities (Sivista). In addition, a salary component based on personal performance is paid, up to a maximum of 50%.

Appointment

The Secretary General is appointed by the leadership of the University of Lapland in collaboration with the UArctic Board of Governors, in accordance with the UArctic Constitution and Bylaws.

University of Lapland

The University of Lapland is an international science and art university located in the City of Rovaniemi on the Arctic Circle. Our university creates new knowledge, skills and competence from the arctic perspective – for the North and for the world. Our fields of education and research include educational science, law, art and design, social sciences, and northern and arctic perspectives. Our strategic choices focus on global arctic responsibility, sustainable tourism, future services and governing distances.

jobs.title: KotiAvustajat - yrittäjä
jobs.description:
KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja Vantaalle

Haemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.

KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.

Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.

Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.

Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.

Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

jobs.title: Resort Manager
jobs.description:
Sonka Resort, Finnish Lapland | Full-time, year-round | Start date: 1 October 2026

Sonka Resort is looking for an experienced and hands-on Resort Supervisor to coordinate daily operations, support the team and ensure a consistently high-quality guest experience. Part of Arctic GM Experiences, Sonka Resort combines accommodation, guest services and Arctic experiences in Finnish Lapland.

The Role

As Resort Supervisor, you will oversee the resorts daily activities across reception, housekeeping and maintenance. You will set daily priorities, delegate tasks, follow up on their completion and work alongside the team whenever needed.

You will handle routine operational matters independently, report to company management and coordinate with management on decisions involving budgets, purchases or other major matters.

Key responsibilities

\- Welcome and assist guests throughout their stay

\- Coordinate daily priorities and delegate tasks to the resort team

\- Follow up to ensure tasks and management assignments are completed

\- Support the team during busy periods and resolve day-to-day operational issues

\- Maintain high standards of guest service, cleanliness and resort presentation

\- Carry out regular property inspections and follow up on maintenance needs

\- Keep booking information, availability and guest-facing information accurate

\- Provide management with clear operational updates

\- Identify problems early, suggest practical solutions and improve daily routines

About You

We are looking for someone with hospitality experience, preferably within a hotel, resort or similar operation. You can take responsibility without needing constant direction, while understanding when management approval is required.

You are:

\- Proactive, resourceful and able to think outside the box

\- Confident in coordinating and supporting a team

\- Structured, reliable and hands-on

\- Guest-focused with strong attention to quality

\- Calm and solution-oriented when priorities change

\- Fluent in English

\- A holder of a valid Category B driving licence recognised in Finland

\-Already authorised to work in Finland without employer sponsorship

Experience in international hospitality, winter destinations or high-volume operations is considered an advantage.

Why Sonka Resort?

This is a responsible, year-round supervisory position where you can make a genuine difference to the daily operation and guest experience. You will work closely with company management while coordinating the team and ensuring that the resort runs smoothly.

Apply Please send your CV and a short introduction to isa@sonka.fi. Applications are reviewed continuously.

jobs.title: Project Controls Manager

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

We are looking first and foremost for hands-on implementers with a proven record of taking real industrial or infrastructure projects from planning through procurement, construction, commissioning and operation.

The roles are part of an international renewable-energy, circular-economy, biorefining and industrial side-stream utilisation investment programme with Côte dIvoire as the principal implementation country. The portfolio includes both fast-start production projects and later large-scale industrial investments.

A reasonable level of working English is essential. French language skills are a major advantage.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: VVS-Montør søges
jobs.description:
Erfaren VVS-montør søges

Vil du være en del af en veldrevet virksomhed med høj faglighed, stor frihed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

Niels Mølgaard ApS søger en dygtig og engageret VVS-montør, der er klar til nye udfordringer og ønsker at blive en del af et professionelt team med fokus på kvalitet, service og godt håndværk.

Trives du i en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, ansvar og tæt kontakt til kunder? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen

Med reference til afdelingslederen bliver du en del af en veletableret og dynamisk VVS-installationsvirksomhed, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er centrale værdier.

Hos os er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på godt kollegaskab, sammenhold, humor og en positiv omgangstone i hverdagen. Du får primært arbejdsområde i Aarhus og omegn, hvor du kommer til at servicere både private- og erhvervskunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med spændende opgaver inden for:

• Service- og reparationsarbejde for private kunder, erhvervskunder og boligforeninger

• Renoverings- og ombygningsprojekter

• Energioptimering og energirenoveringer

• Mindre entrepriser

• Fejlfinding, vedligeholdelse og kundeservice

Arbejdet udføres hovedsageligt i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og fast job i en solid virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• Stor grad af frihed under ansvar i et velfungerende team af kompetente og erfarne kolleger

• En flad organisation med kort vej fra idé til handling og solid administrativ opbakning i hverdagen

• Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, firmabil og smartphone til rådighed

• Moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, herunder komplet blikkenslagerværksted

• Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling gennem kurser og efteruddannelse

• Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt fællesskab

Vi forventer, at du

• Er uddannet VVS-montør og gerne kompetent erfaring

• Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

• Har fokus på kvalitet og god service

• Er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager positivt til teamet

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag

• Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

Tiltrædelse

Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@nmvvs.dk med emnet "VVS-montør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega hos Niels Mølgaard ApS.

Om virksomheden

Niels Mølgaard ApS er en familieejet virksomhed, etableret i 1984, og er i dag blandt Østjyllands førende specialister inden for VVS, energi og blik. Virksomheden løser opgaver for både private kunder, erhverv og entrepriser og har stor fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og godt håndværk. Med ca. 30 medarbejdere og løbende efteruddannelse af alle ansatte tilbyder Niels Mølgaard ApS et professionelt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. Virksomheden har adresse i Højbjerg ved Aarhus og omfatter desuden søsterselskaberne NME Ejendomsadministration og VVS-shoppen.dk

jobs.title: Compliance Advisor - Framework & Monitoring (FATCA/CRS) (Fixed-Term contract until end of 2026)(M/F)
jobs.description:
Compliance Advisor - Framework & Monitoring (FATCA/CRS) (Fixed-Term contract until end of 2026)(M/F)

Luxembourg
req1153

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Compliance Officer - Framework & Monitoring to join our Compliance team. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the Bank's compliance framework, with a particular focus on the oversight and monitoring of FATCA and Common Reporting Standard (CRS) obligations.

As a second-line-of-defense function, you will be responsible for assessing the effectiveness of first-line controls, monitoring regulatory compliance, identifying risks, and supporting the ongoing development of governance and control frameworks related to tax transparency regulations.

Your next challenge:

Compliance Framework & Governance

• Contribute to the development, maintenance and enhancement of the Compliance Framework in line with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
• Draft, review and update policies, procedures and control standards related to FATCA, CRS and tax transparency obligations.
• Support the implementation of new regulatory requirements and compliance initiatives.
• Provide day-to-day guidance on compliance topics in collaboration with Tax department, Tax Operations, KYC Office and/or Legal teams.

Monitoring & Second-Line Controls

• Design and execute second-line compliance monitoring and testing activities on FATCA/CRS and other AML processes.
• Assess the effectiveness of first-line controls covering client onboarding, due diligence, classification, documentation, remediation and reporting obligations.
• Analyse control results and provide recommendations to strengthen the control environment
• Monitor corrective action plans and ensure timely remediation of identified issues.

Your skills:

• University degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Compliance, Regulatory Risk, Internal Control or Audit within the financial services industry.
• Good knowledge of FATCA/CRS and AML regulations and their practical implementation within banking or financial institutions.
• Experience conducting compliance monitoring reviews, control testing or second-line oversight activities.
• Familiarity with client due diligence, tax classification and regulatory reporting processes.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills.
• Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure timely delivery of monitoring activities and regulatory commitments.
• Excellent attention to detail and ability to assess complex regulatory requirements.
• Ability to challenge constructively and influence stakeholders across different levels of the organization.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

• Knowledge of Luxembourg regulatory environment would be considered an advantage.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events
Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills

• Experience with dynamic system modeling or willingness to develop this quickly

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Arval
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced lawyer with a generalist mindset? Are you ready to join a Nordic in-house legal team as its sole lawyer based in Finland?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Arval** as a new **(Senior) Legal Counsel**!

**_Arval, BNP Paribas Group Company,_** _was founded in 1989 as a specialist in full-service vehicle leasing and new mobility solutions for its customers, ranging from international groups to smaller companies and individual retail clients. More recently, Arval has diversified its business to become a key player in integrated mobility, addressing a wider audience that includes drivers and private individuals. Arval has over 8600 employees operating in 28 countries with over 1,800,00 leased vehicles._

**As BNP Paribas's in-house lawyer**, you will advise Arval's Nordic business, with focus on Finland. This is a versatile role, and your responsibilities will cover the following areas:

- **Contractual matters:** You will draft and revise contracts with a focus on operational leasing, consumer law, public procurement, insurance distribution, and competition law and data protection.


- **Contract negotiations:** You will support in contract negotiations with customers, partners and suppliers.


- **Ongoing legal support:** You will support particularly Finnish business units in all legal matters (excluding tax and employment law). You will identify and assess legal risks, advise the business on legal matters, and provide regular training.


- **Template updates:** You will develop and maintain legal templates and other documentation.


- **Regulatory monitoring and risk mitigation:** You will monitor applicable legal and regulatory changes and assist in mitigating any resulting legal risks, including by ensuring necessary revisions to legal documentation, policies, and procedures.


- **Strategic legal development:** In addition to day-to-day operational work, you will manage legal projects and contribute to group-wide legal initiatives.


While your primary focus is to support Arval's business units, you will also regularly assist the Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) business line of BNP Paribas. You will spend approximately one working day a week in the BNP Paribas Helsinki office, offering legal support to the CIB business line in the Nordics. This will include advising on transactional matters as well as legal and regulatory projects. You will work closely with the CIB Legal Nordics team and other Nordic legal teams of BNP Paribas Group and business partners assisting them with legal advice linked to Finnish operations.

This position will be mainly based at Arval Finland's office in Vantaa, and you will report to the Regional Head of Legal Nordics Arval, based in Stockholm. BNP Paribas's branch office is in Helsinki city center. Based on Arval's hybrid model, you can work remotely two days a week.

**You may be the person we're looking for if:**

- you have a Finnish Master of Laws degree and ideally 7 to 9 years of relevant professional experience working as an in-house legal counsel and/or at a law firm – international working experience and previous experience in an industrial environment or in finance is considered a plus;

- you are a generalist with a solid background within multiple legal areas and the ability to engage in new legal areas. Some of the areas of law for which we expect you to have solid background is contract and consumer law, public procurement as well as data protection. Experience in AML/CFT regulatory frameworks is a plus. Background in transactional and regulatory legal matters in the financial sector in Finland is an advantage but not a requirement. Ideally, you also have experience providing legal advice and assistance in insurance contract matters;

- you have an independent and solution-driven approach and a proven ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice;

- you are a collaborative team player with a strong sense of integrity;

- you have a strong analytical judgement and the ability to assess complex legal and regulatory matters; and

- you have great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish – knowledge in Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is considered a plus.


**Arval offers you:**

- a pivotal legal role with impact on business decisions: you will be a trusted advisor to management and key stakeholders in the Nordics;

- a role with a wide scope of legal matters across multiple areas and countries, along with opportunities for professional development;

- a high degree of autonomy and responsibility, along with a strong level of trust;

- a professional working environment with an international profile; and

- an inclusive and inspiring company culture with supportive colleagues and a great team spirit.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **20 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi).

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

jobs.description:
Do naší party hledáme šikovného kolegu, který se nebojí vzít do ruky nářadí, přemýšlí technicky a má rád poctivě odvedenou práci. Pokud vás láká podílet se na vzniku strojů, které nejsou sériovou výrobou, ale originálním řešením pro konkrétní zákazníky, rádi vás poznáme.

Jsme rodinná firma zaměřená na vývoj a výrobu automatizovaných linek a jednoúčelových strojů. Pracujeme na projektech, které dávají smysl, a hledáme kolegu, který chce růst společně s námi.

Co bude vaším výsledkem práce?
Sestavené a funkční části strojů připravené pro oživení a předání zákazníkovi.
Kvalitně provedené montáže podle technické dokumentace.
Spolehlivě odvedené servisní a montážní práce u zákazníků.
Precizně opracované díly a komponenty připravené pro další výrobu (broušení, jehlení, řezání závitů apod.).

Koho hledáme?
Hledáme člověka, který:
má technické myšlení,
orientuje se ve výkresové dokumentaci,
rozumí mechanice a ideálně zná pneumatické prvky,
je manuálně zručný a pečlivý,
dokáže pracovat samostatně a dotahuje práci do konce,
vlastní řidičský průkaz skupiny B.

Co nabízíme?
Jednosměnný provoz.
Příspěvek na stravování a možnost stravování v závodní jídelně.
Práci na zajímavých zakázkách a unikátních strojích.
Přátelský kolektiv a zázemí stabilní rodinné firmy.
Možnost rychlého profesního růstu a dalšího rozvoje.

Pro koho je tato práce ideální?
Pro člověka, který nechce dělat stále totéž dokola, baví ho technika, rád hledá řešení a chce vidět konkrétní výsledek své práce.

Pokud jste se v tom našli, pošlete nám svůj životopis  a získejte možnost pracovat pro špičkovou firmu v oboru.

jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En postulant à cette offre, vous aurez l'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise innovante, née de l'alliance entre l'agilité d'une startup et l'envergure d'un leader mondial du supply chain retail. Spécialisée dans les solutions technologiques de pointe pour le retail moderne, cette entité construit les moteurs de décision basés sur l'IA qui optimisent en temps réel les opérations en magasin sur des dizaines de millions de séries temporelles (forecasting probabiliste de la demande, planification de production, pricing dynamique Ils sont à la recherche d'un(e) AI Engineer pour posséder des features IA de bout en bout et assumer la responsabilité directe de leur impact business : moins de gaspillage, moins de ruptures et plus de marge visibles sur le terrain dès le lendemain.

Vos missions si vous les acceptez Posséder des features IA de bout en bout, du cadrage du besoin à la conception, au build, à l'intégration produit et au déploiement en production.***Assurer la responsabilité du cycle de vie complet des modèles : feature engineering, entraînement, évaluation et monitoring.***Faire progresser le cœur technologique de forecasting et d'optimisation (gestion de la demande censurée par les ruptures, estimation du gaspillage, détection d'anomalies d'inventaire Concevoir des systèmes auto-améliorants grâce à des boucles de feedback mesurant la qualité des décisions en production pour accorder automatiquement les modèles.***Contribuer à l'infrastructure agentique à grande échelle orchestrant les pipelines et servant les produits.***Diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances en production, du patch d'urgence à la mise en place de solutions durables.***Faire le pont entre la technique et le business en expliquant les sous-performances et en proposant des solutions viables commercialement et techniquement.

Description du profil :

Et vous Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac+5 obligatoire issu d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master spécialisé en IA avec un profil quantitatif fort.***Vous disposez d'au moins 1 an d'expérience minimum (hors stages et alternances) en tant que AI Engineer ou ML Engineer.***Vous avez un track record prouvé de mise en production de modèles ML (pas uniquement de la R&D) dans des environnements où le taux de service est critique.***Vous possédez une excellente culture ML générale (Transformers, modèles de fondation, mécanismes d'attention) et maîtrisez parfaitement Python.***Vous maîtrisez au moins un cloud provider (GCP, AWS ou autre).Vous parlez un anglais courant et un français courant.***Vous êtes doté d'une culture de 'builder' : créatif, autonome, axé sur l'ownership total et prêt à faire tout ce qu'il faut pour délivrer.
