Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19 i 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26.), ne stariju od dana objave natječaja, Prednost pri zapošljavanju: Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine 157/ 13, 152/ 14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dužni su priložiti i odgovarajuće dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Način prijave: Prijave s dokumentacijom se šalju e-mailom, osobno ili na adresu: DJEČJI VRTIĆ "TRNORUŽICA" ULICA FERDE RUSANA 11, ZAGREB uz naznaku: „Za natječaj – Odgojitelj/ica" Ostale napomene: • Nepotpune, nepravodobne ili nepotpisane prijave neće se razmatrati. • Priložena dokumentacija ne vraća se kandidatima. • Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. • U skladu sa člankom 13. stavak 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08,69/17) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. • Izrazi iz teksta natječaja rodnog značenja koriste se neutralno i jednako su primjenjivi na muški i ženski rod. Rezultati natječaja bit će objavljeni na mrežnoj stranici Vrtića: www.vrtic-trnoruzica.zagreb.hr u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata.

jobs.title: KUĆNI MAJSTOR/KUĆNA MAJSTORICA
jobs.description:
Obavlja jednostavnije poslove održavanja i popravke: instalacije, elektroinstalacije, 
vodovodne instalacije, grijanje i druge poslove u hotelu. 
 
Izvršava sve radove na preventivnom i tekućem održavanju postrojenja. 
Vodi evidenciju o primljenom i utrošenom materijalu. 
Dužan je voditi knjigu izvršenih radova s unošenjem podataka o vremenu i vrsti posla 
koji je izvršen, te popis vrsta i količina utrošenog materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Sudjeluje u godišnjem remontu strojeva i instalacija. 
 
Odgovoran je za primjenu mjera zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara na objektima, 
instalacijama, strojevima i uređajima, te za zaštitu okoliša hotela. 
Svakodnevno kontrolira Knjigu kvarova i vodi računa o njihovom promptnom 
uklanjanju. 
Predlaže voditelju poboljšanje sustava održavanja i ukazuje na stanje zaliha 
materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Savjesno se odnosi prema opremi i sredstvima rada. 
Vodi tehničku dokumentaciju i potrebne evidencije. 
Sudjeluje u nabavci potrošnog materijala i rezervnih dijelova. 
Održava čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i strojeva. 
Kontrolira i primjenjuje mjere i sredstva zaštite na radu. 
Obavlja i ostale poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.         
 
poželjno radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ODGOJITELJICA
jobs.description:
Dječji vrtić „Naša radost“ Pregrada

Stjepana Škreblina 1

49218 Pregrada

Tel. 049 377 489

e-mail: dv.nasaradost@pregrada.hr

KLASA: 112-01/26-01/29

URBROJ: 2214-41-02-26-1

Pregrada, 4.9.2026.

Na temelju članka. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26), članka 47. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Naša radost“ Pregrada i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 31.8.2026. godine raspisuje se

N A T J E Č A J

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

za radno mjesto ODGOJITELJ/ICA

- 1 izvršitelj/ica na određeno puno radno vrijeme (zamjena za nenazočnu djelatnicu)

UVJETI za radno mjesto:

- Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih šest mjeseci života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij za Rani i predškolski odgoj propisan Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24 i 62/25) i razine obrazovanja za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti:

a) sveučilišni prijediplomski studij,

b) stručni prijediplomski studij,

c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima,

d) sveučilišni diplomski studij,

e) stručni diplomski studij.

  • Uvjeti iz članka 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26)
  • Utvrđena zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta
  • Probni rad od 6 mjeseci

U prijavi za natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  • zamolba – prijava na natječaj uz navedene priloge, vlastoručno potpisana
  • životopis, vlastoručno potpisan
  • dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu iz evidencije HZMO, ne stariji od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 1 i 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja;
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 3 i 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja,
  • potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda sukladno članku 25. st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne stariju od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • rodni list.

Traženi dokazi mogu se dostaviti i u neovjerenim preslikama, a dostavljena dokumentacija se vraća isključivo na zahtjev kandidata.

Izabrani kandidat/kinja dužan je izvornike i ovjerene preslike dostaviti po donošenju odluke o izboru, a prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatra se odustankom od prijave na natječaj.

Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava prethodno navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij i to: specijalistički diplomski stručni studij ili integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji diplomski stručni studij primarnog obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa stekne kvalifikaciju odgojitelja temeljem priznavanja stečenih ishoda učenja na studiju za učitelja i razlike programa za prekvalifikaciju ili dokvalifikaciju učitelja u svrhu stjecanja kvalifikacije odgojitelja.

U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Prilikom zapošljavanja oba spola su u ravnopravnom položaju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa, te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona.

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića „Naša radost“ Pregrada.

Prijave se podnose osobno ili poštom na adresu Dječji vrtić „Naša radost“ Pregrada, Stjepana Škreblina 1, 49218 Pregrada u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom “ZA NATJEČAJ – ODGOJITELJ/ICA“.

Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatraju se pravovremeno prispjele prijave kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja i koje sadržavaju sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

Nepotpune, nepravovremene i prijave dostavljene elektronskim putem neće se razmatrati.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol.

Obavijest o rezultatima natječaja objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici vrtića s navedenim imenom i prezimenom izabranog kandidata.

Izabrani kandidat po natječaju, a prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu, uputiti će se na utvrđivanje radne sposobnosti.

Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića „Naša radost“ Pregrada dana 9.4.2026. godine i traje do 14.9.2026. godine.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja ESPOO
jobs.description:
**Tule töihin APUNA Avustajapalveluille!**

Etsimme henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme **Espooseen**. Haemme luotettavaa, ystävällistä ja oma-aloitteista avustajaa, jolla on aito halu auttaa toista ihmistä arjessa. Aiempi kokemus henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä tai sosiaali- ja terveysalalta on eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä – tärkeintä on oikeanlainen asenne, luotettavuus ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot. Työ sopii erinomaisesti myös opiskelijalle.

Työ sisältää asiakkaan avustamista päivittäisissä toimissa, kuten: avustamista ruuanlaitossa, siivouksessa ja muissa kodinhoidollisissa tehtävissä. Työssä avustat asiakasta asiointikäynneillä ja muissa kodin ulkopuolisissa toiminnoissa. Tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä vahvoja tietoteknillisiä taitoja.

Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, joten voit hakea tehtävää myös ilman aiempaa kokemusta. Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa viikonloppuun tai arki-iltoihin. Työtuntien määrä ja työajat sovitaan asiakkaan tarpeen mukaisesti, kokonaistyöaika on 30h/kk. Toivomme, että pystyt sitoutumaan asiakkuuteen pitkäaikaisesti. Edellytämme hakijalta voimassa olevaa työnteko-oikeutta Suomessa sekä sitä, että hakija oleskelee Suomessa jo hakuvaiheessa.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- merkityksellisen työn, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan toisen ihmisen arkeen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ennen työn aloittamista

- kannustavan ja helposti tavoitettavan esihenkilön tuen

- mahdollisuuden palkanmaksuun kerran tai kahdesti kuukaudessa

- yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan


**Tervetuloa mukaan APUNA Avustajapalveluiden tiimiin!**

APUNA Avustajapalvelut tarjoaa henkilökohtaisen avun palveluita eri elämäntilanteissa oleville ihmisille ympäri Suomen. Toimintamme perustuu luotettavaan, yksilölliseen ja asiakkaan omia voimavaroja tukevaan palveluun. Haluamme olla työnantaja, jossa työntekijät viihtyvät ja voivat keskittyä siihen, mikä työssä on tärkeintä – ihmisten auttamiseen.

jobs.title: Kitchen Assistant
jobs.description:
Hungry Hub Kuopio is looking for a reliable and motivated Kitchen Assistant to support the restaurants daily kitchen operations.

Main duties include:

- Washing, cutting, preparing and portioning ingredients

- Assisting with the preparation of burgers, fried chicken, wings, fries, wraps and salads according to restaurant recipes

- Receiving deliveries and checking product quantities, freshness, temperatures and quality

- Organising food storage using date labels and the FIFO stock-rotation method

- Conducting opening and closing inventory counts

- Recording food waste, damaged products, remakes and stock differences

- Following food-hygiene, allergen and workplace-safety procedures

- Cleaning kitchen equipment, work surfaces and storage areas

- Washing dishes and kitchen utensils

- Packing takeaway and delivery-platform orders accurately

- Supporting other kitchen and restaurant duties when required


Experience or education in agriculture, food production, raw-material handling, warehouse operations, inventory control, restaurant work or a commercial kitchen is considered an advantage. Agricultural experience can provide useful knowledge of product quality, hygienic handling, safe storage, stock rotation, traceability and waste reduction.

Previous commercial-kitchen experience is beneficial but not essential, as training will be provided in the restaurants recipes, equipment and working procedures.

The applicant must be reliable, physically capable of kitchen work, able to follow instructions and available for evening and weekend shifts.

Fluent spoken English is required because workplace training, recipes, food-safety instructions and delivery-platform orders are handled in English. Finnish language skills are recommended and are particularly useful for customer service. Bangla language skills are considered an advantage for communication with some members of the kitchen team, but they are not mandatory.

A Finnish Hygiene Passport is an advantage. The selected employee must obtain one within the legally required period if it is required for the assigned duties.

Salary and other employment conditions will comply with the applicable Finnish collective agreement. Employment can begin only after the selected applicant has a valid right to work in Finland.

  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)

  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement

  • 20 days paid annual leave

  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)

Personal development and wellbeing

Location and compensation

  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location

Respect, growth and stability

  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

-Participer à l'élaboration, l'amélioration continue et la revue des processus qualité (MSPR et MSSC) conformément aux normes ISO/EN.
-Assurer la communication transversale entre les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes (Direction, opérationnels, clients, organismes certificateurs, GPO/GPOd).
-Participer activement aux projets de transformation de la qualité et aux sujets transverses du système de management (Capitalisation, Cleaning des documents Chorus, ...).

Profil :
Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 4 ans dans la fonction Qualité ayant exercé vos talents sur différentes dimensions de ce Métier.
-capacité à l'animation de communauté

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly

jobs.title: Kierownik (K/M) w Dziale Administracjii - nabór
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Zakres realizowanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. Kierowanie pracami Działu Administracji; dokonywanie podziału zadań
podległym pracownikom i ich nadzór.
2. Prawidłowe i sprawne wykonywanie zadań, przestrzeganie przepisów prawa oraz
porządku i dyscypliny w ramach kierowania działem.
3. Terminowość i rzetelność załatwianych spraw wynikających z realizacji powierzonych
zadań.
4. Racjonalne wykorzystywanie środków w ramach zatwierdzonych budżetów.
5. Kontrola prawidłowości zakupów, transportu i dostaw.
6. Przygotowanie okresowych ocen, analiz, informacji, i sprawozdań.
7. Kontrola rachunków pod względem merytorycznym za zrealizowane zlecenia,
zamówienia i umowy.
8. Coroczne określanie podstawy do naliczenia podatku od nieruchomości, oraz z tytułu
trwałego zarządu.
9. Nadzór nad brygadą remontową.
10. Monitorowanie wykorzystania kart drogowych przez pracowników Działu, oraz
prawidłowości rozliczenia kosztów eksploatacji pojazdów służbowych.
11. Wydawanie i podpisywania zaświadczeń w sprawach wynikających z działalności
Działu.
12. Wykonywanie innych zadań nie objętych zakresem czynności, a zleconych przez
Dyrektora MOPS.
Praca w systemie jednozmianowym w godz. 7.30-15.30 od PN do PT.
Umowa o pracę na czas określony 6 miesięcy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego z zastrzeżeniem art. 11 ust. 2 i 3 ustawy o pracownikach samorządowych.
2. Posiadanie pełnej zdolności do czynności prawnych oraz korzystania w pełni z praw publicznych.
3. Brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe.
4. Posiadanie wykształcenia wyższego.
5. Posiadanie minimum 4 lata stażu pracy w ramach umowy o pracę.
6. Koncepcja organizacji pracy Działu Administracji.
Wymagania dodatkowe związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Preferowane doświadczenie w pracy w obszarze administracji na stanowisku urzędniczym

jobs.title: Officer, Company Secretary, Delegates Monitoring & Fund Setup/Restructuring (m/f)
jobs.description:
Title:  Officer, Company Secretary, Delegates Monitoring & Fund Setup/Restructuring – Permanent Contract (CDI)

About Us:

Global Funds Management S.A. ("GFM"), a Nomura Group entity, serves as an alternative investment fund manager and UCITS management company. We manage a diverse portfolio of alternative investment funds (AIFs) and undertakings for collective investment in transferable securities (UCITS) with assets under management exceeding €12 billion for Nomura Group and third-party clients.

Our investment funds span a comprehensive range of strategies and asset classes, including money market, equity, fixed income, and private equity funds, as well as hedge funds. Portfolio management and marketing services are delegated to specialized service providers across multiple jurisdictions.

The Role:

We are seeking an Officer to join our team on a permanent basis (CDI). You will provide essential support across three key areas:

Company Secretary Function

• Prepare and coordinate board meetings for GFM and SICAVs
• Organize and manage Annual General Meetings

Delegate & Service Provider Oversight

• Prepare, collect, and analyze due diligence questionnaires for portfolio managers, distributors, fund administrators, and other service providers
• Collect and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs)

Fund Administration

• Support the establishment, restructuring, and liquidation of Luxembourg and Cayman Islands investment funds
• Review Japanese SRS reports and fund-related documents
• Assist Conducting Officers on special projects

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications

• Studies in Law, Finance, or Business Administration
• First professional experience in the investment funds industry
• Strong knowledge of the Luxembourg funds regulatory environment, including AIFMD and UCITS regulations
• Fluent in Japanese and English (written and spoken)

Desirable Qualifications

• Prior experience in a Company Secretary function

Key Competencies

• Self-directed and autonomous work style with strong collaborative abilities
• Proactive, curious, and detail-oriented approach
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Critical thinking and problem-solving skills

What we offer:

Join a dynamic, international organization within the Nomura Group where:

• Flat organizational structures foster direct collaboration and open communication
• Your initiative, critical thinking, and contributions are actively valued
• Competitive compensation and benefits package
• Professional development opportunities within a global financial services leader

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our  Recruitment Gateway.

Job Description & Summary:


Meet your future team:

You will join PwC Luxembourg's Risk Assurance Compliance & Analytics team, working closely with colleagues across AML/CFT, internal audit, and risk advisory. The team collaborates with a broad range of financial services stakeholders to strengthen regulatory compliance and trust.

What your role will look like
As an Associate, you contribute to client engagements that strengthen AML/CFT frameworks and risk management practices. Your work supports clients in meeting regulatory expectations while building robust, sustainable controls.

Contribute to AML/CFT client assignments, supporting the review and design of AML/CFT programmes and key components.
Participate in AML risk assessments and risk appetite exercises, translating regulatory expectations into practical insights.
Support reviews of customer due diligence files and the effectiveness of AML/CFT procedures in practice.
Collaborate with various industry participants such as management companies, transfer agents, custodians, and domiciliary agents.
Contribute to broader Risk Assurance assignments, including internal audit and internal controls projects, depending on engagement needs.


Your growth and opportunities:

You will progressively build exposure to a wide range of AML/CFT topics and client environments. Over time, you will take ownership of defined work areas and deepen your understanding of financial crime risks and controls. You will learn alongside experienced professionals through on‑the‑job coaching and diverse engagements.


The skills you bring:

Master's degree or equivalent in Audit, Business, Economics, Financial Crime, or a related field.
Working knowledge of AML/CFT concepts and regulatory expectations.
Proficient use of Microsoft Word and Excel for analysis and documentation.

Language skills: English (CEFR level to be confirmed); French and/or German (CEFR level to be confirmed).


Ways of working:

Think critically and structure information to support sound risk‑based judgments.
Work collaboratively with others, contributing reliably to shared objectives in diverse teams.
Actively seek learning opportunities and apply feedback to build professional confidence.
You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role.
If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.


Take your next step:

Step into a role where your contribution supports trust, compliance, and confidence in the financial system. Build strong foundations in AML/CFT while working with engaged teams and diverse clients. Grow your impact and expertise with PwC Luxembourg as you shape your professional journey.

jobs.title: Field Marketing
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.

The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.

In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000-$160,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Finance
Programming and game design club instructor
jobs.description:
**Brief:**

We are looking for game educators whose hearts beat for creativity, game design, and 21st-century skills! In this role, you will act as the mentor and guide for two of our awesome club themes: _My Own Game Studio_ and _Coding and Future Skills_. You will lead children and young people behind the scenes of the digital world, helping them develop logical thinking and breathe life into their own game ideas in a safe and engaging online environment.

**About us:**

School of Gaming (SOG) is a game-based education and digital youth work company that combines education and gaming in a fun and safe way. We provide children and young people with opportunities to develop 21st-century skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and creativity. Our trained game educators guide kids in inspiring online clubs and courses with a strong social and educational impact.

**Description:**

Have you ever wondered what it feels like to be the one pulling the strings behind the scenes of a game studio? Now is your chance to become the boss of your own game studio and lead the talents of tomorrow from initial idea to final publication. And don't worry, we don't require you to move to Silicon Valley! You can stay right in your gaming chair in Finland or work at your local school. Or both!

Your mission is to guide and mentor groups of 10–15 young, creative gamers. In the _My Own Game Studio_ club, you aren't just coding. You are setting up a whole production team, including scriptwriters, graphic designers, sound designers, and producers. You will help kids identify their strengths and collaborate. In the _Coding and Future Skills_ club, you will step behind the digital curtain using the globally acclaimed Code.org platform.

Rather than spoon-feeding answers or mechanically grinding code syntax, you encourage them to try, fail, and figure things out on their own. Your role is to tickle their gray brain cells, spark their curiosity, and create challenges for them to solve.

**What We Are Looking For:**

- You know which way to hold a mouse and you understand the mechanics and culture of gaming worlds.

- You have a visual eye or a basic understanding of the different aspects of game design (coding, graphics, audio, or storytelling).

- We greatly appreciate it if you have former experience guiding small humanoids on Tellus (e.g., camp counselor, club instructor, or youth work).

- If gaming is your passion and you love stepping into stories and play, you are the Game Educator we want!


We provide plenty of materials, ready-made templates, and infinite support 24/7.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at Linear’s mid-market customers - act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear to drive business outcomes

 - Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with product, sales, and support teams to address challenges and drive enhancements in the product

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years relevant work experience in a technical customer-facing role

 - SaaS and start up experience a must; comfortable working and adapting in a fast paced and flexible environment

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - Previous experience working with product + engineering teams and/or developer tools is preferred

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work-life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (early exercise, extended exercise)

 - Stipend to set up your home office

 - Paid lunch and coffee during workdays

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks of paid vacation

 - 4 months of paid parental leave

jobs.description:
Vos missions :

En tant que courtier-ère spécialisé-e dans l'immobilier résidentiel, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement et la réussite des transactions immobilières sur le marché genevois.

À ce titre, vous serez amené-e à :
- Développer un portefeuille de biens résidentiels (appartements, villas et autres biens) grâce à une prospection active.
- Réaliser des estimations de biens et accompagner les propriétaires en leur apportant des conseils personnalisés adaptés à leur projet.
- Mettre en œuvre la commercialisation des biens : rédaction et diffusion des annonces, organisation des visites et valorisation des propriétés.
- Accompagner vendeurs et acquéreurs tout au long du processus de vente, de la première prise de contact jusqu'à la signature, en assurant un suivi rigoureux.
- Conduire les négociations avec professionnalisme afin de garantir la satisfaction des différentes parties.
- Assurer une veille permanente du marché immobilier genevois afin d'identifier les opportunités et les évolutions du secteur.

Profil recherché :
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 10 ans dans le courtage immobilier, idéalement dans le secteur résidentiel. Vous possédez une excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois ainsi qu'un réseau professionnel développé.

Autonome, dynamique et orienté-e résultats, vous êtes reconnu-e pour votre sens commercial, votre capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance et votre qualité de service. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et savez accompagner vos clients avec professionnalisme tout au long de leur projet.

Compétences et prérequis :
- Expérience de 10 ans minimum en courtage immobilier résidentiel
- Excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois
- Réseau professionnel solide dans la région
- Français langue maternelle
- Anglais courant
- Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels
- Permis de conduire indispensable.

Déplacements :
Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir dans le cadre de cette fonction.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced accounting professional with solid expertise in financial accounting and a mindset for continuous improvement?

We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join Valmet Automotive's Finance team.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad accounting and reporting role in an international environment. You will have a key role in ensuring reliable financial information while helping us improve finance processes and ways of working.

You will be part of a collaborative Finance team where responsibilities span financial accounting, tax reporting, finance processes, and reporting activities. The role gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise, understand finance activities across the organization, and expand your responsibilities over time.


Your role
In this position, your primary focus will be on ensuring high-quality accounting and statutory reporting for Valmet Automotive Oyj.

Your responsibilities will include:
* General ledger accounting and account reconciliations

* Monthly and year-end financial closings and financial statement preparation (FAS)

* Participate in IFRS reporting to support group reporting requirements

* Fixed asset and capital expenditure accounting
* VAT, taxation, statutory and authority reporting

* Develop accounting, reporting and internal control processes and maintain related documentation



What you bring?
You are a proactive and dependable finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, finding practical solutions, and working flexibly as part of a small team.

To succeed in this role, you bring:
* A relevant degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

* Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting

* Strong understanding of Finnish Accounting Standards (FAS)

* Good knowledge of taxation, VAT and fixed asset accounting
* Experience with SAP and strong Excel skills

* Fluent communication skills in Finnish and English

* Knowledge of IFRS and group finance processes is considered an advantage



Location & Work Flexibility:

Our main operations are based in Uusikaupunki.However,youllalso have theoptionto work from our officepremisesin Turkuand Helsinki, withadditionalflexibility for remote work.



Why join us?
At Valmet Automotive, you will join a collaborative Finance organization where your contribution is valued and your work has a visible impact. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will gain broad exposure to finance activities, deepen your expertise, and gradually expand your responsibilities. You will also have the opportunity to bring forward new ideas and genuinely influence how our finance processes and ways of working are developed.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description:
Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle henkilökohtaisen avun pariin? Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on hyvä asenne sekä sosiaaliset taidot.

Etsimme luonnon helmassa sijaitsevaan Leväniemen palvelukeskukseen Heinävedelle avustajaa, joka toimii työparina toiselle avustajalle eri asiakkaiden kanssa. Työtuntien määrä vaihtelee kuukausittain, arviolta liikkuen 10–40 tunnin välillä. Asiakkaille on myönnetty vapaa-ajan avustustunteja ja ne toteutuvat palvelukeskuksen ulkopuolella. Asiakkaiden kanssa tehdään makkaranpaistoretkiä, samoillaan luonnossa, käydään kahvilla tai syömässä, osallistutaan tapahtumiin, vieraillaan asiakasta kiinnostavissa kohteissa, kuten vaikkapa Karvion kanavalla tai Valamon luostarissa. Ole yhteydessä palveluesihenkilö Anne Rajapolveen (p. 0400183218) saadaksesi lisätietoja!

Lupaamme sinulle:

\- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

\- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

\- lähiesihenkilön tuen

\- monipuolisen työnkuvan

\- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

\- palkkaluokka on G16A + 12 snt/tunti eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,32 € - 14,63 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)

Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus.

jobs.title: RDI Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an RDI Specialist to join Karelia University of Applied Sciences in a fixed-term employment relationship for the period 1 November 2026-31 December 2027.

As an RDI Specialist, you will work in the field of international higher education and RDI. The position offers you an opportunity to take on new challenges, build meaningful expert networks, and contribute to the development of education and related project activities with both local and international impact. A central part of your work will be promoting cooperation within the INVEST European University Alliance consortium. You will be supported in your role by Karelias expert RDI support services team.

Your duties will include:
- coordinating the RDI activities of the INVEST Centre of Excellence and research cluster cooperation among staff at Karelia, as well as linking these activities to the development of INVEST education provision and Living Labs
- participating in the networks and expert groups of the INVEST Alliance
- planning and implementing workshops, training activities and international network meetings
- developing the monitoring, reporting and impact assessment of RDI related activities, including preparing analyses and reports to support decision-making
- preparing EU-funded RDI projects in cooperation with Karelias experts and other partners
- maintaining networks and partnerships and identifying new cooperation opportunities
- participating in the implementation and development of Karelias RDI support services and INVEST teamwork

Find out more about the INVEST Alliance online:
https://www.invest-alliance.eu/fi
https://www.invest-alliance.eu/fi/Home/Texts?link=62-center-of-excellence---research---innovation

We expect you to have:
- a suitable Masters degree
- experience in international higher education cooperation and in the preparation, implementation and coordination of projects
- evidence of successful development work
- good knowledge of key EU-funded development programs, and experience in project funding application processes
- readiness to work in international networks, and an understanding of different operating cultures
- the ability to purposefully promote common goals in cooperation with colleagues and stakeholders
- the ability to manage several simultaneous task areas, and prioritize your own work
- good oral and written Finnish language skills (at least B1) and excellent English language skills (C1-C2)
- readiness to travel in Finland and abroad for work assignments

In addition, we consider the following advantages:
- a suitable doctoral degree
- knowledge of RDI activities and the operating environment of higher education institutions
- versatile language skills in addition to Finnish and English

Employment details:
- Collective agreement: Collective agreement for Universities of Applied Sciences (Sivista ry)
- Salary: according to your previous work experience, 3 842,18-5 093,84 €/month.
- Trial period: 6 months
- Working hours: 36.25 hours per week (7.25 hours/day), flexible working hours
- The position requires on-site work at Karelia UAS campuses in Joensuu, with a partial remote work option

We will conduct a background check on the person selected for the position to ensure research security.

Applying:

Please submit your application and CV through Kuntarekry by Sunday 20 September at 20:00. You may complete your application either in Finnish or in English.

Interviews will be held in Joensuu on 5 October 2026. We will contact those invited to interview by phone during week 44.

We are committed to equality and non-discrimination in our recruitment processes and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds. Our application form is based on the researcher CV template recommended by the Finnish National Board on Research Integrity (TENK). Candidates invited to interview will be selected based on the information and evidence presented in their applications.

jobs.title: Ajoneuvonasentaja (Vakituinen työ)
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme ajoneuvonasentajaa monimerkkikorjaamoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Tuusulaan. Oletko juuri sinä etsimämme henkilö?

Yritys tarjoaa laadukkaita huolto-ja korjauspalveluita monimerkkiautoille pitkälla kokemuksella panostamalla asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Töitä tehdään korjaamolla ammattitaitoisen henkilökunnan kanssa. Yritys tarjoaa nykyaikaiset korjaamolaitteet sekä työkalut. Huolettavat ja korjattavat autot ovat pääasiassa bensa- ja hybridikäyttöisiä. Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi mukaan.

Työtehtäviisi sisältää muun muassa erilaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt, ongelmanratkaisu, vikadiagnostiikan lukeminen sekä asiakkaiden neuvonta ja tehtävien dokumentointi.

Tehtävä edellyttää aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä sekä alan koulutusta. Eduksi katsotaan, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta autosähköosaamisesta.

Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan ja työaika on arkisin klo 8.00 – 16.00.

Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Täytä työnhakulomake osoitteessa alrekry.fi!

Asiakkaamme käyttävät palveluamme työtehtävissä suorittavista tehtävistä ammattitaitoa vaativiin tehtäviin kuin myös suunnitteluun ja johtotehtäviin. Asiakkaamme ovat aktiivisia toimijoita monilta eri aloilta vahvimmin edustettuna teollisuus-, logistiikka-, tuotanto-, palvelu- ja kuljetusaloilla.

Kiinnostuitko! Jos haluat tietää enemmän, soita rohkeasti minulle ja kysy lisää. Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 09.00 - 15.00: 050 380 2656 / Anne Järvelä. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.

Olemme luotettava ja vakavarainen työnantaja. Olemme toimineet näin jo vuodesta 2004. Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin. Olemme luotettava kumppani.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle kotiin vietävien palveluiden pariin Tampereen alueelle? Haemme vahvistusta keikkaluontoisesti työskentelevien tiimiimme. Kotiin vietäviin palveluihimme kuuluu mm. vammaisten kotihoito ja lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu.

Spesio - Omanlainen elämä: Tehtävänäsi on auttaa asiakasta elämään mahdollisimman omanlaista elämää. Työn kokonaisuutta määrittelee asiakkaan avun tarve, hoidollisten tehtävien lisäksi työnkuvaan kuuluu mm. avustamista kotitöissä. Lapsiperheiden luona työn keskiössä on lastenhoito. Huolehdimme siitä, että jokaisen asiakkaan kanssa on riittävästi aikaa, eikä ole kiirettä juosta asiakkaalta toiselle. Työsuhteen aluksi tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen ja käytettävissäsi on kollegoiden sekä lähiesihenkilön tuki.

Me teemme työtä aina asiakkaan hyvinvointi edellä ja olemmekin siinä melkoisen hyviä: sisäpiirissä olevat sanoisivat, että pykälää parempia!

Lupaammekin sinulle:

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

- palkkaluokka G20C eli palvelusvuosista riippuen 14,82-16,03€ (+mahdollinen tehtäväkohtainen lisä).


Sinä: Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, kenelle asiakkaan hyvinvointi tulee ykkösenä. Haussa huomioidaan myös alan opiskelijat (esim. lähihoitaja- ja sairaanhoitajaopiskelijat sekä lääketieteen opiskelijat). Edellytämme työntekijöiltämme LOVE-lääkelupia, mutta tarjoamme vaadittavan koulutuksen, mikäli sinulla ei ole voimassa olevia lääkelupia. Tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote, koska työ sisältää ikäihmisten, vammaisten ja lasten kanssa työskentelyä.

Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään ja uskomme, että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus "Hae työpaikkaa" -painikkeen kautta. Hakemuksia aletaan käsitellä jo hakuaikana. Jos olet opiskelija, kerrothan jo hakemuksessasi suoritettujen opintojen määrän.

Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Joensuussa, Kuopiossa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille.

jobs.title: Sampo: Analyst, Compensation & Benefits
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Fabianinkatu 21, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** Mon 21.9.2026

Sampo Group is looking for an Analyst with strong data and statistical skills to join its Compensation & Benefits team in Helsinki. This is an opportunity to develop as an analyst while building expertise in C&B in an international environment.

**Responsibilities**

As an Analyst, you will support Sampos C&B team with data-driven analysis, reporting, and market insights across key compensation topics, such as fixed pay, equal pay and pay transparency, and executive compensation.

Your work will include salary benchmarking, compensation surveys, and monitoring market practices. You will analyze compensation data and turn your findings into actionable recommendations for C&B, management, and other stakeholders. You will also participate in stakeholder meetings to discuss findings and provide analytical input. Your analyses help guide the effective allocation of significant compensation-related financial resources across the Group.

You will also help develop Sampos C&B analytics by improving ways of working with data and exploring how tools such as AI can create additional value. As part of a team, you may also contribute to broader C&B development projects and responsibilities.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a relevant Masters degree, for example in economics, and strong analytical skills with the ability to work confidently with data.You enjoy combining quantitative analysis with real-world business questions and are motivated to further develop your skills as an analyst. You also enjoy working with people as the role involves interaction across the organization.

Previous experience in compensation & benefits is an advantage but not required. More importantly, you are interested in compensation-related topics and motivated to deepen your expertise.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree or final-stage studies, for example in economics or another quantitative field

- Entry-level work experience from analytical, data-heavy roles

- Strong analytical skills and an understanding of statistics, with the ability to apply these skills to practical business questions

- Good technical capabilities in Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI, as well as an interest in utilizing AI in analytics

- Good English skills, combined with strong communication and collaboration skills

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, conceptual thinking skills, and motivation to develop professionally


**We consider as an asset:**

- Finnish and Swedish language skills

- Previous exposure to compensation and benefits, people analytics, or related HR topics

- Experience with Workday or other relevant HR systems


**Sampo offers you:**

Sampo offers you meaningful analytical work at a leading Nordic insurance group, with exposure to business-critical C&B topics. As your expertise grows, you will have the opportunity to take on more demanding roles and responsibilities within the C&B team. You will work alongside experienced colleagues in a close-knit and collaborative team and contribute to developing processes and ways of working.

As an employer, Sampo promotes a healthy work environment by offering modern and ergonomic workstations and equipment, extensive occupational health care, a comprehensive insurance package and other benefits supporting employees well-being. The benefits package includes for example:

- Profit sharing program and an employee fund

- Lunch, sports and commuter benefits

- Extensive healthcare plan and insurance coverage

- Increasing holiday earnings up to 3,25 days a month

- Phone benefit

- Office in the heart of Helsinki and a peaceful working environment at the office

- IT support at the office and excellent working equipment

- Summer and Christmas events and other variable activities


**Practicalities**

This is a full-time and permanent position in which you will be employed directly by Sampo plc. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible and will be agreed with the selected candidate. Sampos headquarters are located in central Helsinki, and you are expected to work at the office at least three days per week. The position has a fixed monthly salary, which will be negotiated with the selected candidate.

**Interested in joining Sampo?** Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest Monday 21st of September 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/380488/create/ .

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. Please note, that this position is located in Finland, and requires a valid work permit in Finland. You can familiarize yourself with Sampo here: https://www.sampo.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process contact aTalents Senior Recruitment Consultant Kati Hautakoski (+358 50 552 0419, kati.hautakoski@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.
