jobs.title: Tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia matalamainepesijöitä, Low-pressure cleaners
jobs.description:
Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa MATALAPAINEPESIJÖITÄ OUTOKUMPUUN teurastamoon!
Tässä tehtävässä vastaat tuotantotilojen pesusta matalapainepesumenetelmin teurastamossa korkeiden hygieniavaatimusten mukaisesti. Katsomme eduksesi aikaisemman siivoustyökokemuksen, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme tehtävään henkilöitä, jotka eivät kavahda teurastamoa työympäristönä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Pääset osaksi monimuotoista ja ammattimaista tiimiämme.
Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava. Työvuorosi sijoittuvat arkipäiville iltavuoroon kello 15.00–22.30 välille. Huomaathan, että kohteeseen ei kulje hyvin julkista liikennettä ja saatat tarvita autoa työmatkoihisi. Aloitus tehtävissä on sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 5 mukaista palkkaa (14,58 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.

Vaatimukset:
- Innostuneisuutta, asennetta ja heittäytymistä työhön.
- Hyvä fyysinen kunto.
- Hygieniapassi ja työturvallisuuskortti.
- Todennettu negatiivinen tulos salmonellatestistä.
- Suomen tai englannin kielen hyvä osaaminen.

Arvostamme:
- Oma-aloitteista ja tarkkaa työskentelytapaa sekä innokasta asennetta uuden oppimiseen.
- Aikaisempaa siivoustyökokemusta.
- Halua tehdä ruumiillista työtä.
- Kokemuksen ja/tai koulutuksen elintarvikehygienia- tai puhtaanapitoalalta katsotaan eduksi.
- Kohteeseen ei kulje julkista liikennettä iltaisin, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on eduksi.

Tarjoamme:
- Työn, jossa näet oman käden jäljen – työ on palkitsevaa.
- Paikan Suomen elintarvikehygienian puhdistuksen kärkipaikalla.
- Isona yrityksenä palkan, joka tulee ajallaan.
- Kattavan koulutusohjelman, jossa jatkokoulutamme sinusta alan ehdottoman ykkösosaajan.
- Mielenkiintoisen sekä muuttuvan työn, jossa pääset toteuttamaan omaa osaamista
- Huippu tiimin ja arvostuksen.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi. Ole osa jotain suurempaa tee merkityksellistä työtä, joka varmistaa asiakkaamme tuotantoprosessin toimivuuden joka päivä ja, että me kaikki kuluttajina saamme turvallista ja puhdasta ruokaa.
Hae oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 13.9.2026.! Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.


---
We are looking for low-pressure cleaners for OUTOKUMPU to a slaughterhouse.
In this role, you will be responsible for cleaning production facilities using low-pressure washing methods at a slaughterhouse, in accordance with high hygiene standards. Previous cleaning experience is considered an advantage, but above all, we are looking for individuals for the position who are not deterred by a slaughterhouse as a working environment. We will provide you with comprehensive training for the role. You will become part of our diverse and professional team.
Your shifts are scheduled on weekdays between 15.00 – 22.30 in the evening. This is a permanent and on-the-call contract and will start as soon as possible according to the agreement. Please note that the location is not well served by public transport, and you may need a car for your commute.
In this position, the salary is paid according to the Real Estate Services Collective Agreement (wage class 5, 14,58€/h) plus any applicable supplements.
Requirements:
- Enthusiasm, attitude, and commitment to work.
- Good physical condition.
- Hygiene passport and safety card.
- Verified negative result for salmonella test.
- Proficiency in Finnish or English.

We appreciate:
- Proactive work style and an enthusiastic attitude towards learning new things.
- Willingness to do physical work.
- Previous cleaning experience.
- Experience and/or education in the food hygiene or cleaning industry is considered an advantage.
- Since there is not public transportation to the area at nighttime ability to use your own car is recommended.

We offer:
- A rewarding job where you can see the results of your hard work.
- A place at the forefront of Finnish food hygiene cleaning.
- As a large company, a salary that is paid on time.
- A comprehensive training program where we will continue to train you to become an absolute top expert in the field.
- Interesting and varied work where you can implement your own skills.
- A great team and appreciation.

We value diversity in all its meanings; in our team you can be yourself. Be part of something bigger, do meaningful work that ensures our customers' production process works every day and that we, as consumers, get safe and clean food.
Apply through the link below by September 13th , 2026! We will process all applications and inform each applicant about the progress of the process.

We at ISS Finland are part of the leading workplace experience and facility management company that is established in over 30 different countries. In Finland we have over 7000 people working at ISS and we operate nationally. The meaning of our operation is to provide placemaking solutions that contribute to better business performance and make life easier, more productive and enjoyable. We create these places with our cleaning, food, technical and workplace services. Cleaning is our largest service sector and we have been developing our know-how in cleaning for over 100 years.
Our climate goal is to be carbon neutral in the year 2040 - as an ISS worker you will have the chance to contribute significantly to reaching our goal and the well-being of our planet!

jobs.title: Opas Ylläkselle talvisesonkiin
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme opasta talvisesonkiin Ylläksen upeisiin maisemiin!

Työnkuva

Oppaan työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Päivät alkavat usein tavaravuokraamon tehtävillä ja välinehuollolla, minkä jälkeen valmistellaan päivän aktiviteetteja ja retkiä. Työpäivien sisältö määräytyy pitkälti asiakkaiden varaamien ohjelmien mukaan, joten yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen.

Tehtävään kuuluu erilaisten luonto- ja aktiviteettiohjelmien ohjaamista, kuten moottorikelkka-, hiihto-, lumikenkäily- ja pilkkiretkillä toimimista. Työtä tehdään sekä itsenäisesti että osana muuta tiimiä. Työkieli on englanti.

Työsuhde alkaa joulukuussa ja kestää maaliskuun loppuun saakka. Työ sisältää myös viikonlopputöitä, ja työvuorot suunnitellaan kolmen viikon työvuorolistoihin. Työsuhde solmitaan määräaikaisena Henkilöstöliigan kanssa.



Odotamme hakijalta

* Ensiapukoulutusta

* Aikaisempaa työkokemusta Lapin opastustehtävistä

* Erinomaista englannin kielen taitoa

* Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta työskennellä ulkona talviolosuhteissa

Etsimme reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta omaavaa hakijaa, jolla on hyvät asiakaspalvelutaidot ja kyky tulla toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa.



Katsomme haussa eduksi

* Sujuvan ranskan ja saksan kielitaidon

* Eräopaskoulutuksen



Tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden viettää talvisesongin Lapin upeissa maisemissa ja työskennellä monipuolisissa opastehtävissä kansainvälisten matkailijoiden parissa. Pääset osaksi noin 30 hengen työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen päivä tuo mukanaan uusia kokemuksia ja kohtaamisia.

Työntekijöille pyritään järjestämään majoitus, mikäli omaa majoitusta ei ole valmiiksi. Lisäksi työsuhteeseen kuuluu ruokaetu. Henkilöstöliiga takaa aina luotettavat palkkahallintopalvelut. Lisäksi saat henkilökohtaisen HR-yhteyshenkilön tuen koko työsuhteesi ajalle.



Hakuprosessi

Toivottavasti kiinnostuit tehtävästä! Jätä hakemus järjestelmämme kautta helposti parissa minuutissa. Huomioithan, että ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta saapuneet hakemukset käsitellään. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse tai muun kanavan kautta toimitettuja työhakemuksia. Lisätietoja saat arkisin 9.00-16.00 Marko Nääppä, 044 9011 732, marko.naappa@henkilostoliiga.fi [marko.naappa@henkilostoliiga.fi]

Henkilöstöliiga:

Henkilöstöliiga on Etelä-Suomen vahvimpia henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksiä. Satojen työntekijöidemme joukosta löytyy teollisuuden, logistiikan-, kiinteistö- ja ravintola-alan osaajia, sekä toimistotyön ja palvelualan työntekijöitä. Olemme aktiivinen asiantuntijayritys ja tavoitteenamme on saada työntekijämme viihtymään. Henkilöstöliiga on Henkilöstöala HELAn jäsen. Henkilöstömme on vakuutettu LähiTapiolassa tapaturmien varalta ja työterveyshuolto on järjestetty Mehiläisessä.

Vuoden 2025 Henkilöstöliigan työtyytyväisyyskyselyssä saimme kiitosta työntekijöiltämme ammattimaisesta ja yhdenmukaisesta kohtelusta sekä mieluisista työtehtävistä. Lisäksi saimme positiivista palautetta myös hyvästä tavoitettavuudesta ja viestinnästä.

Katso kaikki avoimet työpaikkamme täältä: https://henkilostoliiga.fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/ [https://henkilostoliiga.fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/]

jobs.title: Chauffører søges til faste distributionsruter hos Danmarks Fragtgruppe
jobs.description:
Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS søger flere stabile og ansvarsbevidste chauffører til vores team i Glostrup.

Vi søger chauffører til faste distributionsopgaver med udgangspunkt fra Naverland 13, 2600 Glostrup.

Stillingerne er på fuld tid og passer godt til dig, der trives med en aktiv arbejdsdag med ansvar, kundekontakt og frihed til i høj grad at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag efter aftale.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kørsel og distribution af gods på faste ruter

  • Levering af varer til erhvervskunder

  • Lastning og aflæsning

  • Indbæring af varer hos kunder

  • Sikring og korrekt håndtering af gods

  • Kontrol af varer og leverancer

  • Registrering og dokumentation af leverancer

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Ansvar for, at bilen holdes ordentlig og præsentabel

Kørslen foregår primært med 18-pallers forvogne.

Fleksibel arbejdstid

Vi ønsker at give vores chauffører mulighed for en arbejdsdag, der så vidt muligt passer til den enkelte.

Arbejdstiden kan derfor aftales individuelt inden for tidsrummet ca. kl. 06.00–18.00, afhængigt af ruterne og virksomhedens drift.

En normal arbejdsdag kan eksempelvis være 8 timer, men der kan også efter aftale være mulighed for flere timer på de dage, hvor chaufføren ønsker det, og hvor driften giver mulighed for det.

Det betyder eksempelvis, at nogle chauffører kan foretrække:

  • Tidlig opstart og tidligere fri

  • Senere opstart og senere fri

  • En almindelig arbejdsdag på omkring 8 timer

  • Længere arbejdsdage efter aftale

Den konkrete arbejdstid planlægges i samarbejde med kørselsledelsen og under hensyntagen til gældende regler om arbejdstid, pauser samt køre- og hviletid.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori C

  • Har gyldigt chaufføruddannelsesbevis/EU-kvalifikationsbevis, hvor dette er påkrævet

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Er serviceminded og ordentlig i kontakten med kunder

  • Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og indbæring

  • Behandler virksomhedens materiel og kundernes varer med respekt

  • Kan samarbejde godt med kolleger og kørselsledelsen

  • Har en professionel og positiv tilgang til arbejdet

Erfaring med distribution og lastbilkørsel er en fordel, men den rette indstilling, stabilitet og ansvarlighed vægter højt hos os.

ADR

ADR-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Har du ikke ADR-bevis, kan der efter nærmere aftale være mulighed for at tage den nødvendige ADR-uddannelse gennem virksomheden.

Løn

Vi tilbyder en timeløn på:

175–250 kr. pr. time

Den konkrete timeløn fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og afhænger blandt andet af:

  • Erfaring

  • Relevante kvalifikationer

  • Certifikater og uddannelser

  • Erfaring med distributionskørsel

  • Arbejdsopgaver og ansvar i stillingen

Vi tilbyder

  • Fastansættelse

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Faste distributionsopgaver

  • Timeløn på 175–250 kr. efter kvalifikationer

  • Mulighed for fleksibel tilrettelæggelse af arbejdstiden

  • Mulighed for både ca. 8 timers arbejdsdage og længere arbejdsdage efter aftale

  • Arbejdstid inden for ca. kl. 06.00–18.00

  • Faste rammer og tydelig kørselsplanlægning

  • Et professionelt og ordentligt arbejdsmiljø

  • Mulighed for ansvar og udvikling

  • Mulighed for ADR-uddannelse efter aftale

  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

Om Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS

Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS er en transport- og distributionsvirksomhed med fokus på driftssikker transport, god kundeservice og professionel håndtering af vores kunders varer.

Vi lægger vægt på stabile medarbejdere, godt samarbejde og en professionel tilgang til den enkelte transportopgave.

Vi ønsker samtidig at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor der så vidt muligt er plads til, at den enkelte chauffør kan få arbejdsliv og privatliv til at hænge sammen.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og gerne dit CV til:

info@dfgdk.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

jobs.title: Cleaning Supervisor
jobs.description:
At duuo our mission is to empower our customers by providing customer centric advice and solutions, enabling them to focus on their core business and what really matters.

By working as a Cleaning Supervisor at duuo, you will be working with the Cleaning department - a team of around 120 dedicated staff members that are serving 150+ customers in central Copenhagen and ensure that the quality of cleaning at our customers meets duuo's standards at all times.

The work is exclusively evenings during the week, and weekends and you will be expected to work both Saturday and Sunday.

The supervisor role is primarily responsible for active quality assurance on site. Other duties will include:

  • Specialist Cleaning

  • Training and mentoring

  • Replacement cleaning in case of illness and other issues

To qualify of this role, we would like to hear from candidates that have the following:

  • 5 years cleaning experience in Denmark

  • Full and Valid Driving License

  • Fluent English

To excel in this role, you will need to following attributes:

  • Attention to detail

  • Good people & communication skills

  • Some knowledge of Danish

  • Good problem solving and ability to work independently.

The location and nature of the work will change daily, we need someone that is adaptable and flexible and able to think on their feet and react to lots of unknown situations. Alongside this you need good humour and patience as you will be working with different people and different locations.

If you see yourself in this role, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

jobs.title: Skal du være socialfaglig medarbejder på Holbrogaard?
jobs.description:
Vi får plads til flere unge derfor søger vi socialfaglige medarbejdere med opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Holbrogaard ligger i naturskønne omgivelser tæt ved det sydfynske øhav i Faaborg. Vi tilbyder miljøterapeutisk og neoaffektiv døgnbehandling til unge i alderen 12-18 (22) år, med begyndende personlighedsforstyrrelser og psykiatrinære lidelser.

Det er en arbejdsplads for omkring 20 medarbejdere med såvel sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske uddannelser, hvor det faglige niveau er højt. Behandlingen af hver enkelt ung, er nøje tilrettelagt efter den unges individuelle behov og foregår i et omsorgsfuldt bo-miljø.

Skoletilbuddet aftales med den anbringende kommune for hver enkelt ung og foregår i nærmiljøet. Det er med til at skabe den bedste udvikling i den unges liv.

Behandlingen tager udgangspunkt i evidensbaseret miljøterapi og neuroaffektive og systemiske principper. Det betyder, at vores behandlingsmetoder er veldokumenterede og tager hensyn til og inddrager alle aspekter af den unges liv.
For at udvikle fagligheden, er der løbende efteruddannelse og supervision.

Med andre ord: Holbrogaard lykkes, når unge udvikles og styrkes mod et bæredygtigt liv.

Med udgangspunkt i en stærk faglighed og blikket hævet mod ovenstående kerneopgave, arbejder vi bevidst insisterende mod at lykkes sammen med de unge.

Dette stiller store krav til os som behandlingssted og vores pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige handlinger.

Kan du se dig selv ind i ovenstående og har du følgende kvalifikationer hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Shaw Commercials Group in Castlebar is currently recruiting for Business Analyst position. Reporting to the Managing Director / Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play an important role in the business with have multiple responsibilities and duties that will span across various departments. This is a busy work environment working to weekly and monthly deadlines. Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

Bonde Glas er en lokal glarmestervirksomhed på Lolland. Ud over glarmesterarbejde har virksomheden også tømrere ansat og udfører mange forskellige praktiske opgaver.

Første samtale kan afholdes online, hvis det er nødvendigt. Udvalgte kandidater kan blive inviteret til at besøge arbejdspladsen, inden der indgås en endelig ansættelsesaftale.

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. jobs.title: Turvallisuusasiantuntija
jobs.description:
Mitä pääset tekemään?
Turvallisuusasiantuntijana vastaat erityisesti vesilaitosten, vedenottamoiden, puhdistamon ja verkostoa palvelevien järjestelmien turvallisuudesta. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:
Toimiminen vesihuoltolaitoksen tietoturvavastaavana
Tuotantolaitosten kyberturvallisuuden kehittäminen yhdessä IT- ja automaatioasiantuntijoiden kanssa esim. valvomojärjestelmät, prosessiautomaatio, etäyhteydet
Tietoturvapolitiikan, -prosessien ja ohjeiden kehittäminen ja jalkauttaminen vesihuollon tarpeisiin (NIS2, kansallinen lainsäädäntö, viranomaisvaatimukset)
Riskienhallinnan suunnitelmallinen ylläpito ja kehittäminen, erityisesti tuotantolaitoksiin, prosessiturvallisuuteen ja kyberuhkiin liittyen
Tietoturva- ja turvallisuuspoikkeamien hallinta, tutkinta ja raportointi sekä jälkiarviointi yhteistyössä organisaation ja viranomaisten kanssa
Laitosten ja toimitilojen fyysisen turvallisuuden kehittäminen
Osallistuminen valmius- ja jatkuvuussuunnitteluun
Henkilöstön turvallisuus- ja tietoturvatietoisuuden lisääminen

Tehtävä on vahvasti käytännönläheinen: jalkaudut toimistolta myös muihin vesilaitoksen kohteisiin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. turvallisuusala, tekniikka, ICT) tai vastaava osaaminen
Vähintään kolmen vuoden työkokemus tietoturvan, tuotantolaitosten automaation, järjestelmien ylläpidon ja/tai verkkojen hallinnan parista
Osaamista ja kokemusta prosessiturvallisuudesta sekä siihen liittyvistä standardeista ja lainsäädäntövaatimuksista (esim. työturvallisuus, kemikaaliturvallisuus, vesihuolto- ja ympäristölainsäädäntö)
Kokemusta riskianalyysimenetelmistä ja niiden fasilitoinnista
Osaamista kemikaaliturvallisuudesta
Ymmärrystä teollisista ohjausjärjestelmistä tai vahva motivaatio oppia ne vesihuollon ympäristössä
Aitoa kiinnostusta turvallisuustehtäviin, kriittisen infrastruktuurin turvaamiseen ja kestävää kehitystä tukeviin ratkaisuihin
Erinomainen suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi
Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, järjestelmällisyys, luotettavuus ja oma-aloitteisuus

Lisäksi katsomme eduksi
Kokemusta vesihuollosta ja/tai prosessiteollisuudesta tai muusta vastaavasta tuotantoympäristöstä
Kokemusta projektinhallinnasta ja toiminnallisen turvallisuuden vaatimuksista
Kyberturvallisuusosaamista (security) erityisesti teollisuus- ja kriittisen infrastruktuurin ympäristöissä
NIS2-direktiivin sekä Traficomin ja muiden viranomaisten ohjeiden tuntemusta
Suoritetut tietoturva- tai turvallisuussertifikaatit (esim. CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001, kyberturvallisuuskoulutukset)

Mitä tarjoamme?
Vakaan ja varman työpaikan vesihuoltolaitoksessa
Mahdollisuuden työskennellä yhteiskunnan kannalta kriittisen toiminnan parissa
Vaikuttavan roolin, jossa pääset käytännössä parantamaan kyberturvaa ja laitosten fyysistä turvallisuutta
Monipuolisen tehtäväkentän, jossa yhdistyvät laitosturvallisuus, tietoturva, prosessiturvallisuus ja varautuminen
Osaavan ja matalahierarkkisen organisaation tuen sekä koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuuksia
Kilpailukykyiset työehdot ja henkilöstöedut

Työsuhteessa on kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaika. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilasta ennen työn aloittamista. Päätöksenteon tukena käytämme henkilöarviointia.

Kiinnostuitko?
Tule mukaan varmistamaan, että toiminta-alueemme vesihuolto toimii turvallisesti myös tulevaisuudessa - niin normaalitilanteessa kuin häiriöissä - lähetä hakemuksesi!

jobs.title: KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling
jobs.description:
KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling

Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt elektronikteam og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, effektiv drift og motiverede medarbejdere? Så er du måske vores nye arbejdsleder til Elektronikafdelingen. Vi arbejder hovedsageligt på nybygninger og er med fra de første spæde installationer til de sidste, færdige installation ombord på topmoderne fartøjer.

Som arbejdsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af elektronikafdelingen i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen. Du bliver en central del af produktionen, hvor du sikrer effektiv planlægning, høj kvalitet i arbejdet og synlig ledelse af afdelingens medarbejdere.

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for både medarbejdere, produktion, kvalitet og opfølgning på opgaver og ressourcer.

 

Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with energy system, power system, or electricity market modelling, and with the associated software and programming environments.
- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tulet toimimaan tietohallinnon ICT-palveluiden yksikössä, jossa roolisi on kriittinen: varmistat, että Keusoten suuren 10 miljoonan euron investointiohjelman tuottamat uudet teknologiat ja automaatiot laskeutuvat jatkuvaan tuotantoon hallitusti, vikasietoisesti ja elinkaarikestävästi.

Tässä roolissa toimit tiiviinä työparina kehityspuolen Ratkaisuarkkitehdille sekä jatkuvien palveluiden ICT- asiantuntijoille, tuoden palvelumuotoilun ja operatiivisen tehokkuuden näkökulman uuden teknologian jalkauttamiseen.

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tuot "Ops"-näkökulman suoraan kehityshankkeiden ytimeen. Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, ettei uusi älykäs automaatio (kuten AI-toiminnot, edistynyt ohjelmistorobotiikka ja integraatiot) jää irralliseksi, vaan sen tuomat tuottavuushyödyt ulosmitataan sote-palvelutoiminnassa täysimääräisesti sujuvan, vakaan ja loppukäyttäjälle optimoidun palvelutuotannon kautta.

Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:

- Automaation tuotantoon vienti ja vakauttaminen: Vastaat siitä, että kehityshankkeiden automaatioratkaisut (esim. ServiceNow tai tekoäly) siirtyvät tuotantoon luotettavasti ja ilman manuaalista häiriönhallinnan tarvetta.
- Palveluarkkitehtuurin suunnittelu: Määrittelet ja varmistat yhdessä ict-palveluarkkitehtien kanssa, että uudet järjestelmät täyttävät jatkuvien palveluiden laatuvaatimukset, kuten valvonta-, tuki-, dokumentaatio- ja elinkaarimallit.
- Hankintojen palveluvaatimukset: Osallistut suurten ICT-kilpailutusten (kuten talous-, HR- ja asianhallintajärjestelmät) valmisteluun asettamalla toimittajille tiukat ylläpito-, jatkuvuus- ja palvelutasovaatimukset (SLA).
- Asiantuntijayksikön tekninen tuki: Toimit ICT-asiantuntijoiden ja järjestelmävastaavien teknisenä sparrauskumppanina monimutkaisissa ongelmanratkaisutilanteissa sekä palveluiden muutoshallinnassa (Change Management).

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietotekniikka tai tietojärjestelmätiede) sekä vahva käytännön kokemus laajojen IT-palvelukokonaisuuksien ja palveluarkkitehtuurin hallinnasta.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

Olet luonteeltasi siltoja rakentava asiantuntija, joka ymmärtää sekä modernin IT-arkkitehtuurin mahdollisuudet että arjen sujuvan palvelutuotannon ja loppukäyttäjän tarpeet.

- Substanssiosaaminen: Syvällinen IT-palvelunhallinnan (ITIL) viitekehyksen ja prosessien tuntemus. Hyvä tekninen ymmärrys pilvipalveluista, integraatioista (API) sekä automaatioratkaisujen (RPA/AI) operatiivisesta ylläpidosta.
- Järjestelmäosaaminen: Erinomainen hallinta palvelunhallinnan työkaluista (ITSM) sekä strategiamme mukaisesti Google-ekosysteemin laajamittainen osaaminen.
- Vuorovaikutustaidot: Erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot. Kyky toimia tulkkina ja koordinaattorina kehityksen, jatkuvien palveluiden asiantuntijoiden sekä ulkopuolisten toimittajien välillä.

Lisätiedot tehtävästä antaa ICT-aluepäällikkö Saku Salonen, p. 040 304 7040, saku.salonen@keusote.fi

Lisätiedot palvelussuhteesta sekä tehtävään esitettävät selvitykset

jobs.title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.



As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.

 - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.

 - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.

 - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.

 - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.

 - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.

 - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Permanent employment with a global and growing logistics leader
* Salary: PLN 91,663 – 145,800 gross per year*
* Private medical care (LUX MED)
* Group life insurance
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting employees and their families
* Employment contract in an international logistics company

The final salary level will depend on the candidate's professional experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: MRO Buyer
jobs.description:
The MRO Buyer manages procurement activities across various departments, ensuring optimal cost-effectiveness, timely delivery, and compliance with quality standards and procurement policies. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional teams, internal stakeholders, customers, and external suppliers, as well as a proactive approach to continuous improvement and cost savings.

Primary Responsibilities:

Procurement Planning

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering and Logistics, to understand procurement requirements, specifications, inventory needs, and priorities. Ensure planning covers MRO materials and office supplies needs.

Order Management

  • Place purchase orders and ensure timely delivery of materials and services, coordinating with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve any issues, delays, or supply risks.

Supplier Management

  • Monitor and manage supplier performance, including delivery performance, quality and responsiveness, and compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular supplier reviews and evaluations.
  • Seek opportunities for supplier development, improved commercial terms, and long-term supplier relationships.

Record-Keeping

  • Maintain accurate procurement records, including purchase orders, contracts, trackers, and supplier information, according to company policies and procedures.

Inventory Management

  • Collaborate with the planning and relevant internal teams to support adequate inventory levels, considering lead times, operational requirements, and production needs.

Cost Optimization

  • Identify and implement cost-saving measures, sourcing opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Explore opportunities for supplier consolidation, improved commercial terms, and long-term agreements.

Reporting

  • Generate reports and analyses on procurement activities, supplier performance, purchasing performance, and cost-saving initiatives.

Continuous Improvement & Collaboration

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, lead times, supplier performance, and overall efficiency.
  • Support and participate in Continuous Improvement projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Support other procurement categories and team members when needed.

Requirements:

Skills And Competencies

  • Min. 5 years of proven experience as an MRO buyer.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement processes, best practices, sourcing, negotiation, and supplier management.
  • Proven team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support others.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in using procurement software, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and effectively prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify issues, raise risks early, and drive improvements.
  • High-level proficiency in English, including communication with international suppliers and stakeholders.

Experience & Qualification:

  • Bachelorâs degree in mechanical engineering and/or Supply Chain Management.
  • Practical experience in MRO procurement.
  • Proven experience in procurement or supply chain management.
  • Experience in a global or multinational organization is an advantage.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, automotive, engineering, manufacturing, or import/export industries is an advantage.

jobs.title: Chauffør - STARK Regionale Distributionscenter
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Trives du med frihed, ansvar og kundekontakt, og har du erfaring med krankørsel? Så er du måske vores nye chauffør på STARKs regionale distributionscenter i Aarhus.

Du bliver en del af et team på 80 kolleger, der hver dag sørger for levering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, byggepladser og private kunder.

Dine opgaver

  • Levering af byggematerialer med lastbil og kran

  • Læsning og aflæsning med kran og truck

  • God og professionel kundeservice

  • Sikker og ansvarlig håndtering af varer

Vi forestiller os at du:

  • Har kørekort C

  • Har kran D-certifikat

  • Har truckcertifikat

  • Har EU-kvalifikationsbevis

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og serviceminded

Det får du hos os:

  • Moderne MAN- og Volvo-lastbiler

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Fri weekender og helligdage

  • En hverdag med variation og selvstændighed

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra 06:00 - 14:15

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK RDC via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK RDC som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftschef Bjarne Søndergaard på telefon +45 28 94 82 76

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________
 

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

Haemme nyt asiakaspalveluhenkistä ENERGIA-ASIANTUNTIJAA, ISS Remote Engineering Centre-etähallintakeskukseemme Kuopioon. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Työaika tässä tehtävässä sijoittuu pääasiallisesti arkeen toimistoaikaan. Raportoit tehtävässä palveluesihenkilölle.
Energia-asiantuntijana vastaat nimettyjen asiakkaiden kiinteistöjen energia- ja olosuhdehallinnasta. Työ koostuu kiinteistöjen energianhallintaan ja rakennusautomaatioon liittyvistä monipuolisista työtehtävistä sekä raportoinnista. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden kanssa sekä sähköpostitse, puhelimitse että asiakkaan tiloissa. Toimit asiakkaiden asiantuntevana kumppanina löytäen heidän liiketoimintaansa tukevia ratkaisuja eri kiinteistöpalveluistamme. Työ on pääasiassa toimistolla tehtävää, mutta siihen voi sisältyä myös satunnaista matkustamista eri puolille Suomea.
Odotamme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistöjen energianhallinnasta ja talotekniikan parista. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulutututkinto tekniikan alalta, tai olet juuri tutkintoosi valmistumassa ja/tai kokemusta vastaavista energia-asiantuntijatehtävistä. Arvostamme automaatiojärjestelmien syvällistä tuntemusta sekä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen olosuhteista. Tehtävä edellyttää valmiuksia tehdä energianhallintaan liittyviä laskentoja, kuten energiankulutuksen analysointia, toimenpiteiden säästöpotentiaalien arviointia ja energiankäytön optimointia. Tärkeintä on hyvä motivaatio, tahtotila kehittyä ja aito halu toimia rohkeasti asiakasrajapinnassa. Työssäsi tarvitset oma-aloitteisuutta, vahvaa palveluasennetta sekä paineensietokykyä. Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi, niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti, suomen kielellä ja hyvällä englannin kielellä sekä IT-taitosi ovat ajan tasalla. Katsomme eduksi Motivan energiakatselmoijan pätevyyden ja ISO 50001 -energiahallintajärjestelmän tuntemuksen. Teetämme valitulle henkilölle turvallisuusselvityksen, joka on hyväksyttynä edellytys työsopimukselle.
Tarjoamme sinulle itsenäisen, mielenkiintoisen ja haastavan työn kasvavassa yksikössämme. Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kannustavaan tiimiimme! Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuksia kehittyä sekä rakentaa oman näköistä ISS urapolkuasi. Tule kanssamme luomaan tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Mikäli olet etsimämme henkilö, jätä meille hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 15.9.2026. Liitäthän hakemukseesi mukaan myös CV:n.

jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator - Fitness Centre
jobs.description:
Position purpose

The Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator is responsible for maintaining a safe, healthy, clean and well-organised environment for customers, employees and visitors of the fitness centre. The role combines occupational health and safety coordination, facility cleanliness and hygiene, safety administration, and customer support. The position also has particular responsibility for welcoming, advising and guiding international and non-Finnish-speaking customers.

Key responsibilities

Coordinate the fitness centre's occupational health and safety activities and support compliance with applicable workplace health and safety requirements.

Conduct regular workplace and facility inspections, hazard identification and risk assessments, identify potential safety risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain safety documentation, including risk assessments, inspection records, incident reports, safety instructions, training records and other relevant OHS documentation.

Support incident investigation and follow-up, report safety concerns, and help implement measures to prevent recurrence.

Coordinate and maintain practical emergency preparedness, first-aid and fire-safety arrangements and provide safety guidance to employees when required.

Monitor the cleanliness, hygiene and general condition of the fitness centre, including training areas, changing rooms, sanitary facilities, reception and other customer areas.

Perform and coordinate routine cleaning duties and ensure that cleaning materials, hygiene products, first-aid supplies and other essential facility supplies are adequately maintained.

Identify safety, cleanliness, hygiene or facility deficiencies and ensure that they are reported and addressed promptly.

Welcome and assist international and non-Finnish-speaking customers, provide orientation to the fitness centre and explain facilities, access procedures, safety practices, rules and appropriate use of the premises.

Support reception and front-of-house operations when required, including customer check-in, visitor management, answering enquiries, telephone communication and general administrative record keeping.

Promote a proactive safety culture and contribute to a professional, welcoming and well-organised customer environment.

Requirements

NEBOSH certificate completed within 5 years (or alternatively, NEBOSH course active with graduation before the commencement of the work).

Professional OHS certifications: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment (HIRA), Basic Fire Fighting, Basic First Aid, Incident Investigation and Legal Liability.

Excellent command of English, both spoken and written, enabling professional customer service, safety communication, guidance and documentation in an international environment.

Relevant occupational health and safety competence and the ability to conduct workplace inspections, identify hazards and maintain safety documentation.

Strong customer-service, communication, organisational and administrative skills.

Relevant competence

The role utilises competence in occupational health and safety, SHE representation, workplace inspections, hazard identification and risk assessment, safety documentation, incident investigation, first aid, fire safety, administration and front-desk customer service.

jobs.title: Urban walker
jobs.employer: walkr - turn your Google Meet walk-friendly
jobs.description:
Urban Walker

Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability) Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors)



About Walkr

Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work.

We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day.




The role

We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll take Walkr's calls, meetings and thinking sessions outdoors, on foot, in a city with enough walkable area to actually make that work. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback.

Practically, this means:

  • Taking scheduled calls and 1:1s while walking, using Walkr to flag and organise them
  • Logging what works and what doesn't: audio quality, routes, weather, pacing, how conversations change when nobody's looking at a screen
  • Feeding that back into the product directly, you'll be in the room (or rather, on the street) with the team building the features you use
  • Scouting and mapping walkable routes near our hubs that others on the team can reuse
  • Occasionally representing Walkr in walking meetings with partners, press or early users



What we're looking for

  • You live in, or are willing to be based in, a city with genuinely walkable areas (parks, canals, low-traffic streets, decent pavements)
  • You're comfortable holding a normal, focused conversation while moving, this is a real skill, not everyone has it
  • You're organised enough to manage a calendar full of outdoor commitments and reroute around weather, meetings and life
  • You're naturally curious about behaviour change, habits and how environment shapes how we think
  • Bonus: you already walk a lot and have opinions about it



Why this role exists

Most companies talk about wellbeing and then put everyone back in a chair in a room with no windows. We'd rather have one person whose entire job disproves the excuse that walking meetings "don't really work in practice." If it's your job, it has to work.


What you'll get

  • A role that pays you to do the thing our product is trying to get everyone else to do
  • Direct input into what we build next
  • Flexible hours built around daylight and your city's best routes
  • The rare chance to put "Professional Walker" on your CV and mean it

jobs.title: Medhjælper i bageriet - Priorparken
jobs.description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Medhjælper til bageriet, der kan hjælpe os med at holde produktionen godt kørende og skabe friskbagt brød, kager og bagværk til vores gæster hver dag. Her bruger du din lyst til at lære, dit gode drive og din glæde ved at arbejde sammen med andre, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…
Kort sagt handler rollen om at understøtte produktionen og lære arbejdet i bageriet godt at kende.

Den lidt længere version er, at du bliver en del af et team, hvor du får oplæring i de forskellige opgaver i produktionen. Det kan være alt fra dejhåndtering, bagning og pakning til brug af maskiner og opsætning af frost. Hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver, og vi roterer, så vi kan hjælpe hinanden. Du bliver en del af vores centralbageri, hvor bageri, pakkeri og logistik arbejder tæt sammen, og hvor vi hver dag skaber friskbagt kvalitet til vores gæster.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • har lyst til at arbejde med bageri og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dig i rollen

  • er en holdspiller og bidrager til den gode stemning

  • gerne har erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, men det er ikke et krav

  • kan tale, læse og forstå dansk eller engelsk

Hvad vi tilbyder dig
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos os
Din arbejdsuge er på 37 timer, hvor du arbejder med fast natarbejdstid mellem kl. 18.00 og 04.00 (arbejdstiden kan skifte) og fri hver anden weekend.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.
