jobs.title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks førende krisecenter  Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en erfaren socialrådgiver til en fast stilling
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer?

Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft, og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner, både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund har 21 lejligheder med plads til voksne og op mod 30 medfølgende børn, og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af opholdsplaner

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum 5 års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag , vi er et krisecenter, ikke kun en kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og rengøringspersonale.

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset og den fælles opgave.

Arbejdstid

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage kl. 8.00-16.00.

I denne stilling vil onsdag være den faste ugentlige lange arbejdsdag med arbejdstid frem til kl. 18.00.

Du bestemmer selv om du ønsker 30, 32 eller 37 timer ugentligt.

Derudover indgår rådgiverne i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, lørdag og søndag kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter, typisk 1-2 vagter afhængigt af de pågældende helligdage.

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter. Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til udvikling.

  • En hverdag med både selvstændighed, ansvar og mulighed for faglig sparring.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed, samarbejde, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst: de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer – en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er en fast stilling med ansættelse fra 1/11-2026

Ansøgning samt CV sendes til linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. septmber 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt: 24. septmeber 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda Møllgren
Leder, Krisecenter Guldborgsund
Telefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-14.00
Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag forsøger at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation is open for appointment from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter. The position is available for a period of 20 months and is based at Aalborg University’s campus in Aalborg.

You will be part of the research group Batteries, which is placed in the section for Mechatronic Systems. The position is closely connected to our activities within applied battery research, and your work will contribute to the development of new knowledge within this field.

Your work tasks
In this position you will conduct research within battery state estimation, with a particular focus on emerging sodium-ion battery technology. You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and abroad.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in a research project related to development of a battery management system (BMS) tailored for sodium-ion batteries. The tasks include battery cell characterization and modelling based on laboratory tests, and development of algorithms for estimating the charge level, health, and power capability which includes robustness against different operation conditions. The position is a part of a research project and prototype battery modules will be produced by one of the partners. The tasks include testing of these prototype modules as well. Sodium-ion batteries is a relatively new technology, and they have their own electrochemical properties. One of the key questions of this research project is to obtain a better understanding of the difference between emerging sodium-ion batteries and traditional lithium-ion based batteries when it comes to the battery state estimation and management.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. The position may include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of students at bachelor’s and master’s level, for example in the form of project supervision or involvement in courses related to your expertise. Depending on project needs, you may also take part in preparing applications for external research funding and in supporting the development of new research directions at the department.

Your competencies
You hold a PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrochemistry or a closely related field or can document equivalent scientific qualifications at PhD level. Your research profile is clearly connected to battery state estimation, and you can demonstrate experience with development of battery electric equivalent circuit models and algorithms for estimating the charge, health, and power based on direct methods (e.g. open circuit voltage), model-based methods (e.g. Kalman filtering), data driven methods (e.g. machine learning or neural networks), etc. The experience could come from lithium-ion, lithium-ion capacitor, sodium-ion, or other battery technologies.

You have solid skills in Matlab/Simulink simulation tool, experimental work in laboratory environments, working with battery cyclers and equipment for electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), preparing battery test setups, and data processing and analysis of battery test data and you are comfortable working systematically with complex technical problems. Experience with industrial collaboration and battery management systems will be an advantage, as well as documented ability to publish in international journals.

You communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing, and you can present your work to both specialists and non-specialists. If you already speak Danish or would like to learn it, this will be an asset in everyday life at the university and in Danish society, and language courses are available locally.

You are motivated by working in an international academic environment, where you collaborate closely with colleagues, share knowledge and contribute actively to joint projects, while also managing your own tasks in a structured and responsible way. You are curious, open to feedback and able to move projects forward from idea to concrete results within agreed deadlines.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

Do you have any questions?
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us.

For professional questions, please contact Erik Schaltz, Associate Professor, esc@energy.aau.dk, +45 99403302.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position
  • References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Further information
Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish).

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in Europe in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and Europe.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in the project MetNH3Energy, in the topic of Hydrogen storage and Transport using Ammonia and modelling in CFD on ammonia leakage and the project ACE Water, in the topic degradation in LTEL and HTEL stacks and developing lifetime models, life-time predictions and the validation of them.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. The position may include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of students at bachelor’s and master’s level, for example in the form of project supervision or involvement in courses related to your expertise. Depending on project needs, you may also take part in preparing applications for external research funding and in supporting the development of new research directions at the department.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
jobs.description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

jobs.title: Store Manager
jobs.description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether youâre welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. youâre not expected to fit a mold. Youâre encouraged to break it and create something better.

Overview

As the Store Manager, you will lead a dedicated team of store associates & leaders every day, to create an exceptional consumer experience.â¯ Your focus will be on driving sales, providing excellent customer service, maintaining visual presentations, and developing talent within the store. This role offers opportunity to grow and collaborate with industry leading teammates and partners.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver outstanding service to our consumers using our C.H.A.R.M service model
  • Leads the store team in surpassing performance metrics including sales, consumer service and charms
  • Apply analytical thinking & company reporting to find opportunities within store, empowering the team to make strategic decisions
  • Lead visual presentation, product flow, replenishment, and operational standards throughout the store
  • Foster a welcoming, inclusive environment that engages promotes internal growth and builds an external network of talent
  • Coordinate, delegate, prioritize and meet store deadlines while ensuring effective follow up on daily activities
  • Contribute to crafting a team environment that encourages sharing of suggestions, ideas, and concerns while upholding Crocs Inc. values
  • Learn & assist in various departments including consumer service, product knowledge, visual presentation, and stock room management.
  • Support team members in the daily execution of retail operations i.e., POS system management and use, stock replenishment, assist in pricing and markdown processes seasonally, promote loyalty programs, maintain cleanliness and recovery standards etc.
  • Adhere to Crocs, Inc. Asset Protection policies and procedures, including shortage prevention, inventory control, and compliance procedures

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Minimum 18+ years old
  • Possess at least A Level / SSCE/ Diploma / Advanced Diploma or above preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of total retail experience; preferably with previous Store Manager experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a passion for challenging, empowering, and driving team results
  • Professional working proficiency in English, proficiency of other language(s) will be an advantage
  • Proven communication skills (written and verbal) to successfully connect with store team, operations managers, District Managers & corporate partners
  • Flexible to work on rotational shift basis, including nights, Saturdays, Sundays and Public Holidays.
  • Intermediate computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Email and able to operate retail Point of Sale system
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a passion for challenging, empowering, and driving team results
  • Desire to succeed in a high growth, fast-paced retail environment
  • The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of but not limited to those that an employee will encounter while performing the essential functions of this job.
  • Ability to climb and descend ladders carrying merchandise daily
  • Ability to lift 15kg or more with assistance daily

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.â¯This posting is for an existing vacany and we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other classification protected by law.

Title: Store Manager

The posted pay range reflects geographic market conditions and may vary by location. Compensation will always meet or exceed applicable local minimum wage requirements.

This position is eligible to participate in a company incentive program.

This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, and many other additional voluntary benefits. This organization participates in E-Verify

jobs.title: OPERATER U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 4)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 2 smjene – prijepodne/poslijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.304,83 € do 1.500,60 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda
  • rukovanje s repromaterijalima i kemikalijama koje se koriste u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • dehidriranje otpadnog mulja,
  • nadopuna spremnika za kemikalije prema radnim postupcima,
  • skidanje korozije po opremi i zaštita odgovarajućim sredstvima,
  • pomaganje kod redovitih remonta i popravaka opreme i crpki,
  • održavanje alata,
  • održavanje travnjaka,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme (pranje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača, mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana, skidanje korozije, zaštita opreme odgovarajućim zaštitnim sredstvima..),
  • kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i po potrebi zamjena beskonačnih vreća za otpad,
  • pomoć oko čišćenja kod pražnjenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja…,
  • čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika,
  • obrada i dehidracija mulja, održavanje kontejnera za mulj čistim,
  • mjerenje koncentracije plinova prema radnim uputama,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

Projektiranje mehaničkih sklopova, robota, proizvodnih linija i gusjeničara različitih veličina

Visoka stručna sprema (strojarstvo ili srodno)

Iskustvo u izradi kompletne projektne dokumentacije
Poznavanje principa projektiranja pokretnih mehanizama, pogona i konstrukcija
Samostalnost, preciznost i orijentiranost na detalje
Poznavanje engleskog jezika je prednost

jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Manufacturing & Industrialisation Lead
jobs.description:
After nearly nine years of technology development, we are entering an important stage of growth. We are transitioning from low-rate engineering builds towards industrialisation, pre-series manufacturing and serial production.

Work tasks: Lead the transition from engineering builds through pre-series and into scalable serial production
Establish and scale Golbriak Space’s manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing capability in Estonia Develop repeatable production processes, routings, work instructions, acceptance criteria and engineering-to-production transfer practices Define production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures, equipment and test infrastructure Own the end-to-end manufacturing flow, from incoming inspection and material planning to final acceptance and shipping Implement production planning, capacity management, inventory control, ERP/MRP tools and relevant manufacturing metrics Oversee optical, electronic, mechanical and system-level assembly, integration, verification and testing Define and manage supplier, outsourcing and make-or-buy strategies for components and manufacturing activities Establish production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 principles, including traceability, change control and non-conformance management Identify and resolve manufacturing, testing, capacity and supply-chain risks and bottlenecks Drive continuous improvement across quality, yield, cycle time, cost and delivery performance Build, lead and develop the manufacturing and operations team as production scales

We offer: A key leadership role with ownership of Golbriak Space’s manufacturing and industrialisation function
The opportunity to build a production facility and manufacturing capability from the ground up Direct involvement in taking advanced optical communication technology into serial production Close cooperation with the founders and a multidisciplinary engineering team A high level of autonomy and the ability to shape manufacturing systems, facilities, supplier strategy and team capability An international, technically ambitious and hands-on working environment A monthly gross salary of €4,655–€5,985, depending on experience and Relocation support to Estonia if required Flexible working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: Proven experience establishing or significantly scaling a manufacturing facility or function
Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

jobs.title: RTL Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Come work with a multidisciplinary engineering team focused on delivering world-class optical telecommunication systems for space, airborne and ground applications.

Work tasks: Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain and improve RTL modules in VHDL Implement high-speed digital logic for communication systems Create simulations and testbenches to verify RTL behaviour Verify and validate designs against technical and system requirements Use Quartus, GHDL and GTKWave as part of the development and verification workflow Investigate and resolve RTL, integration and system-level issues Maintain clear code documentation and verification records Debug and validate FPGA designs on physical hardware Support board bring-up and hardware integration Work with LVDS, Ethernet and other high-speed digital interfaces Support integration between Altera FPGAs and STM32 microcontrollers through CAN interfaces Use laboratory equipment, including high-speed oscilloscopes, power supplies and multimeters Support system-level testing, verification and product qualification Contribute to the integration of custom software-defined radio functionality Work closely with electronics, embedded software and systems engineers Coordinate with electronics engineers on FPGA pinout integration and chip interconnections Translate system and communication requirements into practical RTL implementations Maintain FPGA architecture, interface, verification and code documentation Provide practical input into the development and improvement of the communication system

We offer: We offer a competitive salary
Work/life balance with the possibility of flexible hours Bonuses based on performance The opportunity to work in a talented and dynamic startup environment.

Other requirements: Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in electronics, computer engineering, telecommunications or another relevant technical field At least one year of practical RTL or FPGA development experience Practical experience with RTL design in VHDL Experience maintaining, improving and developing RTL modules Experience creating and using simulations and testbenches Experience debugging FPGA designs on physical hardware Experience designing long, high-speed processing pipelines Understanding of clock recovery and high-speed digital data paths Understanding of digital communication systems and network protocol layers Familiarity with FPGA-based communication interfaces Ability to use technical documentation, electronic schematics and component datasheets A structured approach to verification, debugging and technical documentation Ability to work independently while recognising when collaboration or support is needed Readiness to work in a startup environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve Professional working proficiency in English at C1 level or equivalent University or personal projects may be considered as relevant experience when they include substantial FPGA-based development, such as developing a software-defined radio or a similarly complex system. Practical RTL design experience is essential for this position. Nice to have: Experience with Altera FPGA platforms Experience using Quartus, GHDL or GTKWave Experience with LVDS and Ethernet interfaces Experience with PCIe or similar high-speed technologies Understanding of Ethernet physical and data-link layers, including PHY and MAC functionality Experience with digital signal processing or high-speed data processing Experience developing FPGA-based software-defined radio systems Experience integrating FPGAs with microcontrollers or other electronic components Experience coordinating FPGA pinouts and chip interconnections with electronics engineers Experience in telecommunications, optical communication or signal processing Experience developing high-reliability or radiation-resilient digital logic Experience in aerospace, defence or another high-reliability engineering environment

 - You'll influence the broader company by communicating your findings and driving change in our product and business. (Insights are useful. Impact is even better!)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.



Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Finance Systems & Compliance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

 - AI-native builder mindset: Experience designing or building with AI assistants and agents, workflow automation, or internal tooling — including prompt design, tool selection, and evaluation for quality, reliability, and edge cases. This role requires AI fluency.

 - Lightweight automation ability: Comfort building with Notion custom agents and automations, structured skills, and integrations across systems (APIs, webhooks, connectors). Hands-on preferred.

 - Clear communication and stakeholder judgment: Ability to convey design intent using whatever artifact fits the problem, and to present and defend tradeoffs across multiple tools and teams.

Tööülesanded: Administraatori tööülesannete alla kuulub eelkõige külalistega ladus suhtlemine ja abivalmis hoiak. Tuleb külalisi sisse- kui ka välja registreerida, hoida silm peal e-mailidel ning aidata kliente ka telefoni teel.
Ootame kandidaadilt täpsust maksete ja broneeringusüsteemide haldamisel ning oskust olla vahelüliks erinevate osakondade vahel. Loodame leida vastutustundlikku ja rõõmsameelset inimest, kes oskaks ennast vabalt väljendada nii eesti kui ka inglise keeles. Suhtlustasemel vene keel ja muud võõrkeeled tulevad kasuks.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume graafiku alusel tööd ajavahemikul 7:00 - 23:00. Sõltuvalt hooajast ning vajadustest 8-10 tunnised vahetused, kas hommikul alates 7:00 või 12:30. Valmis tuleb olla ka pühadel ja nädalavahetustel töötamiseks.
Toimib igakuine motiveeriv boonussüsteem kus töötasu sõltub tööülesannete korrektsest täitmisest, meeskonnatööst ning klientide tagasisidest. Huvitav ja vaheldusrikas töö, sõbraliku ning üksteist toetava kollektiiviga, kellega tehakse koos ka ühisüritusi. Kontor asub vanalinnas. Võimalus töötada osalise tööajaga.

Muud nõuded: Sobivalt kandidaadilt ootame:
Valmisolekut meeskonnatööks; Head eesti ja inglise keele oskust, suhtlustasemel vene keelt; Positiivset ja avatud suhtlemist; Valmisolek mõnel korral nädalas olema peale tööpäeva telefoni valves; Valmisolekut töötamiseks päevasel ajal graafiku alusel, vahetustega (kaasaarvatud pühad ja nädalavahetused); Kohusetundlikkust, täpsusust.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts:
Part time (0.25 - 0.75)
